Ta'aruf-e-Quran-e-Kareem. Phir farman hai ke yeh aayatein Quran-e-Mubeen ki hain jo bahut wazeh bilkul saaf aur haq-o-batil, bhalai-o-burai ke darmiyan faisla aur farq karne wala hai. In logon ke iman na lane se aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ranjeeda-e-khatir aur ghamgeen na hon. Jaise aur jagah irshad hai aayat (فَلَا تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسَرٰتٍ ۭ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِـيْمٌۢ بِمَا يَصْنَعُوْنَ) (35. Fatir: 8) to un ke iman na lane par hasrat-o-afsos na kar. Aur aayat mein hai aayat (فَلَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ عَلٰٓي اٰثَارِهِمْ اِنْ لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوْا بِهٰذَا الْحَدِيْثِ اَسَفًا) (18. Al-Kahf: 6) kahin aisa na ho ke tu un ke peeche apni jaan ganwa de. Chunke hamari yeh chahat hi nahin ke logon ko iman par zabardasti karein, agar yeh chahte to koi aisi cheez aasman se utarte ke yeh iman lane par majboor ho jate, magar hum ko to un ka ikhtiyari iman talab karte hain. Aur aayat mein hai (وَلَوْ شَاۗءَ رَبُّكَ لَاٰمَنَ مَنْ فِي الْاَرْضِ كُلُّھُمْ جَمِيْعًا ۭ اَفَاَنْتَ تُكْرِهُ النَّاسَ حَتّٰى يَكُوْنُوْا مُؤْمِنِيْنَ) (10. Yunus: 99) agar tera Rab chahe to roo-e-zameen ke tamam log momin ho jayen, kya tu logon par jabr kare ga? Jab tak ke woh momin na ho jayen. Aur aayat mein hai agar tera Rab chahta to tamam logon ko ek hi ummat bana deta. Yeh ikhtilaf-e-deen-o-mazhab bhi us ka muqarrar kiya hua hai aur us ki hikmat ko zahir karne wala hai, us ne Rasool bhej diye, kitabein utar dein, apni daleel-o-hujjat qaim kar di, insaan ko iman lane na lane mein mukhtar kar diya. Ab jis raah par woh chahe lag jaye, jab kabhi koi aasmani kitab nazil hui bahut se logon ne us se munh mod liya. Teri poori aarzoo ke bawajood aksar log be-iman hi rahenge. Surah Yaseen mein farmaya bandon par afsos hai, un ke paas jo bhi Rasool aaya unhon ne us ka mazaq udaya. Aur aayat mein hai hum ne pai dar pai paighambar bheje lekin jis ummat ke paas un ka Rasool aaya us ne apne Rasool ko jhutlane mein kami na ki. Yahan bhi us ke baad hi farmaya ke Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman ki qoum ne bhi use jhutlaya hai, unhein bhi us ka badla anqareeb mil jaye ga, in zalimon ko bahut jald maloom ho jaye ga ke yeh kis raah dale gaye hain? Phir apni shaan-o-shaukat, qudrat-o-azmat, izzat-o-rif'at bayan farmata hai ke jis ke paigham aur jis ke qasid ko tum jhoota keh rahe ho woh itna bada Qadir-o-Qayyum hai ke usi ek ne sari zameen banai hai aur us mein jaandar aur be-jaan cheezein paida ki hain. Khet, phal, baagh-o-bahaar sab usi ke paida karda hain. Sha'bi (Rahimahullah / R.H) farmate hain log zameen ki paidawar hain, un mein jo jannati hain woh kareem hain aur jo dozakhi hain woh kanjoos hain. Is mein qudrat-e-Khaliq ki bahut si nishaniyan hain, yeh us ne phaili hui zameen ko aur oonche aasman ko paida kar diya. Bawajood is ke bhi aksar log iman nahin late, balki ulta us ke Nabiyon ko jhoota kehte hain, us ki kitabon ko nahin mante, us ke hukumon ki mukhalifat karte hain aur us ke mana karda kamon mein dilchaspi lete hain.

Beshak tera Rab har cheez par Ghalib hai, us ke samne makhlooq aajiz hai. Saath hi woh apne bandon par meharban hai, nafarmanon ke azaab mein jaldi nahin karta, takheer aur dheel deta hai taake woh apne kartooton se baaz aajayein, lekin phir bhi jab woh rah-e-raast par nahin aate to unhein sakhti se pakad leta hai aur un se poora inteqam leta hai. Haan, jo tauba kare aur us ki taraf jhuke aur us ka farmanbardar ho jaye, woh us par us ke maa-baap se bhi zyada raham-o-karam karta hai.

Musa A.S aur Allah Jalla Shanahu ke mukalmaat. Allah Ta'ala apne bande aur apne Rasool aur apne Kaleem Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salatu Wassalam ko jo hukum diya tha use bayan farma rahe hain ke Toor ke dayen taraf se aap ko aawaz di, aap se sargoshiyan keen, aap ko apna Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur barguzida banaya aur aap ko Firaun aur us ki qoum ki taraf bheja jo zulm par kamar basta the. Aur Allah ka darr aur parhezgari naam ko bhi un mein nahin rahi thi. Hazrat Musa A.S ne apni chand kamzoriyan Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ke samne bayan keen jo Inayat-e-Ilahi se door kar di gayin, jaise Surah Taha mein aap ke sawalat poor kar diye gaye. Yahan aap ke uzr yeh bayan hue ke mujhe darr hai ke woh mujhe jhutla denge. Mera seena tang hai, meri zaban luknat wali hai, Haroon ko bhi mere sath Nabi bana diya jaye. Aur main ne un hi mein se ek Qibti ko bila-qasoor maar dala tha jis wajah se main ne Misr chhora, ab jate hue darr lagta hai ke kahin woh mujh se badla na le lein. Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne jawab diya ke kisi baat ka khatka na rakho. Hum tere bhai ko tera sathi bana dete hain. Aur tumhein roshan daleel dete hain, woh log tumhein koi eza na pahuncha sakenge, mera wada hai ke tum ko ghalib karunga. Tum meri aayatein le kar jao to sahi, meri madad tumhare sath rahegi. Main tumhari un ki sab baatein sunta rahunga. Jaise farman hai main tum dono ke sath hoon, sunta hoon, dekhta rahunga. Meri hifazat, meri madad, meri nusrat-o-tayeed tumhare sath hai. Allah Ta'ala apne bande aur apne Rasool aur apne Kaleem Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salatu Wassalam ko jo hukum diya tha use bayan farma rahe hain ke Toor ke dayen taraf se aap ko aawaz di, aap se sargoshiyan keen, aap ko apna Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur barguzida banaya aur aap ko Firaun aur us ki qoum ki taraf bheja jo zulm par kamar basta the. Aur Allah ka darr aur parhezgari naam ko bhi un mein nahin rahi thi. Hazrat Musa A.S ne apni chand kamzoriyan Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ke samne bayan keen jo Inayat-e-Ilahi se door kar di gayin, jaise Surah Taha mein aap ke sawalat poor kar diye gaye. Yahan aap ke uzr yeh bayan hue ke mujhe darr hai ke woh mujhe jhutla denge. Mera seena tang hai, meri zaban luknat wali hai, Haroon ko bhi mere sath Nabi bana diya jaye. Aur main ne un hi mein se ek Qibti ko bila-qasoor maar dala tha jis wajah se main ne Misr chhora, ab jate hue darr lagta hai ke kahin woh mujh se badla na le lein. Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne jawab diya ke kisi baat ka khatka na rakho. Hum tere bhai ko tera sathi bana dete hain. Aur tumhein roshan daleel dete hain, woh log tumhein koi eza na pahuncha sakenge, mera wada hai ke tum ko ghalib karunga. Tum meri aayatein le kar jao to sahi, meri madad tumhare sath rahegi. Main tumhari un ki sab baatein sunta rahunga. Jaise farman hai main tum dono ke sath hoon, sunta hoon, dekhta rahunga. Meri hifazat, meri madad, meri nusrat-o-tayeed tumhare sath hai. Tum Firaun ke paas jao aur us par apni risalat ka izhar karo. Jaise dusri aayat mein hai ke us se kaho ke hum dono mein se har ek Allah ka faristada hai. Firaun se kaha ke tu hamare sath Bani Israel ko bhej de, woh Allah ke momin bande hain, tu ne unhein apna ghulam bana rakha hai aur un ki halat zaboon kar rakhi hai. Zillat ke sath un se apna kaam leta hai aur unhein azabon mein jakar rakha hai, ab unhein azad kar de. Hazrat Musa A.S ke is paigham ko Firaun ne nihayat haqarat se suna. Aur aap ko daant kar kehne laga ke kya tu wahi nahin ke hum ne tujhe apne han pala? Muddaton tak teri khabar-geeri karte rahe, is ehsan ka badla tu ne yeh diya ke hum mein se ek shakhs ko maar dala aur hamari nashukri ki. Jis ke jawab mein Hazrat Kaleemullah A.S ne farmaya yeh sab baatein nabuwat se pehle ki hain jab ke main khud be-khabar tha. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A ki qirat mein bajaye "Min-ad-Dalleen" ke "Min-al-Jahileen" hai. Hazrat Musa A.S ne sath hi farmaya ke phir woh pehla haal jata raha, dusra daur aaya aur Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe apna Rasool bana kar teri taraf bheja, ab agar tu mera kaha manega to salamti payega aur meri nafarmani karega to halak hoga. Is khata ke baad jab ke main tum mein se bhag gaya, us ke baad Allah ka yeh fazl mujh par hua, ab purane qisse yaad na kar. Meri aawaz par labbaik keh. Sun agar ek mujh par tu ne ehsan kiya hai to meri qoum ki qoum par tu ne zulm-o-ta'addi ki hai.

Chunki Firaun ne apni ra'iyat ko behka rakha tha aur unhein yaqeen dilaya tha ke mabood aur rab sirf main hi hoon mere siwa koi nahin is liye un sab ka aqeeda yeh tha. Jab Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne farmaya ke main Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka rasool (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hoon toh usne kaha ke Rabb-ul-Aalameen hai kya cheez? Maqsad yahi tha ke mere siwa koi rab hai hi nahin toh jo keh raha hai mehez ghalat hai. Chunancha aur aayat mein hai ke usne poocha aayat (Faman rabbukuma ya Musa) Musa tum dono ka rab kaun hai? Uske jawab mein Kaleemullah ne farmaya jisne har ek ki paidaish ki hai aur jo sab ka haadi hai. Yahan par yeh yaad rahe ke ba'az mantiqiyon ne yahan thokar khai hai aur kaha hai ke Firaun ka sawal Allah ki mahiyat se tha yeh mehez ghalat hai is liye ke mahiyat ko toh jab poochta jab ke pehle wajood ka qail hota. Woh toh sire se Allah ke wajood ka munkir tha. Apne isi aqeede ko zahir karta tha aur har ek ek ko yeh aqeeda ghont ghont kar pila raha tha go uske khilaf dalail-o-barahin uske samne khul gaye thin. Pas uske is sawal par ke Rabb-ul-Aalameen kaun hai? Hazrat Kaleemullah (A.S) ne jawab diya ke woh jo sab ka khaliq hai, sab ka malik hai, sab par qadir hai yakta hai akela hai uska koi shareek nahin. Maghrib ki taraf utarta hai agar Firaun apni uluhiyat ke da'we mein saccha hai toh zara ek din iska khilaf karke dikha de yani unhein maghrib se nikale aur mashriq ko le jaye. Yeh baat Khalil (Alaihis Salam) ne apne zamane ke badshah se ba-waqt-e-munazra kahi thi. Pehle toh Allah ka wasf bayan kiya ke woh jalata marta hai lekin is bewaqoof ne jab ke is wasf ka Allah ke sath mukhtas hone se inkar kardiya aur kehne laga yeh toh main bhi karsakta hoon, aap ne bawajood isi daleel mein bahut si gunjaish hone ke, us se bhi wazeh daleel uske samne rakhi ke accha mera Rabb mashriq se suraj nikalta hai toh ise maghrib se nikal, ab toh uske hawas gum hogaye. Isi tarah Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ki zabani tabar-tod aisi wazeh aur roshan daleelein sun kar Firaun ke ausan khata hogaye. Woh samajh gaya ke agar ek main ne na mana toh kya? Yeh wazeh daleelein in sab logon par asar kar jayengi, is liye ab apni quwwat ko kaam mein lane ka irada kiya aur Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ko darane dhamkane laga jaise aage aa raha hai.

Firaun aur Musa (A.S) ka mubahisa. Jab mubahisay mein Firaun hara, daleel-o-bayan mein ghalib na aa saka toh quwwat-o-taqat ka muzahira karne laga aur satwat-o-shaukat se haq ko dabane ka irada kiya aur kehne laga ke Musa (A.S) mere siwa kisi aur ko mabood banayega toh jail mein sara sara kar teri jaan le lunga. Hazrat Musa (A.S) bhi chunke wa'z-o-nasihat kar hi chuke thay, aap ne bhi irada kiya ke main bhi isay aur is ki qoum ko dusri tarah qail karoon toh farmane lage kyun ji, main agar apni sachai par kisi aisay mojzay ka izhar karoon ke tumhein bhi qail hona paray tab? Firaun so is ke kya kar sakta tha ke kaha achha agar sacha hai toh pesh kar. Aap ne suntay hi apni lakri jo aap ke haath mein thi hi, usay zameen par daal diya. Bas us ka zameen par girna tha ke woh ek azhdahay ki shakal ban gayi. Aur azhdaha bhi bahut bada, tez kuchliyon wala, haibat-naak, darauni aur khaufnaak shakal wala, munh pharay huay phunkarta hua. Saath hi apne gareban mein apna haath daal kar nikala toh woh chand ki tarah chamakta hua nikla. Firaun ki qismat chunke iman se khali thi, aisay wazeh mojzay dekh kar bhi apni badbakhti par ara raha aur toh kuch ban na para, apne sathiyon aur darbariyon se kehne laga ke yeh toh jadoo ke karishmay hain. Beshak itna toh main bhi maan gaya ke yeh apne fan-e-jadugari mein ustad-e-kamil hai. Phir unhein Hazrat Musa (A.S) ki dushmani par amada karne ke liye ek aur baat banayi ke yeh aisay hi shobday dikha dikha kar logon ko apni taraf mutawajja kar lega. Aur jab kuch log is ke sathi ho jayenge toh yeh ilm-e-baghawat buland kar dega, phir tumhein maghloob karke is mulk mein qabza kar lega toh is ke istihasal ki koshish abhi se karni chahiye. Batlao tumhari raye kya hai? Allah ki qudrat dekho ke Firauniyon se Allah ne woh baat kehwayi jis se Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko aam tableegh ka mauqa milay aur logon par haq wazeh ho jaye. Ya'ni jadugaron ko muqablay ke liye bulwana.

Munazra ke baad muqabla. Munazra zabani ho chuka. Ab munazra amlan ho raha hai. Is munazra ka zikr Surah A'raf, Surah Taha aur is Surah mein hai. Qibtiyon ka irada Allah ke noor ke bujhane ka tha aur Allah ka irada is ki nooraniyat ke phailane ka tha. Pas Allah ka irada ghalib raha. Iman-o-kufr ka muqabla jab kabhi hua, iman kufr par ghalib raha. Allah Ta'ala haq ko ghalib karta hai, batil ka sar phat jata hai aur logon ke batil irade hawa mein ud jate hain. Kaha gaya hai ke in ki tadaad barah ya pandrah ya satrah ya unnis ya kuch oopar tees ya assi hazar ki ya is se kam-o-besh thi. Sahi tadaad Allah Ta'ala hi ko maloom hai. In tamam ke ustad aur sardar char shakhs thay: Saboor, Aazoor, Hath-hat aur Musaffa. Chunki sare mulk mein shor mach chuka tha, charon taraf se logon ke ghol ke ghol waqt-e-muqarrara se pehle Misr mein jama ho gaye. Chunki yeh kulliya qaida hai ke ra'iyat apne badshah ke mazhab par hoti hai. Sab ki zaban se yahi nikalta tha ke jadugaron ke ghalba ke baad hum to in ki rah lag jayenge. Yeh kisi zaban se na nikla ke jis taraf haq hoga hum usi taraf ho jayenge. Ab mauqa par Firaun ma' apne jah-o-hasham ke nikla, tamam umara-o-ru'asa sath thay, lashkar, fauj, paltan hamrah thi. Jadugaron ko apne darbar mein apne samne bulwaya. Jadugaron ne badshah se ahd lena chaha, is liye kaha ke jab hum ghalib aa jayen to badshah hamain inamaat se mehroom nahin rakhenge? Firaun ne jawab diya, wah! Yeh kaise ho sakta hai? Na sirf inaam balkay main to tumhain apne khas ru'asa mein shamil karunga aur tum hamesha mere paas aur mere sath hi raha karoge. Tum mere muqarrab ban jaoge, meri tamam tar tawajjah tumhari hi taraf hogi. Woh khushi khushi maidan ki taraf chal diye. Wahan jakar Musa A.S se kehne lage, bolo tum pehle apni ustadi dikhate ho? Ya hum dikhayen? Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya, nahin tum hi pehle apni bhadas nikal lo taake tumhare dil mein koi arman na rah jaye. Yeh jawab paate hi unhon ne apni chhariyan aur rassiyan maidan mein daal di aur kehne lage, Firaun ki izzat se hamara ghalba rahega. Jaise jahil awam jab kisi kaam ko karte hain to kehte hain yeh fulan ke sawab se. Surah A'raf mein hai, jadugaron ne logon ki aankhon par jadoo kar diya. Unhain haibat mein daal diya aur bada bhari jadoo zahir kiya. Surah Taha mein hai ke in ki lathiyan aur rassiyan in ke jadoo se hilti julti maloom hone lagin. Ab Hazrat Musa A.S ne apne hath mein jo lakdi thi use maidan mein daal diya jis ne sare maidan mein in ki jo kuch nazar-bandiyon ki cheezain thin, sab ko hazam kar liya. Pas haq zahir ho gaya aur batil dab gaya aur in ka kiya karaya sab gharat ho gaya.

Yeh koi halki si baat aur thodi si daleel na thi, jadugar toh usay dekhte hi musalman ho gaye ke ek shakhs apne ustad-e-fan ke muqable mein aata hai, us ka haal jadugaron ka sa nahin. Woh koi baat nahin karta, yaqeenan hamara jadoo sirf nigahon ka fareb hai aur us ke paas Allah ka diya hua mojiza hai. Woh toh usi waqt wahin ke wahin Allah ke samne sajde mein gir gaye. Aur isi majmay mein sab ke samne apne iman lane ka elaan kiya ke hum Rabb-ul-Aalameen par iman la chuke. Phir apna qaul aur wazeh karne ke liye yeh bhi saath hi keh diya ke Rabb-ul-Aalameen se hamari murad woh Rabb hai jisay Hazrat Musa (A.S) aur Haroon (A.S) apna Rabb kehte hain. Itna bada mojiza is qadar inqilab Firaun ne apni aankhon se dekha lekin maloon ki qismat mein iman na tha. Phir bhi aankhein na khuli. Aur dushman-e-jaan ho gaya. Aur apni taqat se haq ko kuchalne laga. Aur kehne laga ke haan main jaan gaya Musa tum sab ke ustad thay, usay tum ne pehle se bhej diya, phir tum bazahir muqabla karne ke liye aaye aur batini mashwaray ke mutabiq maidan haar gaye aur us ki baat maan gaye, pas tumhara yeh makr khul gaya.

Jurrat-o-himmat wale kamil-e-iman log, SubhanAllah kaise kamil-ul-iman log thay halankeh abhi hi iman mein aaye thay lekin un ki sabr-o-sabat ka kya kehna? Firaun jaisa zalim-o-jabir hakim paas khara dara dhamka raha hai aur woh nidar be-khauf ho kar us ki mansha ke khilaf jawab de rahe hain. Hijab-e-kufr dil se door ho gaye hain is wajah se seena thonk kar muqable par aa gaye hain aur madi taqaton se bilkul mar'oob nahin hote. Un ke dilon mein yeh baat jam gayi hai ke Musa (A.S) ke paas Allah ka diya hua mojiza hai kasb kiya hua jadu nahin. Isi waqt haq ko qabool kiya. Firaun aag bagoola ho gaya aur kehne laga ke tum ne mujhe koi cheez hi na samjha. Mujh se baghi ho gaye mujh se poocha hi nahin aur Musa (A.S) ki maan li? Yeh keh kar phir is khayal se ke kahin hazireen-e-majlis par un ke haar jaane balkeh phir musalman ho jaane ka asar na pare us ne unhein zaleel samjha. Ek baat banayi aur kehne laga ke haan tum sab is ke shagird ho aur yeh tumhara ustad hai tum sab khurd ho aur yeh tumhara buzurg hai. Tum sab ko isi ne jadu sikhaya hai. Is mukabira ko dekho yeh sirf Firaun ki be-imani aur daghabazi thi warna is se pehle na to jadugaron ne Hazrat Musa Kalimullah ko dekha tha aur na hi Allah ke Rasool un ki surat se aashna thay. Rasoolullah to jadu jaante hi na thay kisi ko kya sikhate? Aqalmandi ke khilaf yeh baat keh kar phir dhamkana shuru kar diya aur apni zalimana raush par utar aaya kehne laga main tumhare sab ke haath paon ulti taraf se kaat doonga aur tumhein tunday munday bana kar phir suli doonga kisi aur ek ko bhi is saza se na chhoroonga. Sab ne muttafiqa taur par jawab diya ke raja ji is mein harj hi kya hai? Jo tum se ho sake kar guzro. Hamein mutlaq parwah nahin hamein to Allah ki taraf laut kar jaana hai hamein usi se sila lena hai jitni takleef tu hamein de ga utna ajr-o-sawab hamara Rab hamein ata farmaye ga. Haq par musibat sehna bilkul mamooli baat hai jis ka hamein mutlaq khauf nahin. Hamari to ab yahi ek aarzoo hai ke hamara Rab hamare agle gunahon par hamari pakar na kare jo muqabla tu ne hum se karwaya hai. Is ka wabaal hum par se hat jaye aur is ke liye hamare paas siwaye is ke koi waseela nahin ke hum sab se pehle Allah wale ban jayen iman mein sabqat karein. Is jawab par woh aur bhi bigra aur un sab ko us ne qatl kara diya. (R.A) Ajma'een.

Firauniyon ka anjam. Musa A.S ne apni nabuwat ka bahut sara zamana in mein guzara. Allah ki aayatein in par wazeh kar dein lekin un ka sar neecha na hua, un ka takabbur na toota, un ki bad-dimaghi mein koi farq na aaya. To ab siwa is ke ke koi cheez baqi na rahi ke in par azab-e-Ilahi aa jaye aur yeh gharat hon. Musa A.S ko Allah ki wahi aayi ke raton-raat Bani Israelion ko le kar mere hukm ke mutabiq chal do. Bani Israel ne is mauqe par Qibtiyon se bahut se zevar bator-e-aariyat ke liye aur chand charhne ke waqt chup-chap chal diye. Mujahid R.H farmate hain ke us raat chand gehan tha. Hazrat Musa A.S ne raste mein daryaft farmaya ke Hazrat Yusuf A.S ki qabr kahan hai? Bani Israel ki ek burhiya ne qabr batla di. Aap ne taboot-e-Yusuf apne sath utha liya. Kaha gaya ke khud aap ne hi ise uthaya tha. Hazrat Yusuf A.S ki wasiyat thi ke Bani Israel jab yahan se jane lagen to aap ka taboot apne hamrah lete jayen. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek hadith mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ kisi Aarabi ke yahan mehman hue, us ne aap ki bari khatir-tawazo ki. Wapsi mein aap ne farmaya kabhi hum se Madine mein bhi mil lena. Kuch dinon baad Aarabi aap ke paas aaya. Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya kuch chahiye? Us ne kaha han, ek to oontni dijiye ma'a haudaj ke aur ek bakri dijiye jo doodh deti ho. Aap ne farmaya afsos! Tu ne Bani Israel ki burhiya jaisa sawal na kiya. Sahaba R.A ne poocha, woh waqiya kya hai? Aap ne farmaya jab Hazrat Kaleemullah Bani Israel ko le kar chale to rasta bhool gaye, hazar koshish ki lekin raah nahin milti. Aap ne logon ko jama kar ke poocha yeh kya andher hai? To ulma-e-Bani Israel ne kaha baat yeh hai ke Hazrat Yusuf A.S ne apne aakhri waqt hum se ahd liya tha ke jab hum Misr se chalen to aap ke taboot ko bhi yahan se apne sath lete jayen. Hazrat Musa Kaleemullah ne daryaft farmaya ke tum mein se kaun janta hai ke Yusuf A.S ki turbat kahan hai? Sab ne inkar kar diya, hum nahin jante, hum mein siwaye ek burhiya ke aur koi bhi aap ki qabr se waqif nahin. Aap ne us burhiya ke paas aadmi bhej kar us se kehwaya ke mujhe Hazrat Yusuf A.S ki qabr dikha. Burhiya ne kaha han dikhaungi lekin pehle apne haq le loon. Hazrat Musa A.S ne kaha tu kya chahti hai? Us ne jawab diya ke Jannat mein aap ka sath mujhe mayassar ho. Aap par us ka yeh sawal bhari para, usi waqt wahi aayi ke is ki baat maan lo aur is ki shart manzoor kar lo. Ab woh aap ko ek jheel ke paas le gayi jis ke pani ka rang bhi mutaghayyar ho gaya tha, kaha ke is ka pani nikal dalo. Jab pani nikal dala aur zameen nazar aane lagi to kaha ab yahan khodo. Khodna shuru hua to qabr zahir ho gayi, ise sath rakh liya. Ab jo chalne lage to rasta saaf nazar aane laga aur seedhi raah lag gaye. Lekin yeh hadith bahut hi ghareeb hai, balkay zyada qareeb to yeh hai ke yeh mauqoof hai yani Rasool Allah ﷺ ka farman nahin. Wallahu A'lam.

Yeh log toh apne raaste lag gaye, idhar Firaun aur Firauniyon ki subah ke waqt jo aankh khulti hai toh chowkidar ghulam waghera koi nahin. Sakht pech-o-taab khane lage aur maare gusse ke surkh ho gaye. Jab yeh maloom hua ke Bani Israel raat ko sab ke sab farar ho gaye hain toh aur bhi sannata chha gaya. Isi waqt apne lashkar jama karne laga. Sab ko jama karke un se kehne laga ke yeh Bani Israel ka ek chhota sa giroh hai, mehez zaleel kameen aur qaleel log hain, har waqt in se hamein koft hoti rehti hai, takleef pahunchti rehti hai. Aur phir har waqt hamein in ki taraf se daghdagha hi laga rehta hai, yeh maani 'Haaziroon' ki qiraat par hain, salaf ki ek jamaat ne ise 'Haziroon' bhi padha hai yani hum hathiyar band hain. Main irada kar chuka hoon ke ab inhe in ki sarkashi ka maza chakha doon. In sab ko ek saath gher-ghaar kar gajar-mooli ki tarah kaat daal doon. Allah ki shaan, yahi baat isi par laut padi aur woh ma'a apni qaum aur lao-lashkar ke ek waqt halak hua. La'natullahi alaihi wa ala man tabi'ahu. Janab-e-Bari ka irshad hai ke yeh log apni taqat aur aksariyat ke ghamand par Bani Israel ke ta'aqub mein inhe neest-o-nabood karne ke irade se nikal khade hue. Is bahane hum ne inhe un ke baghaat, chashmon, nehron, khazanon aur baronaq makanon se kharij kiya aur jahannam wasil kiya. Woh apne buland-o-bala shaukat-o-shaan wale mehalat, hare bhare baghaat, jaari nehrein, khazane, saltanat, mulk, takht-o-taaj, jaah-o-maal sab chhod kar Bani Israel ke peeche Misr se nikle. Aur hum ne un ki yeh tamam cheezein Bani Israel ko dilwa dein jo aaj tak past-haal thay, zaleel-o-naadaar thay. Choonke hamara irada ho chuka tha ke hum in kamzoron ko ubharein aur in gire pade logon ko barsar-e-taraqqi layein aur inhe peshwa aur waris bana dein aur irada hum ne poora kiya.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek hadith mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ kisi Aarabi ke yahan mehman hue, us ne aap ki bari khatir-tawazo ki. Wapsi mein aap ne farmaya kabhi hum se Madine mein bhi mil lena. Kuch dinon baad Aarabi aap ke paas aaya. Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya kuch chahiye? Us ne kaha han, ek to oontni dijiye ma'a haudaj ke aur ek bakri dijiye jo doodh deti ho. Aap ne farmaya afsos! Tu ne Bani Israel ki burhiya jaisa sawal na kiya. Sahaba R.A ne poocha, woh waqiya kya hai? Aap ne farmaya jab Hazrat Kaleemullah Bani Israel ko le kar chale to rasta bhool gaye, hazar koshish ki lekin raah nahin milti. Aap ne logon ko jama kar ke poocha yeh kya andher hai? To ulma-e-Bani Israel ne kaha baat yeh hai ke Hazrat Yusuf A.S ne apne aakhri waqt hum se ahd liya tha ke jab hum Misr se chalen to aap ke taboot ko bhi yahan se apne sath lete jayen. Hazrat Musa Kaleemullah ne daryaft farmaya ke tum mein se kaun janta hai ke Yusuf A.S ki turbat kahan hai? Sab ne inkar kar diya, hum nahin jante, hum mein siwaye ek burhiya ke aur koi bhi aap ki qabr se waqif nahin. Aap ne us burhiya ke paas aadmi bhej kar us se kehwaya ke mujhe Hazrat Yusuf A.S ki qabr dikha. Burhiya ne kaha han dikhaungi lekin pehle apne haq le loon. Hazrat Musa A.S ne kaha tu kya chahti hai? Us ne jawab diya ke Jannat mein aap ka sath mujhe mayassar ho. Aap par us ka yeh sawal bhari para, usi waqt wahi aayi ke is ki baat maan lo aur is ki shart manzoor kar lo. Ab woh aap ko ek jheel ke paas le gayi jis ke pani ka rang bhi mutaghayyar ho gaya tha, kaha ke is ka pani nikal dalo. Jab pani nikal dala aur zameen nazar aane lagi to kaha ab yahan khodo. Khodna shuru hua to qabr zahir ho gayi, ise sath rakh liya. Ab jo chalne lage to rasta saaf nazar aane laga aur seedhi raah lag gaye. Lekin yeh hadith bahut hi ghareeb hai, balkay zyada qareeb to yeh hai ke yeh mauqoof hai yani Rasool Allah ﷺ ka farman nahin. Wallahu A'lam.

Yeh log toh apne raaste lag gaye, idhar Firaun aur Firauniyon ki subah ke waqt jo aankh khulti hai toh chowkidar ghulam waghera koi nahin. Sakht pech-o-taab khane lage aur maare gusse ke surkh ho gaye. Jab yeh maloom hua ke Bani Israel raat ko sab ke sab farar ho gaye hain toh aur bhi sannata chha gaya. Isi waqt apne lashkar jama karne laga. Sab ko jama karke un se kehne laga ke yeh Bani Israel ka ek chhota sa giroh hai, mehez zaleel kameen aur qaleel log hain, har waqt in se hamein koft hoti rehti hai, takleef pahunchti rehti hai. Aur phir har waqt hamein in ki taraf se daghdagha hi laga rehta hai, yeh maani 'Haaziroon' ki qiraat par hain, salaf ki ek jamaat ne ise 'Haziroon' bhi padha hai yani hum hathiyar band hain. Main irada kar chuka hoon ke ab inhe in ki sarkashi ka maza chakha doon. In sab ko ek saath gher-ghaar kar gajar-mooli ki tarah kaat daal doon. Allah ki shaan, yahi baat isi par laut padi aur woh ma'a apni qaum aur lao-lashkar ke ek waqt halak hua. La'natullahi alaihi wa ala man tabi'ahu. Janab-e-Bari ka irshad hai ke yeh log apni taqat aur aksariyat ke ghamand par Bani Israel ke ta'aqub mein inhe neest-o-nabood karne ke irade se nikal khade hue. Is bahane hum ne inhe un ke baghaat, chashmon, nehron, khazanon aur baronaq makanon se kharij kiya aur jahannam wasil kiya. Woh apne buland-o-bala shaukat-o-shaan wale mehalat, hare bhare baghaat, jaari nehrein, khazane, saltanat, mulk, takht-o-taaj, jaah-o-maal sab chhod kar Bani Israel ke peeche Misr se nikle. Aur hum ne un ki yeh tamam cheezein Bani Israel ko dilwa dein jo aaj tak past-haal thay, zaleel-o-naadaar thay. Choonke hamara irada ho chuka tha ke hum in kamzoron ko ubharein aur in gire pade logon ko barsar-e-taraqqi layein aur inhe peshwa aur waris bana dein aur irada hum ne poora kiya.

Allah ki aayatein in par wazeh kar dein lekin un ka sar neecha na hua, un ka takabbur na toota, un ki bad-dimaghi mein koi farq na aaya. Firaun aur uska lashkar gharq-e-darya ho gaya. Firaun apne tamam lao-lashkar aur tamam ri'aya ko, Misr aur berun ke logon ko, apne walon ko aur apni qaum ke logon ko lekar bari tamtaraq aur thaath se Bani Israel ko tehas-nehas karne ke irade se chala. Baaz kehte hain unki tadaad lakhon se tajawuz kar gayi thi. In mein se ek lakh toh sirf siyah rang ke ghoron par sawar thay lekin yeh khabar Ahl-e-Kitab ki hai jo ta'ammul talab hai. Ka'ab se toh marwi hai ke aath lakh toh aise ghoron par sawar thay. Hamara toh khayal hai ke yeh sab Bani Israel ki mubaligha-amez riwayatein hain. Itna toh Quran se sabit hai ke Firaun apni kul jama'at ko lekar chala magar Quran ne unki tadaad bayan nahin farmayi, na iska ilm hamein kuch nafa dene wala hai. Tulu-e-aftab ke waqt yeh unke paas pahunch gaya. Kafiron ne mominon aur mominon ne kafiron ko dekh liya. Hazrat Musa A.S ke sathiyon ke munh se besakhta nikal gaya ke Musa ab batao kya karein? Pakar liye gaye, aage Bahr-e-Qulzum hai, peeche Firaun ka tiddi-dal lashkar hai. Na jaye mandan na paye raftan. Zahir hai ke Nabi aur ghair-Nabi ka iman yaksan nahin hota. Hazrat Musa A.S nihayat thande dil se jawab dete hain ke ghabrao nahin, tumhein koi eza nahin pahuncha sakti, main apni raye se tumhein lekar nahin nikla balkay Ahkam-ul-Hakimeen ke hukm se tumhein lekar chala hoon. Woh wa'ada khilaf nahin hai. Unke agle hissay par Hazrat Haroon A.S thay, unhi ke sath Hazrat Yusha bin Noon thay, yeh Aal-e-Firaun ka momin shakhs tha. Aur Hazrat Musa A.S lashkar ke agle hissay mein thay. Ghabrahat ke maaray aur raah na milne ki wajah se saaray Bani Israel hakka-bakka ho kar thehar gaye aur iztirab ke sath Janab-e-Kaleemullah se daryaft farmane lage ke isi raah par chalne ka Allah ka hukm tha? Aap ne farmaya haan. Itni der mein toh Firaun ka lashkar sar par aa pahuncha. Isi waqt Parwardigar ki wahi aayi ke ae Nabi! Is darya par apni lakri maaro aur phir meri qudrat ka karishma dekho. Aap ne lakri maari jiske lagte hi ba-hukm-e-Allah pani phat gaya. Is pareshani ke waqt Hazrat Musa A.S ne jo dua mangi thi, woh Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein in alfaaz se marwi hai: Dua (Ya man kana qabla kulli shai-in, al-mukawwinu li-kulli shai-in, wal-ka'inu ba'da kulli shai-in, ij'al lana makhraja). Yeh dua Hazrat Musa A.S ke munh se nikli hi thi ke Allah ki wahi aayi ke darya par apni lakri maaro. Hazrat Qatada R.A farmate hain is raat Allah Ta'ala ne darya ki taraf pehle hi se wahi bhej di thi ke jab mere paighambar Hazrat Musa A.S aayein aur tujhe lakri marein toh tu unki baat sunna aur manna. Pas samundar mein raat bhar talatum raha, uski maujein idhar udhar sar takrati phirein ke na maloom Hazrat A.S kab aur kidhar se aa jayein aur mujhe lakri mardein, aisa na ho ke mujhe khabar na lage aur main unke hukm ki baja-awari na kar sakoon. Jab bilkul kinare pahunch gaye toh aap ke sathi Hazrat Yusha bin Noon R.H ne farmaya ae Allah ke Nabi! Allah ka aap ko kya hukm hai? Aap ne farmaya: Yehi ke main samundar mein lakri maaroon.

Unhon ne kaha phir der kya hai? Chunancha aap ne lakri maar kar farmaya Allah Ta'ala ke hukm se tu phat aur mujhe chalne ka rasta de de. Isi waqt woh phat gaya, raste beech mein saaf nazar aane lage aur us ke aas paas pani bator-e-pahar ke khara ho gaya. Is mein barah raste nikal aaye, Bani Israel ke qabile bhi barah hi thay. Phir Qudrat-e-Ilahi se har do fareeq ke darmiyan jo pahar hail tha us mein taaq se ban gaye taake har ek dusre ko salamat-rawi se aata hua dekhe. Pani misl-e-deewaron ke ho gaya aur hawa ko hukm hua ke us ne darmiyan se pani ko aur zameen ko khushk karke raste saaf kar diye, pas us khushk raste se aap ma' apni qoum ke be-khatke jaane lage. Phir Firauniyon ko Allah Ta'ala ne darya se qareeb kar diya, phir Musa A.S aur Bani Israel aur sab ko to najaat mil gayi aur baqi sab kafiron ko hum ne dubo diya, na un mein se koi bacha, na un mein se koi dooba. Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood R.A farmate hain: Firaun ko jab Bani Israel ke bhaag jaane ki khabar mili to us ne ek bakri zibah ki aur kaha is ki khaal utarne se pehle chhe laakh ka lashkar jama ho jana chahiye. Idhar Musa A.S bhaagam bhaag darya ke kinare jab pahunch gaye to darya se farmane lage tu phat ja, kahin hat ja aur hamein jagah de de. Us ne kaha yeh kya takabbur ki baatein kar rahe ho? Kya main is se pehle bhi kabhi phata hoon? Aur hat kar kisi insaan ko jagah di hai jo tujhe doonga? Aap ke saath jo buzurg shakhs thay unhon ne kaha ae Nabi A.S kya yahi rasta aur yahi jagah Allah Ta'ala ki batlai hui hai? Aap ne farmaya haan yahi. Unhon ne kaha phir na to aap jhoote hain na aap se ghalat farmaya gaya hai. Aap ne dobara yahi kaha lekin phir bhi kuch na hua. Us buzurg shakhs ne dobara yahi sawal kiya, isi waqt wahi utri ke samundar par apni lakri maar. Ab aap ko khayal aaya aur lakri maari, lakri lagte hi samundar ne rasta de diya. Barah raahein zahir ho gayin, har firqa apne raste ko pehchan gaya aur apni raah par chal diya aur ek dusre ko dekhte hue ba-itminan-e-tamam chal diye. Hazrat Musa A.S to Bani Israel ko le kar paar nikal gaye aur Firauni un ke ta'aqub mein samundar mein aa gaye ke Allah Ta'ala ke hukm se samundar ka pani jaisa tha waisa ho gaya aur sab ko dubo diya. Jab sab se aakhri Bani Israeli nikla aur sab se aakhri Qibti samundar mein aa gaya isi waqt Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ke hukm se samundar ka pani ek ho gaya aur saare ke saare Qibti ek ek karke dubo diye gaye. Is mein bari ibrat-naak nishani hai ke kis tarah gunahgar barbad hote hain aur nek kirdar shaad hote hain lekin phir bhi aksar log imaan jaisi daulat se mehroom hain. Beshak tera Rab Aziz-o-Raheem hai.

Baaz kehte hain unki tadaad lakhon se tajawuz kar gayi thi. In mein se ek lakh toh sirf siyah rang ke ghoron par sawar thay lekin yeh khabar Ahl-e-Kitab ki hai jo ta'ammul talab hai. Ka'ab se toh marwi hai ke aath lakh toh aise ghoron par sawar thay. Hamara toh khayal hai ke yeh sab Bani Israel ki mubaligha-amez riwayatein hain. Itna toh Quran se sabit hai ke Firaun apni kul jama'at ko lekar chala magar Quran ne unki tadaad bayan nahin farmayi, na iska ilm hamein kuch nafa dene wala hai. Tulu-e-aftab ke waqt yeh unke paas pahunch gaya. Kafiron ne mominon aur mominon ne kafiron ko dekh liya. Hazrat Musa A.S ke sathiyon ke munh se besakhta nikal gaya ke Musa ab batao kya karein? Pakar liye gaye, aage Bahr-e-Qulzum hai, peeche Firaun ka tiddi-dal lashkar hai. Na jaye mandan na paye raftan. Zahir hai ke Nabi aur ghair-Nabi ka iman yaksan nahin hota. Hazrat Musa A.S nihayat thande dil se jawab dete hain ke ghabrao nahin, tumhein koi eza nahin pahuncha sakti, main apni raye se tumhein lekar nahin nikla balkay Ahkam-ul-Hakimeen ke hukm se tumhein lekar chala hoon. Woh wa'ada khilaf nahin hai. Unke agle hissay par Hazrat Haroon A.S thay, unhi ke sath Hazrat Yusha bin Noon thay, yeh Aal-e-Firaun ka momin shakhs tha. Aur Hazrat Musa A.S lashkar ke agle hissay mein thay. Ghabrahat ke maaray aur raah na milne ki wajah se saaray Bani Israel hakka-bakka ho kar thehar gaye aur iztirab ke sath Janab-e-Kaleemullah se daryaft farmane lage ke isi raah par chalne ka Allah ka hukm tha? Aap ne farmaya haan. Itni der mein toh Firaun ka lashkar sar par aa pahuncha. Isi waqt Parwardigar ki wahi aayi ke ae Nabi! Is darya par apni lakri maaro aur phir meri qudrat ka karishma dekho. Aap ne lakri maari jiske lagte hi ba-hukm-e-Allah pani phat gaya. Is pareshani ke waqt Hazrat Musa A.S ne jo dua mangi thi, woh Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein in alfaaz se marwi hai: Dua (Ya man kana qabla kulli shai-in, al-mukawwinu li-kulli shai-in, wal-ka'inu ba'da kulli shai-in, ij'al lana makhraja). Yeh dua Hazrat Musa A.S ke munh se nikli hi thi ke Allah ki wahi aayi ke darya par apni lakri maaro. Hazrat Qatada R.A farmate hain is raat Allah Ta'ala ne darya ki taraf pehle hi se wahi bhej di thi ke jab mere paighambar Hazrat Musa A.S aayein aur tujhe lakri marein toh tu unki baat sunna aur manna. Pas samundar mein raat bhar talatum raha, uski maujein idhar udhar sar takrati phirein ke na maloom Hazrat A.S kab aur kidhar se aa jayein aur mujhe lakri mardein, aisa na ho ke mujhe khabar na lage aur main unke hukm ki baja-awari na kar sakoon. Jab bilkul kinare pahunch gaye toh aap ke sathi Hazrat Yusha bin Noon R.H ne farmaya ae Allah ke Nabi! Allah ka aap ko kya hukm hai? Aap ne farmaya: Yehi ke main samundar mein lakri maaroon.

Phir Qudrat-e-Ilahi se har do fareeq ke darmiyan jo pahar hail tha us mein taaq se ban gaye taake har ek dusre ko salamat-rawi se aata hua dekhe. Phir Qudrat-e-Ilahi se har do fareeq ke darmiyan jo pahar hail tha us mein taaq se ban gaye taake har ek dusre ko salamat-rawi se aata hua dekhe. Barah raahein zahir ho gayin, har firqa apne raste ko pehchan gaya aur apni raah par chal diya aur ek dusre ko dekhte hue ba-itminan-e-tamam chal diye. Hazrat Musa A.S to Bani Israel ko le kar paar nikal gaye aur Firauni un ke ta'aqub mein samundar mein aa gaye ke Allah Ta'ala ke hukm se samundar ka pani jaisa tha waisa ho gaya aur sab ko dubo diya. Jab sab se aakhri Bani Israeli nikla aur sab se aakhri Qibti samundar mein aa gaya isi waqt Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ke hukm se samundar ka pani ek ho gaya aur saare ke saare Qibti ek ek karke dubo diye gaye. Is mein bari ibrat-naak nishani hai ke kis tarah gunahgar barbad hote hain aur nek kirdar shaad hote hain lekin phir bhi aksar log imaan jaisi daulat se mehroom hain. Beshak tera Rab Aziz-o-Raheem hai.

Ibrahim A.S alamat-e-tauhidi parasti, tamam muwahhidon ke baap, Allah ke bande aur Rasool aur Khalil Hazrat Ibrahim Alaihis Afzalut-Tahiyyati wat-Tasleem ka waqia bayan ho raha hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum ho raha hai ke aap apni ummat ko yeh waqia sunadein, taake woh ikhlas, tawakkul aur Allah-e-Wahid ki ibadat aur shirk aur mushrikeen se bezari mein aap ki iqtida karein. Aap awwal din se Allah ki tauheed par qaim thay aur aakhir din tak isi tauheed par jame rahe. Apni qoum se aur apne baap se farmaya ke yeh but-parasti kya kar rahe ho? Unhon ne jawab diya ke hum toh purane waqt se in buton ki mujawari aur ibadat karte chale aate hain. Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ne unki is ghalti ko un par wazeh karke un ki ghalat raush benaqab karne ke liye ek baat aur bhi bayan farmayi ke tum jo in se duayein karte ho aur door nazdeek se inhe pukarte ho toh kya yeh tumhari pukar sunte hain? Ya jis nafa ke hasil karne ke liye tum inhe bulate ho woh nafa tumhe woh pahuncha sakte hain? Ya agar tum inki ibadat chhod do toh kya woh tumhe nuqsan pahuncha sakte hain? Is ka jawab jo qoum ki janib se mila woh saaf zahir hai ke unke mabood in kamon mein se kisi kaam ko nahin kar sakte. Unhon ne saaf kaha ke hum toh apne badon ki wajah se but-parasti par jame hue hain. Is ke jawab mein Hazrat Khalilullah A.S ne un se aur un ke maboodan-e-batila se apni bara'at aur bezari ka elaan kardiya. Saaf farmadiya ke tum aur tumhare mabood se mein bezar hoon, jin ki tum aur tumhare baap dada parastish karte rahe, un sab se mein bezar hoon, woh sab mere dushman hain, mein sirf sachche Rabbul-Alameen ka parastar hoon. Mein muwahhid mukhlis hoon. Jao tum se aur tumhare maboodon se jo ho sake karlo. Hazrat Nooh Nabi A.S ne bhi apni qoum se yahi farmaya tha, tum aur tumhare saare mabood mil kar agar mera kuch bigad sakte ho toh kami na karo. Hazrat Hood A.S ne bhi farmaya tha mein tum se aur tumhare Allah ke siwa baqi maboodon se bezar hoon, tum sab agar mujhe nuqsan pahuncha sakte ho toh jao pahunchalo. Mera bharosa apne Rabb ki zaat par hai, tamam jaandar uske matahat hain, woh seedhi raah wala hai. Isi tarah Khalilur-Rahman Alaihis Salawat-ur-Rahman ne farmaya ke mein tumhare maboodon se bilkul nahin darta. Dar toh tumhe mere Rabb se rakhna chahiye, jo sachcha hai. Aap ne elaan kardiya tha ke jab tak tum ek Allah par imaan na lao mujh mein tum mein adawat hai. Mein ae baap tujh se aur teri qoum se aur tere maboodon se bari hoon. Sirf apne Rabb se meri aarzoo hai ke woh mujhe raah-e-raast dikhlaye, isi ko yani La Ilaha Illallah ko unhon ne kalma banaliya.

Ya jis nafa ke hasil karne ke liye tum inhe bulate ho woh nafa tumhe woh pahuncha sakte hain? Ya agar tum inki ibadat chhod do toh kya woh tumhe nuqsan pahuncha sakte hain? Is ka jawab jo qoum ki janib se mila woh saaf zahir hai ke unke mabood in kamon mein se kisi kaam ko nahin kar sakte. Unhon ne saaf kaha ke hum toh apne badon ki wajah se but-parasti par jame hue hain. Is ke jawab mein Hazrat Khalilullah A.S ne un se aur un ke maboodan-e-batila se apni bara'at aur bezari ka elaan kardiya. Saaf farmadiya ke tum aur tumhare mabood se mein bezar hoon, jin ki tum aur tumhare baap dada parastish karte rahe, un sab se mein bezar hoon, woh sab mere dushman hain, mein sirf sachche Rabbul-Alameen ka parastar hoon. Mein muwahhid mukhlis hoon. Jao tum se aur tumhare maboodon se jo ho sake karlo. Hazrat Nooh Nabi A.S ne bhi apni qoum se yahi farmaya tha, tum aur tumhare saare mabood mil kar agar mera kuch bigad sakte ho toh kami na karo. Hazrat Hood A.S ne bhi farmaya tha mein tum se aur tumhare Allah ke siwa baqi maboodon se bezar hoon, tum sab agar mujhe nuqsan pahuncha sakte ho toh jao pahunchalo. Sirf apne Rabb se meri aarzoo hai ke woh mujhe raah-e-raast dikhlaye, isi ko yani La Ilaha Illallah ko unhon ne kalma banaliya.

Khalilullah ki tareef: Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) apne Rabb ki sifatein bayan farmate hain ke main toh in ausaf wale Rabb ka hi aabid hoon. Uske siwa aur kisi ki ibadat nahin karunga. Pehla wasf yeh ke woh mera Khaliq hai, usi ne andaza muqarrar kiya hai aur wahi makhluqat ki uski taraf rehbari karta hai. Dusra wasf yeh ke woh Hadi-e-Haqiqi hai, jise chahta hai apni rah-e-mustaqeem par chalata hai, jise chahta hai use ghalat rah par laga deta hai. Teesra wasf mere Rabb ka yeh hai ke woh Raziq hai, aasman-o-zameen ke tamam asbab usi ne muhayya kiye hain. Badalon ka uthana, phailana, un se barish ka barsana, us se zameen ko zinda karna, phir paidawar ugana usi ka kaam hai. Wahi meetha aur pyas bujhane wala pani hamein deta hai aur apni makhluq ko bhi, gharz khilane pilane wala wahi hai. Saath hi bimari-o-tandurusti bhi usi ke haath hai, lekin Khalilullah (A.S) ka kamal-e-adab dekhiye ke bimari ki nisbat toh apni taraf ki aur shifa ki nisbat Allah Ta'ala ki taraf hai. Go bimari bhi usi ki qaza-o-qadar hai aur usi ki banayi hui cheez hai. Yehi latafat Surah Fatiha ki dua mein bhi hai ke inaam-o-hidayat ki asnad toh Allah-e-Aalam ki taraf ki hai aur ghazab ke fa'il ko hazf kar diya hai aur zalalat bande ki taraf mansoob kar di hai. Surah Jinn mein jinnaat ka qaul bhi mulahiza ho jahan unhon ne kaha hai ke hamein nahin maloom ke zameen wali makhluq ke saath kisi burai ka irada kiya gaya hai ya un ke saath un ke Rabb ne bhalai ka irada kiya hai? Yahan bhi bhalai ki nisbat Rabb ki taraf ki gayi aur burai ke irade mein nisbat zahir nahin ki gayi. Isi tarah ki aayat hai ke jab main bimar padta hoon toh meri shifa par bajuz is Allah ke aur koi qadir nahin. Dawa mein taseer paida karna bhi usi ke bas ki cheez hai. Maut-o-hayat par qadir bhi wahi hai. Ibtida usi ke saath hai, usi ne pehli paidaish ki hai. Wahi dobara lautayega. Duniya aur aakhirat mein gunahon ki bakhshish par bhi wahi qadir hai, woh jo chahta hai karta hai, Ghafoor-o-Raheem wahi hai.

Hukm se kya murad hai? Hukm se murad ilm, aql, uluhiyat, kitab aur nabuwat hai. Aap Allah Ta'ala se dua karte hain ke mujhe yeh cheezein ata farma kar duniya aur aakhirat mein nek logon mein shamil rakh. Chunancha sahih hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne bhi aakhri waqt mein dua mangi thi ke ae Allah aala rafeeqon mein mila de, teen baar yahi dua ki. Ek hadith mein Huzoor (ﷺ) ki yeh dua bhi marwi hai: (Allahumma ahyina muslimeen wa amitna muslimeen walhiqna bissaliheen ghaira khazaaya wa la mubaddileen). Ya'ni ae Allah! Hamein Islam par zinda rakh aur musalmani ki halat mein hi maut de aur nekon mein mila de. Dar-aan-haale-ke na ruswai ho na tabdeeli. Phir aur dua karte hain ke mere baad bhi mera zikr-e-khair logon mein jaari rahe. Log nek baaton mein meri iqtida karte rahein. Allah Ta'ala ne bhi unka zikr pichli naslon mein baqi rakha. Har ek aap par salam bhejta hai, Allah kisi nek bande ki neki akaarat nahin karta. Ek jahan hai jin ki zabanen aap ki tareef-o-tauseef se tar hain. Duniya mein bhi Allah ne unhein unchai aur bhalai di. Umooman har mazhab-o-millat ke log Khalilullah (A.S) se mohabbat rakhte hain. Aur dua karte hain ke mera zikr-e-jameel jahan mein baqi rahe, wahan aakhirat mein bhi jannati banaya jaaun. Aur ae Allah mere gumrah baap ko maaf farma. Lekin apne kafir baap ke liye yeh istighfar karna ek wade par tha, jab aap par uska dushman-e-Allah hona khul gaya ke woh kufr par hi mara to aap ke dil se uski izzat-o-mohabbat jati rahi aur istighfar karna bhi tark kar diya. Ibrahim (A.S) bade saaf dil aur bardbar the. Hamein bhi jahan Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki raush par chalne ka hukm mila hai wahin yeh bhi farma diya gaya hai ke is baat mein unki pairwi na karna. Phir dua karte hain ke mujhe Qayamat ke din ki ruswai se bacha lena. Jab ke tamam agli pichli makhlooq zinda ho kar ek maidan mein khadi hogi. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke Qayamat ke din Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki apne walid se mulaqat hogi. Aap dekhenge ke uska munh zillat se aur gard-o-ghubar se aalooda ho raha hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke us waqt aap janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein arz karenge ke Parwardigar tera mujh se qaul hai ke mujhe Qayamat ke din ruswa na karega. Allah farmayega sun le jannat to kafir par qatan haram hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Ibrahim (A.S) apne baap ko is halat mein dekh kar farmayenge ke dekh main tujhe nahin keh raha tha ke meri nafarmani na kar, baap jawab dega ke achha ab na karunga. Aap Allah Ta'ala ki janab mein arz karenge ke Parwardigar tu ne mujh se wada kiya hai ke is din mujhe ruswa na farmayega. Ab is se badh kar aur ruswai kya hogi ke mera baap is tarah rahmat se door hai. Allah Ta'ala farmayega ke mere Khalil (A.S) main ne jannat ko kafiron par haram kar diya hai, phir farmayega Ibrahim dekh tere pairon tale kya hai?

Aap dekhenge ke ek bad-surat bichhu keechad-o-pani mein lithda khada hai jis ke paon pakad kar jahannam mein phenk diya jayega. Haqiqatan yeh un ke walid honge jo is surat mein kar diye gaye aur apni muqarrara jagah pahuncha diye gaye. Is din insaan agar apna fidiya maal se ada karna chahe go duniya bhar ke khazane de de lekin besood hai, na is din aulad fayda degi. Tamam ahl-e-zameen ko apne badle mein dena chahe phir bhi la-hasil. Is din nafa dene wali cheez imaan, ikhlas aur shirk aur ahl-e-shirk se bezari hai. Jis ka dil saleh ho yani shirk-o-kufr ke mail-kuchail se saaf ho, Allah Ta'ala ko sacha janta ho, qayamat ko yaqini manta ho, dobara ke jee uthne par imaan rakhta ho, Allah Ta'ala ki tauheed ka qail aur aamil ho. Nifaq waghera se dil mareez na ho. Balkeh imaan-o-ikhlas aur nek aqide se dil sahih aur tandurust ho. Bid'aton se nafrat rakhta ho aur sunnat se itminan aur ulfat rakhta ho.

Aur riwayat mein hai ke us waqt aap janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein arz karenge ke Parwardigar tera mujh se qaul hai ke mujhe Qayamat ke din ruswa na karega. Allah farmayega sun le jannat to kafir par qatan haram hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Ibrahim (A.S) apne baap ko is halat mein dekh kar farmayenge ke dekh main tujhe nahin keh raha tha ke meri nafarmani na kar, baap jawab dega ke achha ab na karunga. Aap Allah Ta'ala ki janab mein arz karenge ke Parwardigar tu ne mujh se wada kiya hai ke is din mujhe ruswa na farmayega. Ab is se badh kar aur ruswai kya hogi ke mera baap is tarah rahmat se door hai. Allah Ta'ala farmayega ke mere Khalil (A.S) main ne jannat ko kafiron par haram kar diya hai, phir farmayega Ibrahim dekh tere pairon tale kya hai?

Aap dekhenge ke ek bad-surat bichhu keechad-o-pani mein lithda khada hai jis ke paon pakad kar jahannam mein phenk diya jayega. Haqiqatan yeh un ke walid honge jo is surat mein kar diye gaye aur apni muqarrara jagah pahuncha diye gaye. Is din insaan agar apna fidiya maal se ada karna chahe go duniya bhar ke khazane de de lekin besood hai, na is din aulad fayda degi. Tamam ahl-e-zameen ko apne badle mein dena chahe phir bhi la-hasil. Is din nafa dene wali cheez imaan, ikhlas aur shirk aur ahl-e-shirk se bezari hai. Jis ka dil saleh ho yani shirk-o-kufr ke mail-kuchail se saaf ho, Allah Ta'ala ko sacha janta ho, qayamat ko yaqini manta ho, dobara ke jee uthne par imaan rakhta ho, Allah Ta'ala ki tauheed ka qail aur aamil ho. Nifaq waghera se dil mareez na ho. Balkeh imaan-o-ikhlas aur nek aqide se dil sahih aur tandurust ho. Bid'aton se nafrat rakhta ho aur sunnat se itminan aur ulfat rakhta ho.

Nek log aur Jannat: Jin logon ne nekiyan ki thin, buraiyon se bache thay, Jannat us din un ke paas hi, un ke samne hi zeb-o-zeenat ke sath maujood hogi. Aur sarkashon ke liye isi tarah Jahannam zahir hogi, us mein se ek gardan nikal khadi hogi jo gunahgaron ki taraf ghazabnak teyuron se nazar dale gi aur is tarah shor machaye gi ke dil ud jayenge aur mushrikon se daant-dupat ke sath farmaya jayega ke tumhare maboodan-e-batil jinhein tum Allah ke siwa poojte thay kahan hain? Kya woh tumhari kuch madad karte hain? Ya khud apni madad kar sakte hain? Nahin, nahin, balkay aabid-o-mabood sab dozakh mein ulte latak rahe hain aur jal-bhun rahe hain. Tabe-o-matboo sab oopar-tale Jahannam mein jhonk diye jayenge, sath hi Iblees ke kul lashkari bhi, awwal se le kar aakhir tak. Wahan sufle log bade logon se jhagdenge aur kahenge ke hum ne zindagi bhar tumhari mani. Aaj tum hamein azabon se kyun nahin chhudate? Sach toh yeh hai ke hum hi bilkul gumrah thay, rah se door ho gaye thay ke tumhare ahkaam ko Allah ke ahkaam ke misl samajh baithe thay aur Rabb-ul-Aalameen ke sath hi tumhari bhi ibadat karte rahe, goya ke tumhein Rabb ke barabar samjhe hue thay. Afsos, hamein is ghalat aur khatarnak rah par mujrimon ne lagaye rakha. Ab toh hamara koi sifarishi bhi nahin raha. Aapas mein poochenge ke kya koi hamara shafee hai jo hamari shafa'at kare? Ya aisa bhi ho sakta hai ke hum dobara duniya ki taraf lautaye jayen aur wahan ja kar ab tak kiye hue a'maal ke khilaf amal karein? Jahan hamara koi sifarishi hamein nazar nahin aata, wahan koi qareebi sacha dost bhi nahin dikhai deta ke wohi hamari hamdardi-o-gham-khwari kare, kyunke woh jante hain ke agar kisi saleh shakhs se hamari dosti hoti toh woh aaj zaroor hamein nafa deta aur agar koi hamara dili muhib hota toh woh zaroor hamari shafa'at ke liye aage badhta aur agar hamein phir se duniya mein jana milta toh hum aap apne in bad-a'maal ka tadaruk kar lete, apne Rabb ki hi mante aur usi ki ibadatein karte. Lekin haq toh yeh hai ke yeh badbakht azali agar dobara bhi laye jayen toh wohi bad-a'maliyan phir se shuru kar dein. Surah Sad mein bhi in dozakhiyon ke jhagde ka bayan kar ke Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya hai ke un ka yeh jhagda yaqeenan hoga. Ibrahim (A.S) ne apni qoum se jo kuch farmaya aur jo daleelein unhein dein aur un par tauheed ki wazahat ki, us mein yaqeenan Allah ki uluhiyat par aur us ki yaktai par saaf burhan maujood hai, lekin phir bhi aksar log imaan se mehroom hain. Is mein bhi koi shak nahin ke tera palanhar Parwardigar poore ghalbe aur quwwat wala, sath hi bakhshish-o-rahm wala hai.

Ya aisa bhi ho sakta hai ke hum dobara duniya ki taraf lautaye jayen aur wahan ja kar ab tak kiye hue a'maal ke khilaf amal karein? Jahan hamara koi sifarishi hamein nazar nahin aata, wahan koi qareebi sacha dost bhi nahin dikhai deta ke wohi hamari hamdardi-o-gham-khwari kare, kyunke woh jante hain ke agar kisi saleh shakhs se hamari dosti hoti toh woh aaj zaroor hamein nafa deta aur agar koi hamara dili muhib hota toh woh zaroor hamari shafa'at ke liye aage badhta aur agar hamein phir se duniya mein jana milta toh hum aap apne in bad-a'maal ka tadaruk kar lete, apne Rabb ki hi mante aur usi ki ibadatein karte. Lekin haq toh yeh hai ke yeh badbakht azali agar dobara bhi laye jayen toh wohi bad-a'maliyan phir se shuru kar dein. Surah Sad mein bhi in dozakhiyon ke jhagde ka bayan kar ke Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya hai ke un ka yeh jhagda yaqeenan hoga. Ibrahim (A.S) ne apni qoum se jo kuch farmaya aur jo daleelein unhein dein aur un par tauheed ki wazahat ki, us mein yaqeenan Allah ki uluhiyat par aur us ki yaktai par saaf burhan maujood hai, lekin phir bhi aksar log imaan se mehroom hain. Is mein bhi koi shak nahin ke tera palanhar Parwardigar poore ghalbe aur quwwat wala, sath hi bakhshish-o-rahm wala hai.

But-parasti ka aaghaz: Zameen par sab se pehle jo but-parasti shuru hui aur log shaitani raahon par chalne lage toh Allah Ta'ala ne apne Ulul-Azm rasoolon ke silsile ko Hazrat Nuh (A.S) se shuru kiya jinhon ne aakar logon ko Allah ke azabon se daraya aur uski sazaon se unhein aagah kiya lekin woh apne napak kartooton se baaz na aaye, ghair-Allah ki ibadat na chhori, balkeh Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ko jhoota kaha, unke dushman ban gaye aur eeza-rasani ke darpe ho gaye. Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ka jhutlana goya tamam paighambaron se inkar karna tha, is liye aayat mein farmaya gaya ke qaum-e-Nuh ne nabiyon ko jhutlaya. Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ne pehle toh unhein Allah ka khauf karne ki nasihat ki ke tum jo ghair-Allah ki ibadat karte ho, Allah ke azab ka tumhein dar nahin? Is tarah tauheed ki taleem ke baad apni risalat ki talqeen ki aur farmaya main tumhari taraf Allah ka rasool ban kar aaya hoon aur main amanat-dar bhi hoon, uska paigham bahu-bahu wahi hai jo tumhein suna raha hoon. Pas tumhein apne dilon ko Allah ke dar se parakhna chahiye aur meri tamam baaton ko bila-choon-o-chira maan lena chahiye. Aur suno main tum se is tableegh-e-risalat par koi ujrat nahin mangta. Mera maqsad is se sirf yahi hai ke mera Rab mujhe iska badla aur sawab ata farmaye. Pas tum Allah se daro aur mera kehna mano, meri sachai meri khair-khwahi tum par khoob roshan hai. Saath hi meri diyanat-dari aur amanat-dari bhi tum par wazeh hai.

Hidayat tabaqati asabiyat se pak hai. Qaum-e-Nuh ne Allah ke Rasool ko jawab diya ke chand suflay aur chotay logon ne teri baat maani hai. Hum se yeh nahin ho sakta ke in razeelon ka sath dein aur teri maan lein. Is ke jawab mein Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya yeh mera farz nahin ke koi haq qabool karne ko aaye to main us se us ki qaum aur pesha daryaft karta phirun. Androoni halaat par ittila rakhna, hisab lena Allah ka kaam hai. Afsos tumhein itni samajh bhi nahin. Tumhari is chahat ko poora karna mere ikhtiyar se bahar hai ke main in maskeenon se apni mehfil khali karalon. Main to Allah ki taraf se ek aagah kardene wala hoon. Jo bhi maane woh mera aur jo na maane woh khud zimmedar. Shareef ho ya razeel ho, ameer ho ya ghareeb ho, jo meri maane mera hai aur main us ka hoon.

Tazkirah-e-Nuh (A.S): Lambi muddat tak Janab-e-Nuh (A.S) un mein rahe, din raat chhupe khule unhein Allah ki raah ki dawat dete rahe, lekin joon joon aap (A.S) apni neki mein barhte gaye woh apni badi mein sawaar hote gaye. Bil-aakhir zor bandhte bandhte saaf keh diya ke agar ab hamein apne deen ki dawat di toh hum tujh par pathrao kar ke teri jaan le lenge. Aap ke haath bhi Janab-e-Bari mein uth gaye, qoum ki takzeeb ki shikayat aasman ki taraf buland hui. Aur aap ne fatah ki dua ki, farmaya ke: "Aye Allah! Main maghloob aur aajiz hoon meri madad kar, mere saath mere sathiyon ko bhi bacha le." Pas Janab-e-Bari Azzawajal ne aap ki dua qabool ki. Insaanon, jaanwaron aur saamaan-e-asbaab se kacha-kach bhari hui kashti mein sawaar ho jaane ka hukum de diya. Yaqeenan yeh waqia bhi ibrat-aamoz hai lekin aksar log be-yaqeen hain. Is mein koi shak nahin ke Rabb bare ghalbe wala lekin woh meharban bhi bahut hai.

Bil-aakhir zor bandhte bandhte saaf keh diya ke agar ab hamein apne deen ki dawat di toh hum tujh par pathrao kar ke teri jaan le lenge. Aap ke haath bhi Janab-e-Bari mein uth gaye, qoum ki takzeeb ki shikayat aasman ki taraf buland hui. Aur aap ne fatah ki dua ki, farmaya ke: "Aye Allah! Main maghloob aur aajiz hoon meri madad kar, mere saath mere sathiyon ko bhi bacha le." Pas Janab-e-Bari Azzawajal ne aap ki dua qabool ki. Deal-dol diya, bari quwwat-o-taqat di, pooray maal, aulad, khet, baghaat, phal aur anaaj diya. Bakasrat daulat aur zar, bohat si nehren aur chashmay ja-ba-ja diye. Al-gharaz har tarah ki aasayish aur aasani muhayya ki, lekin Rabb ki tamam ne'maton ki na-qadri karne walon ne aur Allah ke sath shareek karne walon ne apne Nabi ko jhutlaya. Yeh inhi mein se thay. Apna be-laag hona, talib-e-dunya na hona bayan farmaya. Apne khawas ka bhi zikr kiya. Yeh jo fakhr-o-riya ke tor par apne maal barbad karte thay aur oonchay oonchay mashhoor teelon par apni quwwat ke aur maal ke izhar ke liye buland-o-bala alamatein banate thay, is fe'l-e-abas se unhein un ke Nabi Hazrat Hud A.S ne roka kyunke is mein bekar daulat ka khona, waqt ka barbad karna aur mushaqqat uthana hai jis se deen-o-dunya ka koi faida na maqsood hota hai na mutasawwar. Baray baray pukhta aur buland burj aur minar banate thay jis ke baray mein un ke Nabi ne nasihat ki ke kya tum yeh samjhay baithay ho ke yahin hamesha raho ge? Mohabbat-e-dunya ne tumhein aakhirat bhula di hai lekin yaad rakho tumhari yeh chahat be-sood hai. Dunya zail hone wali hai, tum khud fana hone wale ho. Ek qira'at mein 'ka-annakum khalidun' hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke jab musalmanon ne Ghouta mein mehalat aur baghaat ki tameer aala paimanay par zaroorat se zyada shuru kar di to Hazrat Abu Darda R.A ne masjid mein kharay ho kar farmaya ke aye Damishq ke rehne walo suno! Log sab jama ho gaye to aap ne Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana ke baad farmaya ke tumhein sharm nahin aati? Tum khayal nahin karte ke tum ne woh jama karna shuru kar diya jisay tum kha nahin sakte. Tum ne woh makanat banane shuru kar diye jo tumhare rehne sehne ke kaam nahin aate. Tum ne woh door daraz ki aarzooyen karni shuru kar dein jo poori honi muhaal hain. Kya tum bhool gaye tum se aglay logon ne bhi jama jatha kar ke sambhal sambhal kar rakha tha? Baray oonchay oonchay pukhta aur mazboot mehalat tameer kiye thay, bari bari aarzooyen bandhi thin lekin natija yeh hua ke woh dhokay mein reh gaye, un ki poonji barbad ho gayi, un ke makanat aur bastiyan ujar gayin. Aadiyon ko dekho ke Aden se le kar Oman tak un ke ghoray aur oont thay lekin aaj woh kahan hain? Hai koi aisa be-waqoof ke Qoum-e-Aad ki meeras ko do dirhamon ke badlay bhi khareeday? Un ke maal-o-makanat ka bayan farma kar un ki quwwat-o-taqat ka bayan farmaya ke baray sarkash, mutakabbir aur sakht log thay.

Nabi (Alaihis Salam) ne unhein Allah se darne aur apni itaat karne ka hukum diya ke ibadat Rabb ki karo, itaat us ke Rasool ki karo. Phir woh ne'matein yaad dilayin jo Allah ne un par in'aam ki thin jinhein woh khud jaante thay. Maslan chaupaye janwar aur aulad, baghaat aur darya. Phir apna andesha zahir kiya ke agar tum ne meri takzeeb ki aur meri mukhalifat par jame rahe to tum par azab-e-Allah baras pare ga. Laalach aur dar dono dikhaye magar besood rahein.

Ahqaf mulk-e-Yaman mein Hazar-e-Maut ke paas retli pahariyon ke qareeb hai. Un ka zamana Nuh A.S ke baad ka hai. Surah A'raf mein bhi un ka zikr guzar chuka hai ke unhein Qoum-e-Nuh ka ja-nasheen banaya gaya aur unhein bohat kuch kushadgi aur wus'at di gayi. Deal-dol diya, bari quwwat-o-taqat di, pooray maal, aulad, khet, baghaat, phal aur anaaj diya. Bakasrat daulat aur zar, bohat si nehren aur chashmay ja-ba-ja diye. Al-gharaz har tarah ki aasayish aur aasani muhayya ki, lekin Rabb ki tamam ne'maton ki na-qadri karne walon ne aur Allah ke sath shareek karne walon ne apne Nabi ko jhutlaya. Yeh inhi mein se thay. Yeh jo fakhr-o-riya ke tor par apne maal barbad karte thay aur oonchay oonchay mashhoor teelon par apni quwwat ke aur maal ke izhar ke liye buland-o-bala alamatein banate thay, is fe'l-e-abas se unhein un ke Nabi Hazrat Hud A.S ne roka kyunke is mein bekar daulat ka khona, waqt ka barbad karna aur mushaqqat uthana hai jis se deen-o-dunya ka koi faida na maqsood hota hai na mutasawwar. Tum ne woh makanat banane shuru kar diye jo tumhare rehne sehne ke kaam nahin aate. Tum ne woh door daraz ki aarzooyen karni shuru kar dein jo poori honi muhaal hain. Baray oonchay oonchay pukhta aur mazboot mehalat tameer kiye thay, bari bari aarzooyen bandhi thin lekin natija yeh hua ke woh dhokay mein reh gaye, un ki poonji barbad ho gayi, un ke makanat aur bastiyan ujar gayin. Fil-waq'a kafiron ka yahi haal hai ke unhein samjhana be-sood rehta hai. Yeh ek bohtan hai jise tu ne ghar liya hai aur kuch log apne tarafdar karliye hain. Mashhoor qurra ki bina par ma'ani yahi huye ke jis par hum hain wahi hamare purane baap dadon ka mazhab hai, hum toh unhi ki raah chalenge aur isi raush par rahenge, jiyenge phir mar jayenge jaise woh mar gaye. Go ba'az logon se yeh bhi marwi hai lekin is ke qail Bani Israel hain. Un se sun suna kar auron ne bhi yeh keh diya, haqeeqat mein is ki koi mazboot daleel nahin. Isi liye Quran ne Iram ka zikr karte hi farmaya ke aayat (لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِي الْبِلَادِ) (Surah Al-Fajr: 8). In jaisa aur koi shehron mein paida nahin kiya gaya. Dar-asal unhein hamari aayaton se inkaar tha, yeh hum pehle bayan kar chuke hain ke un par sirf bail ke nathne ke barabar hawa chhori gayi thi.

Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ) se bhi yahi farmaya, kaha in azali kuffar par aap ki nasihat mutlaq asar nahin karegi, yeh nasihat karne aur hoshiyar kardene ke baad bhi waise hi rahenge jaise pehle thay. Yeh toh qudrati taur par imaan se mehroom kardiye gaye hain. Jin par tere Rab ki baat sadiq aane wali hai unhein imaan naseeb nahin hone wala. Khuluq-ul-awwaleen ki dusri qira'at Khalq-ul-awwaleen bhi hai, yani jo baatein tu hamein kehta hai yeh toh aglon ki kahi hui hain, jaise Quraishiyon ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) se kaha tha ke aglon ki kahaniyan hain jo subh-o-sham tumhare samne parhi jati hain. Yeh ek bohtan hai jise tu ne ghar liya hai aur kuch log apne tarafdar karliye hain. Mashhoor qurra ki bina par ma'ani yahi huye ke jis par hum hain wahi hamare purane baap dadon ka mazhab hai, hum toh unhi ki raah chalenge aur isi raush par rahenge, jiyenge phir mar jayenge jaise woh mar gaye. Yeh mehez laaf hai ke phir hum Allah ke haan zinda kiye jayenge. Yeh bhi ghalat hai ke hamein azab kiya jayega. Aakhir-e-shan ki takzeeb aur mukhalifat ki wajah se unhein halak kardiya gaya. Sakht tez-o-tund aandhi un par bheji gayi aur yeh barbad kardiye gaye. Yeh Aad-e-Ula thay jinhein aayat (اِرَمَ ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ) (Surah Al-Fajr: 7) bhi kaha gaya. Yeh Iram Sam bin Nuh (A.S) ki nasl mein se thay. 'Amd mein yeh rehte thay, Iram Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ke pote ka naam hai na ke kisi shehar ka. Go ba'az logon se yeh bhi marwi hai lekin is ke qail Bani Israel hain. Un se sun suna kar auron ne bhi yeh keh diya, haqeeqat mein is ki koi mazboot daleel nahin. Isi liye Quran ne Iram ka zikr karte hi farmaya ke aayat (لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِي الْبِلَادِ) (Surah Al-Fajr: 8). In jaisa aur koi shehron mein paida nahin kiya gaya. Agar is se murad shehar-e-Iram hota toh yun farmaya jata ke is jaisa aur koi shehar banaya nahin gaya. Quran-e-Kareem ki aur aayat mein hai aayat (فَاَمَّا عَادٌ فَاسْـتَكْبَرُوْا فِي الْاَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَقَالُوْا مَنْ اَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً) (Surah Fussilat: 15). Aadiyon ne zameen mein takabbur kiya aur na'ara lagaya ke hum se barh kar quwwat wala kaun hai? Kya woh ise bhi bhool gaye un ka paida karne wala un se zyada qawi hai? Dar-asal unhein hamari aayaton se inkaar tha, yeh hum pehle bayan kar chuke hain ke un par sirf bail ke nathne ke barabar hawa chhori gayi thi.

Jis ne un ko un ke shehron ka un ke makanat ka naam-o-nishan mita diya jahan se guzar gayi safaya kar diya, shain-shain karti tamam cheezon ka satyanas karti chali thi. Tamam qoum ke sar alag ho gaye aur dhar alag ho gaye. Azab-e-Ilahi ko hawa ki surat aata dekh kar qilon mein, mehalat mein, mehfooz makanat mein ghus gaye thay. Zameen mein garhay khod-khod kar aadhe-aadhe jism un mein daal kar mehfooz huye thay lekin bhala azab-e-Allah ko koi cheez rok sakti hai? Woh ek minute ke liye bhi kisi ko mohlat aur dam lene deta hai? Sab chat-pat kar diye gaye aur is waqiye ko baad mein aane walon ke liye nishan-e-ibrat bana diya gaya. Un mein se phir bhi aksar log be-imaan hi rahe, Allah ka ghalba aur rahm dono musallam thay.

Saleh A.S aur Qaum-e-Samood: Allah Ta'ala ke banday aur Rasool Hazrat Saleh A.S ka waqea bayan ho raha hai ke aap apni qaum Samood ki taraf Rasool bana kar bhejay gaye thay. Yeh log Arab ke Hijr naami shehar mein rehtay thay jo Wadi-ul-Qura aur Mulk-e-Sham ke darmiyan hai. Yeh Aadiyon ke baad aur Ibrahimiyon se pehlay thay. Sham ki taraf jatay huay aap ka is jagah se guzarnay ka bayan Surah Al-A'raf ki tafsir mein pehlay guzar chuka hai. Inhein un ke Nabi ne Allah ki taraf bulaya ke yeh Allah ki tawheed ko maanein aur Hazrat Saleh A.S ki risalat ka iqrar karein, lekin unhon ne bhi inkar kar diya aur apne kufr par jamay rahay, Allah ke paighambar ko jhoota kaha. Bawajood Allah se dartay rehnay ki nasihat sunnay ke, parhezgari ikhtiyar na ki. Bawajood Rasool-e-Ameen ki maujoodgi ke, rah-e-hidayat ikhtiyar na ki. Halankeh Nabi ka saaf elaan tha ke main apna koi bojh tum par daal nahin raha, main toh risalat ki tableegh ke ajr ka sirf Allah Ta'ala se khwahan hoon. Is ke baad Allah ki ne'matein unhein yaad dilayein.

Saleh A.S ki baghi qoum. Hazrat Saleh A.S apni qoum mein wa'z farma rahe hain, unhein Allah ki ne'matein yaad dila rahe hain aur uske azabon se mutanabbeh farma rahe hain ke woh Allah jo tumhein yeh kushada roziyan de raha hai, jisne tumhare liye baghat aur chashme, khetiyan aur phal phool muhayya farma diye hain, aman-o-chain se tumhari zindagi ke ayyam poore kar rahe hain, tum uski nafarmaniyan karke inhi ne'maton mein aur isi aman-o-aman mein nahin chhore ja sakte. In baghat aur in daryayon mein, in khetiyon mein, in khajuron ke baghat mein jin ke khushe khajuron ki ziyadati ke mare bojhal ho rahe hain aur jhuke padte hain, jin mein teh-ba-teh tar khajurein bharpoor lag rahi hain jo narm, khush-numa, meethi aur khush-zaiqa khajuron se ladi hui hain, tum Allah ki nafarmaniyan karke inko ba-aram hazam nahin kar sakte. Allah ne tumhein is waqt jin mazboot aur pur-takalluf, buland aur umda gharon mein rakh chhora hai, Allah ki tauheed aur meri risalat se inkar ke baad yeh bhi qaim nahin reh sakte. Afsos tum Allah ki ne'maton ki qadr nahin karte, apna waqt, apna rupiya be-ja barbad karke yeh naqsh-o-nigar wale makanat paharon mein ba-tasannu-o-takalluf sirf badai aur riyakari ke liye, apni azmat aur quwwat ke muzahire ke liye tarash rahe ho, jis mein koi nafa nahin balkay iska wabaal tumhare saron par mandla raha hai. Pas tumhein Allah se darna chahiye aur meri itteba karni chahiye, apne Khaliq, Raziq, Mun'im, Mohsin ki ibadat aur uski farmanbardari aur uski tauheed ki taraf poori tarah mutawajjeh ho jana chahiye. Jis ka nafa tumhein apni duniya aur aakhirat mein mile, tumhein uska shukr ada karna chahiye, uski tasbeeh-o-tahleel karni chahiye, subh-o-sham uski ibadat karni chahiye. Tumhein apne in maujooda sardaron ki hargiz na manni chahiye, yeh to hudood-e-Ilahi se tajawuz kar gaye hain, tauheed ko, itteba ko bhula baithe hain. Zameen mein fasad phaila rahe hain, nafarmani, gunah, fisq-o-fujoor par khud lage hue hain aur dusron ko bhi isi ki taraf bula rahe hain aur haq ki muwafiqat aur itteba karke islah ki koshish nahin karte.

Allah ne tumhein is waqt jin mazboot aur pur-takalluf, buland aur umda gharon mein rakh chhora hai, Allah ki tauheed aur meri risalat se inkar ke baad yeh bhi qaim nahin reh sakte. Afsos tum Allah ki ne'maton ki qadr nahin karte, apna waqt, apna rupiya be-ja barbad karke yeh naqsh-o-nigar wale makanat paharon mein ba-tasannu-o-takalluf sirf badai aur riyakari ke liye, apni azmat aur quwwat ke muzahire ke liye tarash rahe ho, jis mein koi nafa nahin balkay iska wabaal tumhare saron par mandla raha hai. Pas tumhein Allah se darna chahiye aur meri itteba karni chahiye, apne Khaliq, Raziq, Mun'im, Mohsin ki ibadat aur uski farmanbardari aur uski tauheed ki taraf poori tarah mutawajjeh ho jana chahiye. Jis ka nafa tumhein apni duniya aur aakhirat mein mile, tumhein uska shukr ada karna chahiye, uski tasbeeh-o-tahleel karni chahiye, subh-o-sham uski ibadat karni chahiye. Tumhein apne in maujooda sardaron ki hargiz na manni chahiye, yeh to hudood-e-Ilahi se tajawuz kar gaye hain, tauheed ko, itteba ko bhula baithe hain. Zameen mein fasad phaila rahe hain, nafarmani, gunah, fisq-o-fujoor par khud lage hue hain aur dusron ko bhi isi ki taraf bula rahe hain aur haq ki muwafiqat aur itteba karke islah ki koshish nahin karte.

Nabi ka apne aap se taqabul: Thamudiyon ne apne Nabi ko jawab diya ke tujh par toh kisi ne jadoo kar diya hai, go ek ma'ani yeh bhi kiye gaye ke tu makhlooq mein se hai aur iski daleel mein Arabi ka ek sher bhi pesh kiya jata hai lekin zahir ma'ani pehle hi hain. Isi ke sath unhon ne kaha ke tu toh hum jaisa ek insaan hai, yeh kaise mumkin hai ke hum mein se toh kisi par wahi na aaye aur tujh par aa jaye? Kuch nahin yeh sirf banawat hai, ek khud-sakhta drama hai, mehez jhoot aur saaf toofan hai. Acha hum kehte hain agar tu waqai sacha Nabi hai toh koi mojiza dikha. Us waqt unke chote bade sab jama thay aur yak-zabaan ho kar sab ne mojiza talab kiya tha. Aap ne poocha tum kya mojiza dekhana chahte ho? Unhon ne kaha yeh samne jo patthar ki badi sari chattan hai yeh hamare dekhte hue phate aur is mein se ek gabhan oontni is is rang ki aur aisi aisi nikle. Aap ne farmaya acha agar main Rabb se dua karoon aur woh yahi mojiza mere hathon tumhein dikha de phir toh tumhein meri nabuwwat ke manne mein koi uzr na hoga? Sab ne pukhta wada kiya, qaul-o-qarar kiya ke hum sab imaan layenge aur aap ki nabuwwat maan lenge. Aap bahut jald yeh mojiza dikhayen. Aap ne usi waqt namaz shuru kar di phir Allah Azza-wa-Jal se dua ki, usi waqt woh patthar phata aur isi tarah ki ek oontni unke dekhte hue is mein se nikli. Kuch log toh hasb-e-iqrar momin ho gaye lekin aksar log phir bhi kafir ke kafir rahe. Aap ne kaha suno ek din yeh pani piyegi aur ek din pani ki bari tumhari muqarrar rahegi. Ab tum mein se koi ise burai na pahunchaye warna badtareen azab tum par utar padega. Ek arsay tak toh woh ruke rahe. Oontni un mein rahi, chara chugti aur apni bari wale din pani piti. Us din yeh log iske doodh se sair ho jate. Lekin ek muddat ke baad unki badbakhti ne unhein aa ghera. Un mein se ek maloon ne oontni ke maar dalne ka irada kiya aur kul ahl-e-shehar uske muwafiq ho gaye, chunancha uski kochein kaat kar use maar dala. Jis ke natijay mein unhein sakht nadamat aur peshimani uthani padi, Allah ke azab ne unhein achanak aadabocha. Unki zameen hila di gayin aur ek cheekh se sab ke sab halak kar diye gaye. Dil ud gaye, kaleje pash-pash ho gaye aur wehm-o-guman bhi jis cheez ka na tha woh aan pada. Aur ta-aakhir sab gharat ho gaye aur duniya jahan ke liye yeh khaufnak waqia ibrat-afza ho gaya. Itni badi nishani apni aankhon dekh kar bhi un mein se aksar logon ko imaan lana naseeb na hua. Is mein kuch shak nahin ke Allah Ghalib hai aur Raheem bhi hai.

Us din yeh log iske doodh se sair ho jate. Lekin ek muddat ke baad unki badbakhti ne unhein aa ghera. Un mein se ek maloon ne oontni ke maar dalne ka irada kiya aur kul ahl-e-shehar uske muwafiq ho gaye, chunancha uski kochein kaat kar use maar dala. Jis ke natijay mein unhein sakht nadamat aur peshimani uthani padi, Allah ke azab ne unhein achanak aadabocha. Unki zameen hila di gayin aur ek cheekh se sab ke sab halak kar diye gaye. Dil ud gaye, kaleje pash-pash ho gaye aur wehm-o-guman bhi jis cheez ka na tha woh aan pada. Aur ta-aakhir sab gharat ho gaye aur duniya jahan ke liye yeh khaufnak waqia ibrat-afza ho gaya. Itni badi nishani apni aankhon dekh kar bhi un mein se aksar logon ko imaan lana naseeb na hua. Is mein kuch shak nahin ke Allah Ghalib hai aur Raheem bhi hai.

Kuch nahin yeh sirf banawat hai, ek khud-sakhta drama hai, mehez jhoot aur saaf toofan hai. Acha hum kehte hain agar tu waqai sacha Nabi hai toh koi mojiza dikha. Lut A.S aur unki qoum. Ab Allah Ta'ala apne bande aur Rasool Hazrat Lut A.S ka qissa bayan farma raha hai. Unka naam Lut bin Haran bin Azar tha. Yeh Ibrahim Khalilullah A.S ke bhatije thay. Inhein Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki hayat mein bahut badi ummat ki taraf bheja tha. Yeh log Sadum aur uske paas baste thay, bil-akhir yeh bhi Allah ke azabon mein pakde gaye, sab ke sab halak hue aur unki bastiyon ki jagah ek jheel sade hue gande khari pani ki baqi reh gayi. Yeh ab tak bhi Bilad-e-Ghaur mein mashhoor hai jo ke Bait-ul-Muqaddas aur Karak-o-Shobak ke darmiyan hai. In logon ne bhi Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki takzeeb ki. Aap ne inhein Allah ki masiyat chhodne aur apni tabedari karne ki hidayat ki. Apna Rasool ho kar aana zahir kiya. Inhein Allah ke azabon se daraya, Allah ki baatein maan lene ko farmaya. Elaan kar diya ke main tumhare paise takke ka mohtaj nahin. Main sirf Allah ke waste tumhari khair-khwahi kar raha hoon, tum apne is khabeeth fe'l se baaz aao yani aurton ko chhod kar mardon se haajat-rawai karne se ruk jao, lekin unhon ne Allah ke Rasool A.S ki na maani balkeh eizayein pahunchane lage.

Hum jinsi parasti ka shikar Lut Nabi (A.S) ne apni qoum ko unki khas badkari se roka ke tum mardon ke paas shahwat se na aao. Haan apni halal biwiyon se apni khwahish puri karo jinhein Allah ne tumhare liye joda bana diya hai. Rabb ki muqarrar hadon ka adab-o-ehtram karo. Iska jawab unke paas yahi tha ke ae Lut (A.S) agar tu baaz na aaya toh hum tujhe jala-watan kar denge, unhon ne aapas mein mashwara kiya ke in pakbaz logon ko toh alag kardo. Yeh dekh kar aap ne un se bezari aur dast-bardari ka elaan kar diya. Aur farmaya ke main tumhare is bure kaam se naraz hoon, main ise pasand nahin karta, main Allah ke samne apni barat ka izhar karta hoon. Phir Allah se unke liye bad-dua ki aur apni aur apne gharane ki nijat talab ki. Allah Ta'ala ne sab ko nijat di magar aap ki biwi ne apni qoum ka sath diya aur unhi ke sath tabah hui jaise ke Surah Al-A'raf, Surah Hud aur Surah Al-Hijr mein bil-tafseel bayan guzar chuka hai. Aap apne walon ko lekar Allah ke farman ke mutabiq is basti se chal khade hue, hukum tha ke aap ke nikalte hi un par azab aayega, us waqt palat kar unki taraf dekhna bhi nahin. Phir un sab par azab barsa aur sab barbad kar diye gaye. Un par aasman se sang-bari hui. Aur unka anjam-e-bad hua. Yeh bhi ibrat-nak waqea hai, un mein se bhi aksar be-iman thay. Rabb ke ghalbe mein aur uske raham mein koi shak nahin.

Iska jawab unke paas yahi tha ke ae Lut (A.S) agar tu baaz na aaya toh hum tujhe jala-watan kar denge, unhon ne aapas mein mashwara kiya ke in pakbaz logon ko toh alag kardo. Yeh dekh kar aap ne un se bezari aur dast-bardari ka elaan kar diya. Aur farmaya ke main tumhare is bure kaam se naraz hoon, main ise pasand nahin karta, main Allah ke samne apni barat ka izhar karta hoon. Phir un sab par azab barsa aur sab barbad kar diye gaye. Un par aasman se sang-bari hui. Aur unka anjam-e-bad hua. Yeh bhi ibrat-nak waqea hai, un mein se bhi aksar be-iman thay. Rabb ke ghalbe mein aur uske raham mein koi shak nahin.

Shuaib A.S: Yeh log Madyan ke rehne wale thay. Hazrat Shuaib A.S bhi in hi mein thay. Aap ko un ka bhai sirf is liye nahin kaha gaya ke is aayat mein in logon ki nisbat Aikah ki taraf ki hai, jise yeh log poojte thay. Aikah ek darakht tha, yahi wajah hai ke jaise aur nabiyon ko un ki ummaton ka bhai farmaya gaya, inhe un ka bhai nahin kaha gaya warna yeh log bhi inhi ki qoum mein se thay. Baaz log jin ke zehan ki rasai is nukte tak nahin hui woh kehte hain ke yeh log aap ki qoum mein se na thay, is liye Hazrat Shuaib A.S ko un ka bhai farmaya gaya, yeh aur hi qoum thi. Shuaib A.S apni qoum ki taraf bhi bheje gaye thay aur in logon ki taraf bhi. Baaz kehte hain ke ek teesri ummat ki taraf bhi aap ki ba'asat hui thi. Chunancha Hazrat Ikrimah R.H se marwi hai ke kisi nabi ko Allah Ta'ala ne do martaba nahin bheja siwaye Hazrat Shuaib A.S ke, ke ek martaba inhe Madyan walon ki taraf bheja aur un ki takzeeb ki wajah se inhe ek chinghaar ke sath halak kar diya, aur dobara inhe Aikah walon ki taraf bheja aur un ki takzeeb ki wajah un par saaye wale din ka azaab aaya aur woh barbaad huye. Lekin yaad rahe ke is ke raawiyon mein ek raawi Ishaq bin Bashir Kaahli hai jo zaeef hai. Qatadah R.H ka qaul hai ke Ashaab-e-Rass aur Ashaab-e-Aikah qoum-e-Shuaib hai aur ek buzurg farmate hain Ashaab-e-Aikah aur Ashaab-e-Madyan ek hi hai. Wallahu A'alam. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai, Rasool-e-Kareem ﷺ farmate hain Ashaab-e-Madyan aur Ashaab-e-Aikah do qoumein hain, in dono ummaton ki taraf Allah Ta'ala ne apne nabi Hazrat Shuaib A.S ko bheja tha lekin yeh hadees ghareeb hai aur is ke marfoo hone mein kalaam hai, bahut mumkin hai ke yeh mauqoof hi ho. Sahih amr yahi hai ke yeh dono ek hi ummat hai. Dono jagah in ke wasf alag alag bayan huye hain magar woh ek hi hai. Is ki ek badi daleel yeh bhi hai ke dono qisson mein Hazrat Shuaib A.S ka wa'az ek hi hai, dono ko naap tol sahih karne ka hukum diya hai.

Dandi maar qoum: Hazrat Shuaib (A.S) apni qoum ko naap tol durust karne ki hidayat kar rahe hain. Dandi maarne aur naap tol mein kami karne se rokte hain aur farmate hain ke jab kisi ko koi shay naap kar do toh poora paimana bhar kar do uske haq se kam na karo. Isi tarah dusre se jab lo toh zyada lene ki koshish aur tadbeer na karo. Yeh kya ke lene ke waqt poora lo aur dene ke waqt kam do? Lain-den dono saaf aur poora rakho. Tarazu achi rakho jis mein tol sahih aaye, batte bhi poore rakho, tol mein adl karo, dandi na maaro, kam na tolo, kisi ko uski cheez kam na do. Kisi ki raah na maaro, chori chakari, loot maar, ghartgari, rehzani se bacho, logon ko dara dhamka kar khaufzada karke un se maal na looto. Us Allah Ta'ala ke azabon ka khauf rakho jis ne tumhein aur sab aglon ko paida kiya hai. Jo tumhare aur tumhare badon ka Rabb hai. Yehi lafz aayat (Walaqad adalla minkum jibillan kaseera, afalam takoonu ta'qiloon) (Surah Yaseen: 62) mein bhi isi ma'ani mein hai.

Dandi maarne aur naap tol mein kami karne se rokte hain aur farmate hain ke jab kisi ko koi shay naap kar do toh poora paimana bhar kar do uske haq se kam na karo. Isi tarah dusre se jab lo toh zyada lene ki koshish aur tadbeer na karo. Yeh kya ke lene ke waqt poora lo aur dene ke waqt kam do? Lain-den dono saaf aur poora rakho. Tarazu achi rakho jis mein tol sahih aaye, batte bhi poore rakho, tol mein adl karo, dandi na maaro, kam na tolo, kisi ko uski cheez kam na do. Kisi ki raah na maaro, chori chakari, loot maar, ghartgari, rehzani se bacho, logon ko dara dhamka kar khaufzada karke un se maal na looto. Us Allah Ta'ala ke azabon ka khauf rakho jis ne tumhein aur sab aglon ko paida kiya hai. Jo tumhare aur tumhare badon ka Rabb hai.
