Mushrikeen ki wahi hamaqatein. Thamudiyon ne jo jawab apne Nabi ko diya tha wahi jawab in logon ne bhi apne Rasoolon ko diya ke tujh par toh kisi ne jadoo kar diya hai, teri aql thikane nahin rahi. Tu hum jaisa hi insaan hai aur hamein toh yaqeen hai ke tu jhoota aadmi hai. Allah ne tujhe nahin bheja. Acha toh agar apne da'we mein sacha hai toh hum par aasman ka ek tukda gira de. Aasmani azaab hum par le aa jaise Quraishiyon ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha tha ke hum tujh par imaan laane ke nahin jab tak ke tu Arab ki is retli zameen mein darya na baha de, yahan tak kaha ke ya toh tu hum par aasman ka koi tukda gira de jaise ke tera khayal hai ya toh Allah Ta'ala ko ya farishton ko khulam khula le aa. Aur aayat mein hai ke unhon ne kaha, "Aye Allah agar yeh tere paas hai aur haq hai toh tu hum par aasman se patthar barsa de." Isi tarah in jahil kafiron ne kaha ke tu hum par aasman ka tukda gira de. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jawab diya ke Allah ko tumhare a'maal bakhoobi maloom hain, jis laiq tum ho woh khud kar de ga. Agar tum us ke nazdeek aasmani azaab ke qabil ho toh bila-taakheer tum par aasmani azaab aa jaye ga, Allah zalim nahin ke beganahon ko saza de. Bil-aakhir jis qisam ka azaab yeh maang rahe thay usi qisam ka azaab un par aaya. Unhein sakht garmi mehsoos hui, saat din tak goya zameen ubalti rahi. Kisi jagah kisi saya mein thandak ya rahat mayassar na hui. Tadap uthay, be-qarar ho gaye. Saat din ke baad unhon ne dekha ke ek siyah badal un ki taraf aa raha hai, woh aa kar un ke saron par chha gaya, yeh sab garmi aur hararat se zuch ho gaye thay us ke neeche ja baithe. Jab saare ke saare us ke saaye mein pahunch gaye, wahin badal mein se aag barasne lagi, saath hi zameen zor zor se jhatkay lene lagi aur is zor ki ek aawaz aayi jis se un ke dil phat gaye, jaan nikal gayi aur saare ek aan mein tabah-o-veeran ho gaye. Is din ke saayeban wale sakht azaab ne un mein se ek ko bhi baqi na chhora. Surah Al-A'raf mein toh farmaya gaya hai ke ek zalzalay ke saath hi yeh sab halak ho gaye. Surah Hud mein bayan hua hai ke un ki tabahi ka ba'is ek khatarnak manzar dil-shikan cheekh thi aur yahan bayan hua ke unhein saayeban ke din azaab ne qaboo kar liya, toh teenon maqamat par teenon ka ek-ek kar ke zikr is maqam ki ibarat ki munasibat ki wajah se hua hai. Surah Al-A'raf mein un ki is khabasat ka zikr hai ke unhon ne Hazrat Shuaib (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko dhamkaya tha ke agar tum hamare deen mein na aayein toh hum tumhein aur tumhare sathiyon ko shehar-badar kar denge. Choonke wahan Nabi ke dil ko hilane ka zikr tha is liye azaab bhi un ke jismon ko ma'a dilon ko hila dene wale yani zalzalay aur jhatkon ka zikr hua. Surah Hud mein zikr hai ke unhon ne apne Nabi ko bator-e-mazaq ke kaha tha ke aap toh baray burdbar aur bhalay aadmi hain. Matlab yeh tha ke baray baki-bakwasi aur buray aadmi hain toh wahan azaab mein cheekh aur chinghaar ka bayan hua. Yahan choonke un ki aarzoo aasman ke tukray ke girne ki thi toh azaab ka zikr bhi saayeban-numa abr ke tukray se hua. Fasubhanahu ma a'zam shaanahu.

Hazrat Umar R.A ka bayan hai ke saat din tak woh garmi padi ke al-aman wal-hafeez kahin thandak ka naam nahin tha, talmila uthay. Is ke baad ek abr utha aur umadha. Is ke saaye mein ek shakhs pahuncha aur wahan rahat aur thandak pakar us ne dusron ko bulaya, jab sab jama ho gaye to abr phata aur us mein se aag barsi. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke abr jo bator-e-saiban ke tha un ke jama hotay hi hat gaya aur suraj se un par aag barsi jis ne un sab ka bharta bana diya. Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi R.H farmatay hain ahl-e-Madyan par teenon azab aaye. Shahron mein zalzala aaya jis se khaif ho kar hudood-e-shahar se bahar aa gaye. Bahar jama hotay hi ghabrahat, pareshani aur be-kali shuru ho gayi to wahan se bhagdar machi lekin shahar mein janay se daray. Wahin dekha ke ek abr ka tukda ek jagah hai, ek us ke neechay gaya aur us ki thandak mehsoos kar ke sab ko aawaz di ke yahan aa jao, yahan jaisi thandak aur taskeen to kabhi dekhi hi nahin. Yeh suntay hi sab us ke neechay jama ho gaye ke achanak ek cheekh ki aawaz aayi jis se kalejay phat gaye, sab ke sab mar gaye. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka bayan hai ke sakht garaj, kadak aur garmi shuru hui jis se saans ghutnay lagay aur be-chaini had ko pahunch gayi. Ghabra kar shahar chhor kar maidan mein jama ho gaye. Yahan badal aaya jis ke neechay thandak aur rahat hasil karnay ke liye sab jama huay. Wahin aag barsi, jal bhun gaye. Yeh tha saiban walay baray bhari din ka azab jis ne un ka naam-o-nishan mita diya. Yaqeenan yeh waqea sarasar-e-ibrat aur qudrat-e-Ilahi ki ek zabardast nishani hai. In mein aksar be-iman thay. Allah Ta'ala apnay bad bandon se inteqam lenay mein ghalib hai. Koi usay maghloob nahin kar sakta, woh apnay nek bandon par meharban hai, unhein bacha liya karta hai.

Mubarak Kitab. Surat ki ibtida mein Quran-e-Kareem ka zikr aaya tha wohi zikr phir tafseelan bayan ho raha hai ke yeh Mubarak Kitab Quran-e-Kareem Allah Ta'ala ne apne bande aur Nabi Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par nazil farmayi hai. Rooh-ul-Amin se murad Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) hain jin ke waste se yeh wahi Sarwar-e-Rusul (A.S / Alaihis Salam) par utri hai. Jaise farman hai aayat (Qul man kana aduwwal-li-Jibrila fa-innahu nazzalahu 'ala qalbika bi-iznillahi musaddiqal-lima baina yadihi wa hudaw-wa bushra lil-mu'minin) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 97) yani is Quran ko bahukm-e-Ilahi Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne tere dil par nazil farmaya hai. Yeh Quran agli tamam ilhami kitabon ki tasdeeq karne wala hai. Yeh farishta hamare yahan aisa mukarram hai ke is ka dushman hamara dushman hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H / Rahimahullah) farmate hain jis se Rooh-ul-Amin bole use zameen nahin khati. Is buzurg ba-martaba farishte ne jo farishton ka sardar hai tere dil par is pak aur behtar Kalam-e-Allah ko nazil farmaya hai jo har tarah ke mail-kuchail se, kami-ziyadati se, nuqsan aur kaji se pak hai. Taake tu Allah ke mukhalifeen ko, gunahgaron ko Allah ki saza se bachao karne ki rahbari kar sake. Aur tabe-e-farman logon ko Allah ki maghfirat-o-rizwan ki khushkhabri pahuncha sake. Yeh khuli faseeh Arabi zaban mein hai. Taake har shakhs samajh sake, parh sake. Kisi ka uzr baqi na rahe aur har ek par Quran-e-Kareem Allah ki hujjat ban jaye. Ek martaba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Sahaba (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhum) ke samne nihayat fasahat se Arab ke ausaf bayan kiye jise sun kar Sahaba keh uthe Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap to kamal darje ki faseeh-o-baleeg zaban bolte hain. Aap ne farmaya bhala meri zaban aisi pakeeza kyun na hogi, Quran bhi to meri zaban mein utra hai. Farman hai aayat (Bilisanin 'arabiyyim-mubin) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 195). Imam Sufyan Thauri (R.H / Rahimahullah) farmate hain wahi Arabi mein utri hai yeh aur baat hai ke har Nabi ne apni qaum ke liye un ki zaban mein tarjuma kar diya. Qayamat ke din Suryani zaban hogi, han jannatiyon ki zaban Arabi hogi (Ibn Abi Hatim).

Aap ne farmaya bhala meri zaban aisi pakeeza kyun na hogi, Quran bhi to meri zaban mein utra hai. Farman hai aayat (Bilisanin 'arabiyyim-mubin) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 195). Imam Sufyan Thauri (R.H / Rahimahullah) farmate hain wahi Arabi mein utri hai yeh aur baat hai ke har Nabi ne apni qaum ke liye un ki zaban mein tarjuma kar diya. Qayamat ke din Suryani zaban hogi, han jannatiyon ki zaban Arabi hogi (Ibn Abi Hatim).

Rooh-ul-Amin se murad Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) hain jin ke waste se yeh wahi Sarwar-e-Rusul (A.S / Alaihis Salam) par utri hai. Jaise farman hai aayat (Qul man kana aduwwal-li-Jibrila fa-innahu nazzalahu 'ala qalbika bi-iznillahi musaddiqal-lima baina yadihi wa hudaw-wa bushra lil-mu'minin) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 97) yani is Quran ko bahukm-e-Ilahi Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne tere dil par nazil farmaya hai. Yeh Quran agli tamam ilhami kitabon ki tasdeeq karne wala hai. Yeh farishta hamare yahan aisa mukarram hai ke is ka dushman hamara dushman hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H / Rahimahullah) farmate hain jis se Rooh-ul-Amin bole use zameen nahin khati. Is buzurg ba-martaba farishte ne jo farishton ka sardar hai tere dil par is pak aur behtar Kalam-e-Allah ko nazil farmaya hai jo har tarah ke mail-kuchail se, kami-ziyadati se, nuqsan aur kaji se pak hai. Basharat-o-Tasdeeq Yafta Kitab. Farmata hai ke Allah ki agli kitabon mein bhi is pak aur Allah ki aakhri kalam ki peshan-goi aur uski tasdeeq-o-sifat majood hai. Agle nabiyon ne bhi iski basharat di yahan tak ke un tamam nabiyon ke aakhri nabi jin ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tak aur koi nabi na tha. Yani Hazrat Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) Bani Israel ko jama kar ke jo khutba dete hain us mein farmate hain ke ae Bani Israel! Main tumhari janib Allah ka bheja hua rasool hoon jo agli kitabon ko sachane ke sath hi aane wale Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki basharat tumhein sunata hoon. Zaboor Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki kitab ka naam hai yahan Zubur ka lafz kitabon ke ma'ani mein hai jaise farman hai. Ayat (Wa kullu shai'in fa'aloohu fiz-zubur) (Surah Al-Qamar: 52) jo kuch yeh kar rahe hain sab kitabon mein tahreer hai. Phir farmata hai ke agar yeh samjhein aur zid aur ta'assub na karein to Quran ki haqaniyat par yahi daleel kya kam hai ke khud Bani Israel ke ulama ise maante hain. Un mein se jo haq-go aur be-ta'assub hain woh Taurat ki un aayaton ka logon par khule aam zikr kar rahe hain jin mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ba'asat, Quran ka zikr aur aap ki haqaniyat ki khabar hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu), Hazrat Salman Farsi (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) aur un jaise haq-go hazrat ne duniya ke samne Taurat-o-Injeel ki woh aayatein rakh dein jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shan-e-wala shan ko zahir karne wali thin. Is ke baad ki ayat ka matlab yeh hai ke agar is faseeh-o-baleeh, jame-o-baligh haq kalam ko hum kisi ajami par nazil farmate phir bhi koi shak hi nahin ho sakta tha ke yeh hamara kalam hai. Magar mushrikeen-e-Quraish apne kufr aur apni sarkashi mein itne barh gaye hain ke us waqt bhi woh iman na late. Jaise farman hai ke agar aasman ka darwaza bhi un ke liye khol diya jata aur yeh khud charh kar jate tab bhi yahi kehte hamein nasha pila diya gaya hai. Hamari aankhon par parda daal diya gaya hai. Aur ayat mein hai agar un ke paas farishte aa jate aur murde bol uthte tab bhi unhein iman naseeb na hota. Un par azab ka kalma sabit ho chuka, azab un ka muqaddar ho chuka aur hidayat ki raah masdood kar di gayi.

Kufr-o-inkaar, takzeeb-o-kufr, inkaar-o-adam-e-tasleem ko in mujrimon ke dilon mein bitha diya hai. Yeh jab tak azaab apni aankhon se na dekh lein imaan nahin layenge. Us waqt agar imaan laye bhi toh mehez besood hoga, un par laanat baras chuki hogi, burai mil chuki hogi. Na pachtana kaam aaye na ma'zarat nafa de. Azaab-e-Allah aayenge aur achanak unki be-khabari mein hi aa jayenge, us waqt unki tamannayein agar zara si bhi mohlat payein toh nek ban jayein, besood hongi. Ek inhi par kya mauqoof hai, har zaalim, faajir, faasiq, kaafir badkaar azaab ko dekhte hi seedha ho jata hai, naadim hota hai, tauba-o-talaafi karta hai magar sab la-haasil. Firaun hi ko dekhiye, Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne uske liye bad-dua ki jo qubool hui, azaab ko dekh kar doobte hue kehne laga ke ab main musalman hota hoon lekin jawab mila ke yeh imaan besood hai. Isi tarah ek aur aayat mein hai ke hamara azaab dekh kar imaan ka iqraar kiya. Phir unki ek aur bad-bakhti bayan ho rahi hai ke woh apne nabiyon se kehte the agar sachay ho toh azaab-e-Allah lao. Agarche hum unhein mohlat dein aur kuch dinon tak, kuch muddat tak unhein azaab se bachaye rakhein, phir unke paas hamara muqarrara azaab aa jaye. Unka haal, unki ne'matein, unki jaah-o-hashmat, garz koi cheez unhein zara sa bhi faida nahin de sakti. Us waqt tak yahi maloom hoga ke shayad ek subh ya ek shaam hi duniya mein rahe. Jaise ek aur aayat mein hai: (Yawaddu ahaduhum law yu'ammaru alfa sanatin, wa ma huwa bi-muzahzihihi minal-azaabi ay yu'ammara, wallahu baseerun bima ya'maloon) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 96). In mein se har ek ki chahat hai ke woh hazaar hazaar saal jiye lekin itni umr bhi Allah ke azaab hata nahin sakti. Yahi yahan bhi farmaya ke asbaab unke kuch kaam na aayenge, ulta azaab mein mubtala hote waqt unki tamam taqatein aur asbaab yunhi rakhay rakhay reh jayenge. Chunancha sahih hadith mein hai ke kaafir ko Qayamat ke din laya jayega, phir aag mein ek ghota dila kar poocha jayega ke tu ne kabhi rahat bhi uthayi hai? Toh woh kahega ke Allah ki qasam main ne kabhi koi rahat nahin dekhi. Aur ek us shakhs ko laya jayega jis ne poori umr waqai koi rahat chakh hi na ho, use Jannat ki hawa khila kar laya jayega aur sawal hoga ke kya tu ne umr bhar kabhi koi burai dekhi hai? Toh woh kahega ae Allah teri zaat-e-paak ki qasam main ne kabhi koi zehmat nahin uthayi. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) umooman yeh sher parha karte the ke jab tu apni muraad ko pahunch gaya toh goya tu ne kabhi kisi takleef ka naam bhi nahin suna. Allah Azza-wa-Jal iske baad apne adl ki khabar deta hai ke kabhi usne hujjat khatam hone se pehle kabhi kisi ummat ko khatam nahin kiya. Rasoolon ko bhejta, kitabein utarta, khabrein deta, hoshiyar karta hai, phir na manne walon par masaib ke pahar toot parte hain. Pas farmaya ke aisa kabhi nahin hua ke ambiya ke bhejne se pehle hi hum ne kisi ummat par azaab bhej diye hon.

Daranay walay bhej kar nasihat karkay uzr hata kar phir na mannay par azab hota hai jaisay farmaya tera Rab kisi basti ko halak nahin karta jab tak ke un ki bastiyon ki sadar basti mein kisi Rasool na bhej day jo unhein hamari aayatein parh kar sunaye.

Kufr-o-inkaar, takzeeb-o-kufr, inkaar-o-adam-e-tasleem ko in mujrimon ke dilon mein bitha diya hai. Yeh jab tak azaab apni aankhon se na dekh lein imaan nahin layenge. Us waqt agar imaan laye bhi toh mehez besood hoga, un par laanat baras chuki hogi, burai mil chuki hogi. Na pachtana kaam aaye na ma'zarat nafa de. Azaab-e-Allah aayenge aur achanak unki be-khabari mein hi aa jayenge, us waqt unki tamannayein agar zara si bhi mohlat payein toh nek ban jayein, besood hongi. Ek inhi par kya mauqoof hai, har zaalim, faajir, faasiq, kaafir badkaar azaab ko dekhte hi seedha ho jata hai, naadim hota hai, tauba-o-talaafi karta hai magar sab la-haasil. Firaun hi ko dekhiye, Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne uske liye bad-dua ki jo qubool hui, azaab ko dekh kar doobte hue kehne laga ke ab main musalman hota hoon lekin jawab mila ke yeh imaan besood hai. Isi tarah ek aur aayat mein hai ke hamara azaab dekh kar imaan ka iqraar kiya. Phir unki ek aur bad-bakhti bayan ho rahi hai ke woh apne nabiyon se kehte the agar sachay ho toh azaab-e-Allah lao. Agarche hum unhein mohlat dein aur kuch dinon tak, kuch muddat tak unhein azaab se bachaye rakhein, phir unke paas hamara muqarrara azaab aa jaye. Unka haal, unki ne'matein, unki jaah-o-hashmat, garz koi cheez unhein zara sa bhi faida nahin de sakti. Us waqt tak yahi maloom hoga ke shayad ek subh ya ek shaam hi duniya mein rahe. Jaise ek aur aayat mein hai: (Yawaddu ahaduhum law yu'ammaru alfa sanatin, wa ma huwa bi-muzahzihihi minal-azaabi ay yu'ammara, wallahu baseerun bima ya'maloon) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 96). In mein se har ek ki chahat hai ke woh hazaar hazaar saal jiye lekin itni umr bhi Allah ke azaab hata nahin sakti. Yahi yahan bhi farmaya ke asbaab unke kuch kaam na aayenge, ulta azaab mein mubtala hote waqt unki tamam taqatein aur asbaab yunhi rakhay rakhay reh jayenge. Chunancha sahih hadith mein hai ke kaafir ko Qayamat ke din laya jayega, phir aag mein ek ghota dila kar poocha jayega ke tu ne kabhi rahat bhi uthayi hai? Yeh Kitab-e-Aziz, yeh Kitab-e-Aziz jis ke aas paas bhi batil phatak nahin sakta, jo Hakim-o-Hamid Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se utri hai. Jis ko Ruh-ul-Amin jo quwwat-o-taqat wale hain, le kar aaye hain. Isay shayateen nahin laye. Phir un ke na lane par teen wajoohaat bayan ki gayin. Ek toh yeh ke woh is ke laiq nahin. Un ka kaam makhlooq ko behkana hai na ke rah-e-rast par lana. Amr-bil-Ma'roof aur Nahi-anil-Munkar jo is kitab ki shaan hai, us ke sarasar khilaf hai. Yeh noor, yeh hidayat hai, yeh burhan hai aur shayateen in teeno cheezon se chirte hain. Woh zulmat ke dildada aur zalalat ke hero hain. Woh jahalat ke shaida hain, pas is kitab mein aur un mein toh tabayun aur ikhtilaf hai. Kahan woh, kahan yeh? Doosri wajah yeh hai ke woh jahan is ke ahl nahin, wahan un mein is ko uthane aur lane ki taqat bhi nahin. Yeh toh woh zi-izzat wala kaam hai ke agar kisi bade se bade pahad par bhi utre toh us ko bhi chakna choor kar de. Phir teesri wajah yeh bayan farmayi ke woh toh is ke nazool ke waqt hata diye gaye thay, unhein toh sunna bhi nahin mila. Tamam aasman par sakht pehra choki thi. Yeh sunne ke liye chadhte thay toh un par aag barsayi jati thin. Is ka ek harf sun lena bhi un ki taqat se bahar tha, taake Allah Ta'ala ka kalam mehfooz tareeqe par us ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko pahunche aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki wasatat se makhlooq-e-Ilahi ko pahunche. Jaise Surah Jinn mein khud jinnaat ka maqoola bayan hua hai ke hum ne aasman ko tatola toh usay sakht pehra choki se bharpoor paya aur jagah jagah sholay mutayyan paye. Pehle toh hum baith kar akka-dukka baat uda laya karte thay lekin ab toh kaan lagate hi shola lapakta hai aur jala kar bhasam kar deta hai.

Mustahiq-e-saza logon se alag ho jao. Khud apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se khitab kar ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke sirf meri hi ibadat kar. Mere sath kisi ko sharik na kar, jo bhi aisa karega woh zaroor mustahiq-e-saza hai. Apne qareebi rishtedaron ko hoshiyar karde ke bajuz iman ke koi cheez nijat dahinda nahin. Phir hukum deta hai ke muwahid muttabi-e-sunnat logon se farotani ke sath milta julta reh. Aur jo bhi mere hukum na mane khwah koi ho to us se betaluq ho ja. Aur apni bezari ka izhar karde. Yeh khas taur ki khas logon ki tanbeeh aam logon ki tanbeeh ke manafi nahin kyunke yeh us ka juz hai. Aur jagah irshad hai: "Tu us qoum ko dara de jin ke bade bhi daraye nahin gaye aur jo ghaflat mein pade hue hain." Aur ayat mein hai: (وَلِتُنْذِرَ اُمَّ الْقُرٰي وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا 92؀) (Surah Al-An'am: 92) "Taake tu Makkah walon ko aur us ke gird walon ko sab ko daraye." Aur ayat mein hai: "Tu is Quran se unhein hoshiyar karde jo apne Rab ke paas jama hone se khauf zada ho rahe hain." Deegar ayat mein irshad farmaya ke: "Tu is Quran se parhezgaron ko khushkhabri suna de aur sarkashon ko dara de." Aur ayat mein farmaya: (لِاُنْذِرَكُمْ بِهٖ وَمَنْۢ بَلَغَ ۭ 19؀ۘ) (Surah Al-An'am: 19) "Taake main isi Quran ke sath tumhein aur jise bhi yeh pahunche dara doon." Aur farman hai: "Is ke sath in tamam firqon mein se jo bhi kufr kare us ki saza jahannam hai." Sahih Muslim ki hadith mein hai: "Us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, is ummat mein se jis ke kaan meri risalat ki baat pad jaye khwah Yahudi ho ya Nasrani, phir woh mujh par iman na laye to zaroor woh jahannam mein jayega." Is ayat ki tafsir mein bahut si hadithein hain, unhein sun lijiye. 001 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai: Jab Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat utari to An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Safa pahad par chadh gaye. Aur "Ya Sabaha" keh kar awaz di. Log jama ho gaye, jo nahin aa sakte the unhon ne apne aadmi bhej diye. Us waqt Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Ae aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib! Ae aulad-e-Fahr! Batao agar main tum se kahoon ke is pahad ki pusht par tumhare dushman ka lashkar pada hua hai aur ghaat mein hai, mauqa pate hi tum sab ko qatl kar dalega to kya tum mujhe sacha samjhoge?" Sab ne yak-zaban kaha ke haan, hum aap ko sacha hi samjhenge. Ab aap ne farmaya: "Sun lo, main tumhein aane wale sakht azabon se darane wala hoon." Is par Abu Lahab mal'oon ne kaha: "Tu halak ho jaye, yahi sunane ke liye to tune hamein bulaya tha?" Is ke jawab mein Surah Tabbat Yada utri (Bukhari, Muslim waghera). 002 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai: Is ayat ke utarte hi Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khade ho gaye aur farmane lage: "Ae Fatima bint-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Ae Safiya bint-e-Abdul Muttalib! Suno, main tumhein Allah ke haan kuch kaam nahin aa sakta. Haan, mere paas jo maal ho jitna tum chaho main dene ke liye tayyar hoon" (Muslim). 003 Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain ke is ayat ke utarte hi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Quraishiyon ko bulaya aur unhein ek-ek karke aur aam taur par khitab karke farmaya: "Ae Quraishiyo! Apni jaanein jahannam se bacha lo, ae Ka'ab ke khandan walo!"

Apni jaanein aag se bachalo, ae Hashim ki aulad ke logo! Apne aap ko Allah ke azabon se chhudwalo. Ae Abdul Muttalib ke ladko! Allah ke azabon se bachne ki koshish karo. Ae Fatima (R.A) bint-e-Muhammad! Apni jaan ko dozakh se bachale, qasam Allah ki, main Allah ke yahan ki kisi cheez ka maalik nahin. Beshak tumhari qarabat-dari hai, jis ke dunyawi haqooq main har tarah ada karne ko tayyar hoon. (Muslim waghera). Bukhari, Muslim mein bhi qadre alfaaz ki tabdeeli se yeh hadith marwi hai, ismein yeh bhi hai ke aap (ﷺ) ne apni phuphi Hazrat Safiya (R.A) aur apni sahibzadi Hazrat Fatima (R.A) se yeh bhi farmaya ke mere maal mein se jo chaho mujh se talab karlo. Abu Ya'la mein hai ke aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Qusay, ae Hashim, ae Abd-e-Manaf ki aulado! Yaad rakho main darane wala hoon aur maut badla dene wali hai, is ka chhapa padne hi wala hai aur Qayamat wa'da-gah hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ) par yeh aayat utri to aap (ﷺ) ek pahadi par chadh gaye jis ki choti par patthar the, wahan pahunch kar aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Bani Abd-e-Manaf! Main to sirf chaukanna kar dene wala hoon, meri aur tumhari misaal aisi hai jaise kisi shakhs ne dushman ko dekha aur daud kar apne azizon ko hoshiyar karne ke liye aaya taake woh bachao kar lein, door se hi us ne ghul machana shuru kar diya ke pehle hi khabardar ho jayein. (Muslim, Nasai waghera). Hazrat Ali (R.A) se marwi hai ke jab yeh aayat utri to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apne Ahl-e-Bait ko jama kar liya, yeh tees shakhs the. Jab yeh kha pee chuke to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Kaun hai jo mera qarz apne zimme le aur mere baad mere wa'de poore kare, woh Jannat mein bhi mera saathi aur meri ahl mein khalifa hoga. To ek shakhs ne kaha: Aap to samundar hain, aap ke saath kaun khada ho sakta hai? Teen dafa aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya lekin koi tayyar na hua, to main ne kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Main is ke liye tayyar hoon. (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ek aur sanad mein is se zyada tafseel ke saath marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Banu Abdul Muttalib ko jama kiya, yeh ek jamaat ki jamaat thi aur bade khaoo the, ek shakhs ek-ek bakri ka bacha kha jata tha aur ek bada budhna doodh ka pee jata tha. Aap (ﷺ) ne un sab ke khane ke liye sirf teen pao ke qareeb khana pakwaya, lekin Allah ne isi mein itni barkat di ke sab pet bhar kar kha chuke aur khoob aasooda ho kar pee chuke, lekin na to khane mein kami nazar aayi thi na peene ki cheez ghatti hui maloom hoti thi. Phir aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib! Main tumhari taraf khusoosan aur tamam logon ki taraf umooman Nabi bana kar bheja gaya hoon. Is waqt tum ek mo'jiza bhi mera dekh chuke ho. Ab tum mein se kaun tayyar hai ke mujh se bai'at kare, woh mera bhai aur mera saathi hoga? Lekin ek shakhs bhi majmay se khada na hua siwaye mere aur main is waqt umr ke lihaz se un sab se chhota tha. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Tum baith jao. Teen martaba aap (ﷺ) ne yahi farmaya aur teenon martaba bajuz mere aur koi khada na hua. Teesri martaba aap (ﷺ) ne meri bai'at li.

Imam Baihaqi (R.H) Dala'il-un-Nubuwwah mein laye hain ke jab yeh aayat utri toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar main apni qoum ke samne abhi hi ise pesh karunga toh woh na manenge. Aur aisa jawab denge jo mujh par garan guzre, pas Aap khamosh ho gaye. Itne mein Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S) aaye aur farmane lage, Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) agar aap ne tameel-e-irshad mein takheer ki toh dar hai ke aap ko saza hogi. Isi waqt Aap ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) ko bulaya aur farmaya, mujhe hukm hua hai ke main apne qareebi rishtedaron ko dara doon. Maine yeh khayal karke agar pehle hi se in se kaha gaya toh yeh mujhe aisa jawab denge jis se mujhe eeza pahunche main khamosh raha, lekin Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S) aaye aur kaha ke agar tu ne aisa na kiya toh tujhe azaab hoga. Toh ab ae Ali tum ek bakri zibah karke gosht pakalo aur koi teen seer anaaj bhi tayyar karlo aur ek budhna doodh ka bhi bhar lo aur aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib ko bhi jama karlo. Maine aisa hi kiya aur sab ko dawat de di, chalis aadmi jama hue ya ek aadh kam ya ek aadh zyada, in mein Aap ke chacha bhi the, Abu Talib, Hamza, Abbas, aur Abu Lahab kafir khabeeth. Maine saalan pesh kiya toh Aap ne is mein se ek boti le kar kuch khai phir ise handiya mein daal diya aur farmaya lo Allah ka naam lo aur khana shuru karo. Sab ne khana shuru kiya yahan tak ke pet bhar gaye lekin Allah ki qasam gosht utna hi tha jitna rakhte waqt rakha tha, sirf in ki ungliyon ke nishanat toh the magar gosht kuch bhi na ghata tha, halankeh in mein se ek ek itna gosht toh kha leta tha. Phir mujh se farmaya ae Ali inhe pilao. Main woh budhna laya, sab ne bari bari shikam-seer ho kar piya aur khoob aasooda ho gaye lekin doodh bilkul kam na hua, halankeh in mein se ek ek itna doodh pi liya karta tha. Ab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kuch farmana chaha lekin Abu Lahab jaldi se uth khada hua aur kehne laga, lo sahab ab maloom hua ke yeh tamam jadugari mahaz is liye thi. Chunancha majma isi waqt ukhad gaya aur har ek apni raah lag gaya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko nasihat-o-tableegh ka mauqa na mila. Dusre roz Aap ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) se farmaya aaj phir isi tarah in sab ki dawat karo kyunke kal us ne mujhe kuch kehne ka waqt hi nahin diya. Maine phir isi tarah ka intezam kiya, sab ko dawat di, aaye khaya piya, phir kal ki tarah aaj bhi Abu Lahab ne khade ho kar wahi baat kahi aur isi tarah sab tatar-batar ho gaye. Teesre din phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) se yahi farmaya, aaj jab sab kha pi chuke toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jaldi se apni guftagu shuru kar di aur farmaya, ae Banu Abdul Muttalib, wallah koi naujawan shakhs apni qoum ke paas is se behtar bhalai nahin laya jo main tumhare paas laya hoon, main duniya aur aakhirat ki bhalai laya hoon. Aur riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Aap ne farmaya ke ab batao tum mein se kaun mere sath ittefaq karta hai aur kaun mera sath deta hai? Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ka hukm hua hai ke pehle main tumhein is ki dawat doon, jo aaj meri maan le ga woh mera bhai hoga aur yeh darje milenge.

Log sab khamosh hogaye lekin Hazrat Ali R.A jo us waqt is majmay mein sab se kam umr thay aur dukhti aankhon walay aur motay pait walay aur bhari pindliyon walay thay, bol uthay Ya Rasool Allah! Is amr mein aap ki wizarat mein qabool karta hoon. Aap ne meri gardan par haath rakh kar farmaya ke yeh mera bhai hai aur aisi fazilaton wala hai tum is ki suno aur mano. Yeh sun kar woh sab log hanstay huay uth kharay huay aur Abu Talib se kehnay lagay le ab tu apnay bachay ki sun aur maan lekin is ka rawi Abdul Ghaffar bin Qasim bin Abi Maryam matrook hai kazzab hai aur hai bhi Shia. Ibn-e-Madini waghera farmatay hain yeh hadeesain ghar liya karta tha, deegar aimma-e-hadees ne bhi is ko zaeef likha hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke is dawat mein sirf bakri ke aik paon ka gosht paka tha is mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ khutba denay lagay to unhon ne jhat se keh diya ke aaj jaisa jadoo to hum ne kabhi nahin dekha. Is par aap khamosh hogaye. Is mein aap ka khutba yeh hai ke kaun hai jo mera qarz apnay zimmay le aur meri ahl mein mera khalifa banay? Is par sab khamosh rahay aur Abbas R.A bhi chup thay sirf apnay maal ki bukhal ki wajah se. Main Abbas R.A ko khamosh dekh kar khamosh ho raha. Aap ne dobara yahi farmaya dobara bhi sab taraf khamoshi thi mujh se raha na gaya aur main bol para. Main us waqt in sab se giri pari halat wala, chandhi aankhon wala baray pait wala aur bojhal pindli wala tha. In riwayaton mein jo Huzoor ﷺ ka farman hai ke kaun mera qarz apnay zimmay leta hai aur meri ahl ki meray baad hifazat apnay zimmay leta hai? Is se matlab aap ka yeh tha ke jab main is tableegh-e-deen ko phailaon ga aur logon ko Allah ki tauheed ki taraf bulaon ga to sab ke sab meray dushman hojayen ge aur mujhay qatl kardain ge. Yahi khatka aap ko laga raha yahan tak ke yeh aayat utri (وَاللّٰهُ يَعْصِمُكَ مِنَ النَّاسِ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 67) Allah Ta'ala tujhay logon ki eza-rasani se bacha lay ga. Is waqt aap be-khatar hogaye. Is se pehlay aap apni pehra choki bhi bithatay thay lekin is aayat ke utarnay ke baad woh bhi hata di. Is waqt fi-alwaqay tamam Banu Hashim mein Hazrat Ali R.A se zyada imaan wala aur tasdeeq-o-yaqeen wala koi na tha. Is liye hi aap ne Huzoor ﷺ ke sath iqrar kiya. Is ke baad Huzoor ﷺ ne Koh-e-Safa par aam dawat di aur logon ko tauheed-e-khalis ki taraf bulaya aur apni nabuwwat ka elaan kiya. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke aik martaba Hazrat Abu Darda R.A apni masjid mein baithay huay wa'az farma rahay thay fatway de rahay thay. Majlis khacha-khach bhari hui thi. Har aik ki nigahain aap ke chehray par thin aur shauq se sun rahay thay lekin aap ke larkay aur ghar ke aadmi aapas mein be-parwahi se apni baton mein mashghool thay.

Kisi ne Hazrat Abu Darda R.A ki is taraf tawajjah dilayi ke aur sab log toh dil se aap ki ilmi baaton mein dilchaspi le rahe hain aur aap ke ahl-e-bait is se bilkul be-parwah hain, woh apni baaton mein nihayat be-parwahi se mashghool hain, toh aap ne jawab mein farmaya: Main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai, duniya se bilkul kinara-kashi karne wale Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) hote hain aur un par sab se zyada sakht aur bhari un ke qarabat-dar hue hain. Isi baare mein aayat (Wa-anzir se ta'maloon) tak hai. Phir farmata hai, apne tamam umoor mein Allah hi par bharosa rakho, wahi tumhara hafiz-o-nasir hai, wahi tumhari ta'eed karne wala aur tumhare kalme ko buland karne wala hai. Us ki nigahein har waqt tum par hain, jaise farman hai: Aayat (WASHBIR LI-HUKMI RABBIKA FA-INNAKA BI-A'YUNINA WASABBIH BI-HAMDI RABBIKA HEENA TAQOOM) (Surah At-Tur: 48). Apne Rab ke hukmon par sabr kar, tu hamari aankhon ke samne hai. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke jab tu namaz ke liye khada hota hai toh hamari aankhon ke samne hota hai. Hum tumhare ruku-sujood dekhte hain, khade ho ya baithe ho ya kisi halat mein ho, hamari nazron mein ho. Yani tanhayi mein toh namaz padhe toh hum dekhte hain aur jamaat se padhe toh tu hamari nigah ke samne hota hai. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke Allah Ta'ala halat-e-namaz mein aap ko jis tarah aap ke samne ki cheezein dikhata tha, aap ﷺ ke peeche ke muqtadi bhi aap ﷺ ki nigah mein rehte the. Chunancha sahih hadith mein hai, Huzoor ﷺ farmaya karte the, safein durust kar liya karo, main tumhein apne peeche se dekhta rehta hoon. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A yeh matlab bhi bayan karte hain ke ek Nabi ki peeth se dusre Nabi ki peeth ki taraf muntaqil hona barabar dekhte rahe hain, yahan tak ke aap bahaisiyat-e-Nabi duniya mein aaye. Woh Allah apne bandon ki baatein khoob sunta hai, un ki harkaat-o-saknaat ko khoob jaanta hai, jaise farmata hai: Aayat (WAMA TAKOONU FEE SHA'NIN WAMA TATLOO MINHU MIN QUR'ANIN WALA TA'MALOONA MIN AMALIN ILLA KUNNA ALAIKUM SHUHOODAN IDH TUFEEDOONA FEEH) (Surah Yunus: 61), toh jis halat mein ho, tum jitna Quran padho, tum jo amal karo, us par hum shahid hain.

Mustahiq-e-saza logon se alag ho jao. Khud apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se khitab kar ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke sirf meri hi ibadat kar. Mere sath kisi ko sharik na kar, jo bhi aisa karega woh zaroor mustahiq-e-saza hai. Apne qareebi rishtedaron ko hoshiyar karde ke bajuz iman ke koi cheez nijat dahinda nahin. Phir hukum deta hai ke muwahid muttabi-e-sunnat logon se farotani ke sath milta julta reh. Aur jo bhi mere hukum na mane khwah koi ho to us se betaluq ho ja. Aur apni bezari ka izhar karde. Yeh khas taur ki khas logon ki tanbeeh aam logon ki tanbeeh ke manafi nahin kyunke yeh us ka juz hai. Aur jagah irshad hai: "Tu us qoum ko dara de jin ke bade bhi daraye nahin gaye aur jo ghaflat mein pade hue hain." Aur ayat mein hai: (وَلِتُنْذِرَ اُمَّ الْقُرٰي وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا 92؀) (Surah Al-An'am: 92) "Taake tu Makkah walon ko aur us ke gird walon ko sab ko daraye." Aur ayat mein hai: "Tu is Quran se unhein hoshiyar karde jo apne Rab ke paas jama hone se khauf zada ho rahe hain." Deegar ayat mein irshad farmaya ke: "Tu is Quran se parhezgaron ko khushkhabri suna de aur sarkashon ko dara de." Aur ayat mein farmaya: (لِاُنْذِرَكُمْ بِهٖ وَمَنْۢ بَلَغَ ۭ 19؀ۘ) (Surah Al-An'am: 19) "Taake main isi Quran ke sath tumhein aur jise bhi yeh pahunche dara doon." Aur farman hai: "Is ke sath in tamam firqon mein se jo bhi kufr kare us ki saza jahannam hai." Sahih Muslim ki hadith mein hai: "Us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, is ummat mein se jis ke kaan meri risalat ki baat pad jaye khwah Yahudi ho ya Nasrani, phir woh mujh par iman na laye to zaroor woh jahannam mein jayega." Is ayat ki tafsir mein bahut si hadithein hain, unhein sun lijiye. 001 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai: Jab Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat utari to An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Safa pahad par chadh gaye. Aur "Ya Sabaha" keh kar awaz di. Log jama ho gaye, jo nahin aa sakte the unhon ne apne aadmi bhej diye. Us waqt Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Ae aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib! Ae aulad-e-Fahr! Batao agar main tum se kahoon ke is pahad ki pusht par tumhare dushman ka lashkar pada hua hai aur ghaat mein hai, mauqa pate hi tum sab ko qatl kar dalega to kya tum mujhe sacha samjhoge?" Sab ne yak-zaban kaha ke haan, hum aap ko sacha hi samjhenge. Ab aap ne farmaya: "Sun lo, main tumhein aane wale sakht azabon se darane wala hoon." Is par Abu Lahab mal'oon ne kaha: "Tu halak ho jaye, yahi sunane ke liye to tune hamein bulaya tha?" Is ke jawab mein Surah Tabbat Yada utri (Bukhari, Muslim waghera). 002 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai: Is ayat ke utarte hi Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khade ho gaye aur farmane lage: "Ae Fatima bint-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Ae Safiya bint-e-Abdul Muttalib! Suno, main tumhein Allah ke haan kuch kaam nahin aa sakta. Haan, mere paas jo maal ho jitna tum chaho main dene ke liye tayyar hoon" (Muslim). 003 Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain ke is ayat ke utarte hi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Quraishiyon ko bulaya aur unhein ek-ek karke aur aam taur par khitab karke farmaya: "Ae Quraishiyo! Apni jaanein jahannam se bacha lo, ae Ka'ab ke khandan walo!"

Apni jaanein aag se bachalo, ae Hashim ki aulad ke logo! Apne aap ko Allah ke azabon se chhudwalo. Ae Abdul Muttalib ke ladko! Allah ke azabon se bachne ki koshish karo. Ae Fatima (R.A) bint-e-Muhammad! Apni jaan ko dozakh se bachale, qasam Allah ki, main Allah ke yahan ki kisi cheez ka maalik nahin. Beshak tumhari qarabat-dari hai, jis ke dunyawi haqooq main har tarah ada karne ko tayyar hoon. (Muslim waghera). Bukhari, Muslim mein bhi qadre alfaaz ki tabdeeli se yeh hadith marwi hai, ismein yeh bhi hai ke aap (ﷺ) ne apni phuphi Hazrat Safiya (R.A) aur apni sahibzadi Hazrat Fatima (R.A) se yeh bhi farmaya ke mere maal mein se jo chaho mujh se talab karlo. Abu Ya'la mein hai ke aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Qusay, ae Hashim, ae Abd-e-Manaf ki aulado! Yaad rakho main darane wala hoon aur maut badla dene wali hai, is ka chhapa padne hi wala hai aur Qayamat wa'da-gah hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ) par yeh aayat utri to aap (ﷺ) ek pahadi par chadh gaye jis ki choti par patthar the, wahan pahunch kar aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Bani Abd-e-Manaf! Main to sirf chaukanna kar dene wala hoon, meri aur tumhari misaal aisi hai jaise kisi shakhs ne dushman ko dekha aur daud kar apne azizon ko hoshiyar karne ke liye aaya taake woh bachao kar lein, door se hi us ne ghul machana shuru kar diya ke pehle hi khabardar ho jayein. (Muslim, Nasai waghera). Hazrat Ali (R.A) se marwi hai ke jab yeh aayat utri to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apne Ahl-e-Bait ko jama kar liya, yeh tees shakhs the. Jab yeh kha pee chuke to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Kaun hai jo mera qarz apne zimme le aur mere baad mere wa'de poore kare, woh Jannat mein bhi mera saathi aur meri ahl mein khalifa hoga. To ek shakhs ne kaha: Aap to samundar hain, aap ke saath kaun khada ho sakta hai? Teen dafa aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya lekin koi tayyar na hua, to main ne kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Main is ke liye tayyar hoon. (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ek aur sanad mein is se zyada tafseel ke saath marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Banu Abdul Muttalib ko jama kiya, yeh ek jamaat ki jamaat thi aur bade khaoo the, ek shakhs ek-ek bakri ka bacha kha jata tha aur ek bada budhna doodh ka pee jata tha. Aap (ﷺ) ne un sab ke khane ke liye sirf teen pao ke qareeb khana pakwaya, lekin Allah ne isi mein itni barkat di ke sab pet bhar kar kha chuke aur khoob aasooda ho kar pee chuke, lekin na to khane mein kami nazar aayi thi na peene ki cheez ghatti hui maloom hoti thi. Phir aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib! Main tumhari taraf khusoosan aur tamam logon ki taraf umooman Nabi bana kar bheja gaya hoon. Is waqt tum ek mo'jiza bhi mera dekh chuke ho. Ab tum mein se kaun tayyar hai ke mujh se bai'at kare, woh mera bhai aur mera saathi hoga? Lekin ek shakhs bhi majmay se khada na hua siwaye mere aur main is waqt umr ke lihaz se un sab se chhota tha. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Tum baith jao. Teen martaba aap (ﷺ) ne yahi farmaya aur teenon martaba bajuz mere aur koi khada na hua. Teesri martaba aap (ﷺ) ne meri bai'at li.

Is waqt fi-alwaqay tamam Banu Hashim mein Hazrat Ali R.A se zyada imaan wala aur tasdeeq-o-yaqeen wala koi na tha. Is liye hi aap ne Huzoor ﷺ ke sath iqrar kiya. Is ke baad Huzoor ﷺ ne Koh-e-Safa par aam dawat di aur logon ko tauheed-e-khalis ki taraf bulaya aur apni nabuwwat ka elaan kiya. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke aik martaba Hazrat Abu Darda R.A apni masjid mein baithay huay wa'az farma rahay thay fatway de rahay thay. Majlis khacha-khach bhari hui thi. Har aik ki nigahain aap ke chehray par thin aur shauq se sun rahay thay lekin aap ke larkay aur ghar ke aadmi aapas mein be-parwahi se apni baton mein mashghool thay.

Kisi ne Hazrat Abu Darda R.A ki is taraf tawajjah dilayi ke aur sab log toh dil se aap ki ilmi baaton mein dilchaspi le rahe hain aur aap ke ahl-e-bait is se bilkul be-parwah hain, woh apni baaton mein nihayat be-parwahi se mashghool hain, toh aap ne jawab mein farmaya: Main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai, duniya se bilkul kinara-kashi karne wale Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) hote hain aur un par sab se zyada sakht aur bhari un ke qarabat-dar hue hain. Isi baare mein aayat (Wa-anzir se ta'maloon) tak hai. Phir farmata hai, apne tamam umoor mein Allah hi par bharosa rakho, wahi tumhara hafiz-o-nasir hai, wahi tumhari ta'eed karne wala aur tumhare kalme ko buland karne wala hai. Us ki nigahein har waqt tum par hain, jaise farman hai: Aayat (WASHBIR LI-HUKMI RABBIKA FA-INNAKA BI-A'YUNINA WASABBIH BI-HAMDI RABBIKA HEENA TAQOOM) (Surah At-Tur: 48). Apne Rab ke hukmon par sabr kar, tu hamari aankhon ke samne hai. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke jab tu namaz ke liye khada hota hai toh hamari aankhon ke samne hota hai. Hum tumhare ruku-sujood dekhte hain, khade ho ya baithe ho ya kisi halat mein ho, hamari nazron mein ho. Yani tanhayi mein toh namaz padhe toh hum dekhte hain aur jamaat se padhe toh tu hamari nigah ke samne hota hai. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke Allah Ta'ala halat-e-namaz mein aap ko jis tarah aap ke samne ki cheezein dikhata tha, aap ﷺ ke peeche ke muqtadi bhi aap ﷺ ki nigah mein rehte the. Chunancha sahih hadith mein hai, Huzoor ﷺ farmaya karte the, safein durust kar liya karo, main tumhein apne peeche se dekhta rehta hoon. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A yeh matlab bhi bayan karte hain ke ek Nabi ki peeth se dusre Nabi ki peeth ki taraf muntaqil hona barabar dekhte rahe hain, yahan tak ke aap bahaisiyat-e-Nabi duniya mein aaye. Woh Allah apne bandon ki baatein khoob sunta hai, un ki harkaat-o-saknaat ko khoob jaanta hai, jaise farmata hai: Aayat (WAMA TAKOONU FEE SHA'NIN WAMA TATLOO MINHU MIN QUR'ANIN WALA TA'MALOONA MIN AMALIN ILLA KUNNA ALAIKUM SHUHOODAN IDH TUFEEDOONA FEEH) (Surah Yunus: 61), toh jis halat mein ho, tum jitna Quran padho, tum jo amal karo, us par hum shahid hain.

Mustahiq-e-saza logon se alag ho jao. Khud apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se khitab kar ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke sirf meri hi ibadat kar. Mere sath kisi ko sharik na kar, jo bhi aisa karega woh zaroor mustahiq-e-saza hai. Apne qareebi rishtedaron ko hoshiyar karde ke bajuz iman ke koi cheez nijat dahinda nahin. Phir hukum deta hai ke muwahid muttabi-e-sunnat logon se farotani ke sath milta julta reh. Aur jo bhi mere hukum na mane khwah koi ho to us se betaluq ho ja. Aur apni bezari ka izhar karde. Yeh khas taur ki khas logon ki tanbeeh aam logon ki tanbeeh ke manafi nahin kyunke yeh us ka juz hai. Aur jagah irshad hai: "Tu us qoum ko dara de jin ke bade bhi daraye nahin gaye aur jo ghaflat mein pade hue hain." Aur ayat mein hai: (وَلِتُنْذِرَ اُمَّ الْقُرٰي وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا 92؀) (Surah Al-An'am: 92) "Taake tu Makkah walon ko aur us ke gird walon ko sab ko daraye." Aur ayat mein hai: "Tu is Quran se unhein hoshiyar karde jo apne Rab ke paas jama hone se khauf zada ho rahe hain." Deegar ayat mein irshad farmaya ke: "Tu is Quran se parhezgaron ko khushkhabri suna de aur sarkashon ko dara de." Aur ayat mein farmaya: (لِاُنْذِرَكُمْ بِهٖ وَمَنْۢ بَلَغَ ۭ 19؀ۘ) (Surah Al-An'am: 19) "Taake main isi Quran ke sath tumhein aur jise bhi yeh pahunche dara doon." Aur farman hai: "Is ke sath in tamam firqon mein se jo bhi kufr kare us ki saza jahannam hai." Sahih Muslim ki hadith mein hai: "Us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, is ummat mein se jis ke kaan meri risalat ki baat pad jaye khwah Yahudi ho ya Nasrani, phir woh mujh par iman na laye to zaroor woh jahannam mein jayega." Is ayat ki tafsir mein bahut si hadithein hain, unhein sun lijiye. 001 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai: Jab Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat utari to An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Safa pahad par chadh gaye. Aur "Ya Sabaha" keh kar awaz di. Log jama ho gaye, jo nahin aa sakte the unhon ne apne aadmi bhej diye. Us waqt Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Ae aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib! Ae aulad-e-Fahr! Batao agar main tum se kahoon ke is pahad ki pusht par tumhare dushman ka lashkar pada hua hai aur ghaat mein hai, mauqa pate hi tum sab ko qatl kar dalega to kya tum mujhe sacha samjhoge?" Sab ne yak-zaban kaha ke haan, hum aap ko sacha hi samjhenge. Ab aap ne farmaya: "Sun lo, main tumhein aane wale sakht azabon se darane wala hoon." Is par Abu Lahab mal'oon ne kaha: "Tu halak ho jaye, yahi sunane ke liye to tune hamein bulaya tha?" Is ke jawab mein Surah Tabbat Yada utri (Bukhari, Muslim waghera). 002 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai: Is ayat ke utarte hi Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khade ho gaye aur farmane lage: "Ae Fatima bint-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Ae Safiya bint-e-Abdul Muttalib! Suno, main tumhein Allah ke haan kuch kaam nahin aa sakta. Haan, mere paas jo maal ho jitna tum chaho main dene ke liye tayyar hoon" (Muslim). 003 Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain ke is ayat ke utarte hi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Quraishiyon ko bulaya aur unhein ek-ek karke aur aam taur par khitab karke farmaya: "Ae Quraishiyo! Apni jaanein jahannam se bacha lo, ae Ka'ab ke khandan walo!"

Apni jaanein aag se bachalo, ae Hashim ki aulad ke logo! Apne aap ko Allah ke azabon se chhudwalo. Ae Abdul Muttalib ke ladko! Allah ke azabon se bachne ki koshish karo. Ae Fatima (R.A) bint-e-Muhammad! Apni jaan ko dozakh se bachale, qasam Allah ki, main Allah ke yahan ki kisi cheez ka maalik nahin. Beshak tumhari qarabat-dari hai, jis ke dunyawi haqooq main har tarah ada karne ko tayyar hoon. (Muslim waghera). Bukhari, Muslim mein bhi qadre alfaaz ki tabdeeli se yeh hadith marwi hai, ismein yeh bhi hai ke aap (ﷺ) ne apni phuphi Hazrat Safiya (R.A) aur apni sahibzadi Hazrat Fatima (R.A) se yeh bhi farmaya ke mere maal mein se jo chaho mujh se talab karlo. Abu Ya'la mein hai ke aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Qusay, ae Hashim, ae Abd-e-Manaf ki aulado! Yaad rakho main darane wala hoon aur maut badla dene wali hai, is ka chhapa padne hi wala hai aur Qayamat wa'da-gah hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ) par yeh aayat utri to aap (ﷺ) ek pahadi par chadh gaye jis ki choti par patthar the, wahan pahunch kar aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Bani Abd-e-Manaf! Main to sirf chaukanna kar dene wala hoon, meri aur tumhari misaal aisi hai jaise kisi shakhs ne dushman ko dekha aur daud kar apne azizon ko hoshiyar karne ke liye aaya taake woh bachao kar lein, door se hi us ne ghul machana shuru kar diya ke pehle hi khabardar ho jayein. (Muslim, Nasai waghera). Hazrat Ali (R.A) se marwi hai ke jab yeh aayat utri to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apne Ahl-e-Bait ko jama kar liya, yeh tees shakhs the. Jab yeh kha pee chuke to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Kaun hai jo mera qarz apne zimme le aur mere baad mere wa'de poore kare, woh Jannat mein bhi mera saathi aur meri ahl mein khalifa hoga. To ek shakhs ne kaha: Aap to samundar hain, aap ke saath kaun khada ho sakta hai? Teen dafa aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya lekin koi tayyar na hua, to main ne kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Main is ke liye tayyar hoon. (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ek aur sanad mein is se zyada tafseel ke saath marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Banu Abdul Muttalib ko jama kiya, yeh ek jamaat ki jamaat thi aur bade khaoo the, ek shakhs ek-ek bakri ka bacha kha jata tha aur ek bada budhna doodh ka pee jata tha. Aap (ﷺ) ne un sab ke khane ke liye sirf teen pao ke qareeb khana pakwaya, lekin Allah ne isi mein itni barkat di ke sab pet bhar kar kha chuke aur khoob aasooda ho kar pee chuke, lekin na to khane mein kami nazar aayi thi na peene ki cheez ghatti hui maloom hoti thi. Phir aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib! Main tumhari taraf khusoosan aur tamam logon ki taraf umooman Nabi bana kar bheja gaya hoon. Is waqt tum ek mo'jiza bhi mera dekh chuke ho. Ab tum mein se kaun tayyar hai ke mujh se bai'at kare, woh mera bhai aur mera saathi hoga? Lekin ek shakhs bhi majmay se khada na hua siwaye mere aur main is waqt umr ke lihaz se un sab se chhota tha. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Tum baith jao. Teen martaba aap (ﷺ) ne yahi farmaya aur teenon martaba bajuz mere aur koi khada na hua. Teesri martaba aap (ﷺ) ne meri bai'at li.

Imam Baihaqi (R.H) Dala'il-un-Nubuwwah mein laye hain ke jab yeh aayat utri toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar main apni qoum ke samne abhi hi ise pesh karunga toh woh na manenge. Aur aisa jawab denge jo mujh par garan guzre, pas Aap khamosh ho gaye. Itne mein Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S) aaye aur farmane lage, Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) agar aap ne tameel-e-irshad mein takheer ki toh dar hai ke aap ko saza hogi. Isi waqt Aap ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) ko bulaya aur farmaya, mujhe hukm hua hai ke main apne qareebi rishtedaron ko dara doon. Maine yeh khayal karke agar pehle hi se in se kaha gaya toh yeh mujhe aisa jawab denge jis se mujhe eeza pahunche main khamosh raha, lekin Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S) aaye aur kaha ke agar tu ne aisa na kiya toh tujhe azaab hoga. Toh ab ae Ali tum ek bakri zibah karke gosht pakalo aur koi teen seer anaaj bhi tayyar karlo aur ek budhna doodh ka bhi bhar lo aur aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib ko bhi jama karlo. Maine aisa hi kiya aur sab ko dawat de di, chalis aadmi jama hue ya ek aadh kam ya ek aadh zyada, in mein Aap ke chacha bhi the, Abu Talib, Hamza, Abbas, aur Abu Lahab kafir khabeeth. Maine saalan pesh kiya toh Aap ne is mein se ek boti le kar kuch khai phir ise handiya mein daal diya aur farmaya lo Allah ka naam lo aur khana shuru karo. Sab ne khana shuru kiya yahan tak ke pet bhar gaye lekin Allah ki qasam gosht utna hi tha jitna rakhte waqt rakha tha, sirf in ki ungliyon ke nishanat toh the magar gosht kuch bhi na ghata tha, halankeh in mein se ek ek itna gosht toh kha leta tha. Phir mujh se farmaya ae Ali inhe pilao. Main woh budhna laya, sab ne bari bari shikam-seer ho kar piya aur khoob aasooda ho gaye lekin doodh bilkul kam na hua, halankeh in mein se ek ek itna doodh pi liya karta tha. Ab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kuch farmana chaha lekin Abu Lahab jaldi se uth khada hua aur kehne laga, lo sahab ab maloom hua ke yeh tamam jadugari mahaz is liye thi. Chunancha majma isi waqt ukhad gaya aur har ek apni raah lag gaya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko nasihat-o-tableegh ka mauqa na mila. Dusre roz Aap ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) se farmaya aaj phir isi tarah in sab ki dawat karo kyunke kal us ne mujhe kuch kehne ka waqt hi nahin diya. Maine phir isi tarah ka intezam kiya, sab ko dawat di, aaye khaya piya, phir kal ki tarah aaj bhi Abu Lahab ne khade ho kar wahi baat kahi aur isi tarah sab tatar-batar ho gaye. Teesre din phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) se yahi farmaya, aaj jab sab kha pi chuke toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jaldi se apni guftagu shuru kar di aur farmaya, ae Banu Abdul Muttalib, wallah koi naujawan shakhs apni qoum ke paas is se behtar bhalai nahin laya jo main tumhare paas laya hoon, main duniya aur aakhirat ki bhalai laya hoon. Aur riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Aap ne farmaya ke ab batao tum mein se kaun mere sath ittefaq karta hai aur kaun mera sath deta hai? Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ka hukm hua hai ke pehle main tumhein is ki dawat doon, jo aaj meri maan le ga woh mera bhai hoga aur yeh darje milenge.

Log sab khamosh hogaye lekin Hazrat Ali R.A jo us waqt is majmay mein sab se kam umr thay aur dukhti aankhon walay aur motay pait walay aur bhari pindliyon walay thay, bol uthay Ya Rasool Allah! Is amr mein aap ki wizarat mein qabool karta hoon. Aap ne meri gardan par haath rakh kar farmaya ke yeh mera bhai hai aur aisi fazilaton wala hai tum is ki suno aur mano. Yeh sun kar woh sab log hanstay huay uth kharay huay aur Abu Talib se kehnay lagay le ab tu apnay bachay ki sun aur maan lekin is ka rawi Abdul Ghaffar bin Qasim bin Abi Maryam matrook hai kazzab hai aur hai bhi Shia. Ibn-e-Madini waghera farmatay hain yeh hadeesain ghar liya karta tha, deegar aimma-e-hadees ne bhi is ko zaeef likha hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke is dawat mein sirf bakri ke aik paon ka gosht paka tha is mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ khutba denay lagay to unhon ne jhat se keh diya ke aaj jaisa jadoo to hum ne kabhi nahin dekha. Is par aap khamosh hogaye. Is mein aap ka khutba yeh hai ke kaun hai jo mera qarz apnay zimmay le aur meri ahl mein mera khalifa banay? Is par sab khamosh rahay aur Abbas R.A bhi chup thay sirf apnay maal ki bukhal ki wajah se. Main Abbas R.A ko khamosh dekh kar khamosh ho raha. Aap ne dobara yahi farmaya dobara bhi sab taraf khamoshi thi mujh se raha na gaya aur main bol para. Main us waqt in sab se giri pari halat wala, chandhi aankhon wala baray pait wala aur bojhal pindli wala tha. In riwayaton mein jo Huzoor ﷺ ka farman hai ke kaun mera qarz apnay zimmay leta hai aur meri ahl ki meray baad hifazat apnay zimmay leta hai? Is se matlab aap ka yeh tha ke jab main is tableegh-e-deen ko phailaon ga aur logon ko Allah ki tauheed ki taraf bulaon ga to sab ke sab meray dushman hojayen ge aur mujhay qatl kardain ge. Aur "Ya Sabaha" keh kar awaz di. Log jama ho gaye, jo nahin aa sakte the unhon ne apne aadmi bhej diye. Us waqt Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Ae aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib! Ae aulad-e-Fahr! Batao agar main tum se kahoon ke is pahad ki pusht par tumhare dushman ka lashkar pada hua hai aur ghaat mein hai, mauqa pate hi tum sab ko qatl kar dalega to kya tum mujhe sacha samjhoge?" Sab ne yak-zaban kaha ke haan, hum aap ko sacha hi samjhenge. Ab aap ne farmaya: "Sun lo, main tumhein aane wale sakht azabon se darane wala hoon." Is par Abu Lahab mal'oon ne kaha: "Tu halak ho jaye, yahi sunane ke liye to tune hamein bulaya tha?" Is ke jawab mein Surah Tabbat Yada utri (Bukhari, Muslim waghera). 002 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai: Is ayat ke utarte hi Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khade ho gaye aur farmane lage: "Ae Fatima bint-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Ae Safiya bint-e-Abdul Muttalib! Suno, main tumhein Allah ke haan kuch kaam nahin aa sakta. Haan, mere paas jo maal ho jitna tum chaho main dene ke liye tayyar hoon" (Muslim). 003 Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain ke is ayat ke utarte hi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Quraishiyon ko bulaya aur unhein ek-ek karke aur aam taur par khitab karke farmaya: "Ae Quraishiyo! Apni jaanein jahannam se bacha lo, ae Ka'ab ke khandan walo!"

Apni jaanein aag se bachalo, ae Hashim ki aulad ke logo! Apne aap ko Allah ke azabon se chhudwalo. Ae Abdul Muttalib ke ladko! Allah ke azabon se bachne ki koshish karo. Ae Fatima (R.A) bint-e-Muhammad! Apni jaan ko dozakh se bachale, qasam Allah ki, main Allah ke yahan ki kisi cheez ka maalik nahin. Beshak tumhari qarabat-dari hai, jis ke dunyawi haqooq main har tarah ada karne ko tayyar hoon. (Muslim waghera). Bukhari, Muslim mein bhi qadre alfaaz ki tabdeeli se yeh hadith marwi hai, ismein yeh bhi hai ke aap (ﷺ) ne apni phuphi Hazrat Safiya (R.A) aur apni sahibzadi Hazrat Fatima (R.A) se yeh bhi farmaya ke mere maal mein se jo chaho mujh se talab karlo. Abu Ya'la mein hai ke aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Qusay, ae Hashim, ae Abd-e-Manaf ki aulado! Yaad rakho main darane wala hoon aur maut badla dene wali hai, is ka chhapa padne hi wala hai aur Qayamat wa'da-gah hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ) par yeh aayat utri to aap (ﷺ) ek pahadi par chadh gaye jis ki choti par patthar the, wahan pahunch kar aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Bani Abd-e-Manaf! Main to sirf chaukanna kar dene wala hoon, meri aur tumhari misaal aisi hai jaise kisi shakhs ne dushman ko dekha aur daud kar apne azizon ko hoshiyar karne ke liye aaya taake woh bachao kar lein, door se hi us ne ghul machana shuru kar diya ke pehle hi khabardar ho jayein. (Muslim, Nasai waghera). Hazrat Ali (R.A) se marwi hai ke jab yeh aayat utri to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apne Ahl-e-Bait ko jama kar liya, yeh tees shakhs the. Jab yeh kha pee chuke to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Kaun hai jo mera qarz apne zimme le aur mere baad mere wa'de poore kare, woh Jannat mein bhi mera saathi aur meri ahl mein khalifa hoga. To ek shakhs ne kaha: Aap to samundar hain, aap ke saath kaun khada ho sakta hai? Teen dafa aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya lekin koi tayyar na hua, to main ne kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Main is ke liye tayyar hoon. (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ek aur sanad mein is se zyada tafseel ke saath marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Banu Abdul Muttalib ko jama kiya, yeh ek jamaat ki jamaat thi aur bade khaoo the, ek shakhs ek-ek bakri ka bacha kha jata tha aur ek bada budhna doodh ka pee jata tha. Aap (ﷺ) ne un sab ke khane ke liye sirf teen pao ke qareeb khana pakwaya, lekin Allah ne isi mein itni barkat di ke sab pet bhar kar kha chuke aur khoob aasooda ho kar pee chuke, lekin na to khane mein kami nazar aayi thi na peene ki cheez ghatti hui maloom hoti thi. Phir aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib! Main tumhari taraf khusoosan aur tamam logon ki taraf umooman Nabi bana kar bheja gaya hoon. Is waqt tum ek mo'jiza bhi mera dekh chuke ho. Ab tum mein se kaun tayyar hai ke mujh se bai'at kare, woh mera bhai aur mera saathi hoga? Lekin ek shakhs bhi majmay se khada na hua siwaye mere aur main is waqt umr ke lihaz se un sab se chhota tha. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Tum baith jao. Teen martaba aap (ﷺ) ne yahi farmaya aur teenon martaba bajuz mere aur koi khada na hua. Teesri martaba aap (ﷺ) ne meri bai'at li.

Imam Baihaqi (R.H) Dala'il-un-Nubuwwah mein laye hain ke jab yeh aayat utri toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar main apni qoum ke samne abhi hi ise pesh karunga toh woh na manenge. Aur aisa jawab denge jo mujh par garan guzre, pas Aap khamosh ho gaye. Itne mein Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S) aaye aur farmane lage, Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) agar aap ne tameel-e-irshad mein takheer ki toh dar hai ke aap ko saza hogi. Isi waqt Aap ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) ko bulaya aur farmaya, mujhe hukm hua hai ke main apne qareebi rishtedaron ko dara doon. Maine yeh khayal karke agar pehle hi se in se kaha gaya toh yeh mujhe aisa jawab denge jis se mujhe eeza pahunche main khamosh raha, lekin Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S) aaye aur kaha ke agar tu ne aisa na kiya toh tujhe azaab hoga. Toh ab ae Ali tum ek bakri zibah karke gosht pakalo aur koi teen seer anaaj bhi tayyar karlo aur ek budhna doodh ka bhi bhar lo aur aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib ko bhi jama karlo. Maine aisa hi kiya aur sab ko dawat de di, chalis aadmi jama hue ya ek aadh kam ya ek aadh zyada, in mein Aap ke chacha bhi the, Abu Talib, Hamza, Abbas, aur Abu Lahab kafir khabeeth. Maine saalan pesh kiya toh Aap ne is mein se ek boti le kar kuch khai phir ise handiya mein daal diya aur farmaya lo Allah ka naam lo aur khana shuru karo. Sab ne khana shuru kiya yahan tak ke pet bhar gaye lekin Allah ki qasam gosht utna hi tha jitna rakhte waqt rakha tha, sirf in ki ungliyon ke nishanat toh the magar gosht kuch bhi na ghata tha, halankeh in mein se ek ek itna gosht toh kha leta tha. Phir mujh se farmaya ae Ali inhe pilao. Main woh budhna laya, sab ne bari bari shikam-seer ho kar piya aur khoob aasooda ho gaye lekin doodh bilkul kam na hua, halankeh in mein se ek ek itna doodh pi liya karta tha. Ab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kuch farmana chaha lekin Abu Lahab jaldi se uth khada hua aur kehne laga, lo sahab ab maloom hua ke yeh tamam jadugari mahaz is liye thi. Chunancha majma isi waqt ukhad gaya aur har ek apni raah lag gaya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko nasihat-o-tableegh ka mauqa na mila. Dusre roz Aap ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) se farmaya aaj phir isi tarah in sab ki dawat karo kyunke kal us ne mujhe kuch kehne ka waqt hi nahin diya. Maine phir isi tarah ka intezam kiya, sab ko dawat di, aaye khaya piya, phir kal ki tarah aaj bhi Abu Lahab ne khade ho kar wahi baat kahi aur isi tarah sab tatar-batar ho gaye. Teesre din phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) se yahi farmaya, aaj jab sab kha pi chuke toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jaldi se apni guftagu shuru kar di aur farmaya, ae Banu Abdul Muttalib, wallah koi naujawan shakhs apni qoum ke paas is se behtar bhalai nahin laya jo main tumhare paas laya hoon, main duniya aur aakhirat ki bhalai laya hoon. Aur riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Aap ne farmaya ke ab batao tum mein se kaun mere sath ittefaq karta hai aur kaun mera sath deta hai? Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ka hukm hua hai ke pehle main tumhein is ki dawat doon, jo aaj meri maan le ga woh mera bhai hoga aur yeh darje milenge.

Log sab khamosh hogaye lekin Hazrat Ali R.A jo us waqt is majmay mein sab se kam umr thay aur dukhti aankhon walay aur motay pait walay aur bhari pindliyon walay thay, bol uthay Ya Rasool Allah! Is amr mein aap ki wizarat mein qabool karta hoon. Aap ne meri gardan par haath rakh kar farmaya ke yeh mera bhai hai aur aisi fazilaton wala hai tum is ki suno aur mano. Yeh sun kar woh sab log hanstay huay uth kharay huay aur Abu Talib se kehnay lagay le ab tu apnay bachay ki sun aur maan lekin is ka rawi Abdul Ghaffar bin Qasim bin Abi Maryam matrook hai kazzab hai aur hai bhi Shia. Ibn-e-Madini waghera farmatay hain yeh hadeesain ghar liya karta tha, deegar aimma-e-hadees ne bhi is ko zaeef likha hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke is dawat mein sirf bakri ke aik paon ka gosht paka tha is mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ khutba denay lagay to unhon ne jhat se keh diya ke aaj jaisa jadoo to hum ne kabhi nahin dekha. Is par aap khamosh hogaye. Is mein aap ka khutba yeh hai ke kaun hai jo mera qarz apnay zimmay le aur meri ahl mein mera khalifa banay? Is par sab khamosh rahay aur Abbas R.A bhi chup thay sirf apnay maal ki bukhal ki wajah se. Main Abbas R.A ko khamosh dekh kar khamosh ho raha. Aap ne dobara yahi farmaya dobara bhi sab taraf khamoshi thi mujh se raha na gaya aur main bol para. Main us waqt in sab se giri pari halat wala, chandhi aankhon wala baray pait wala aur bojhal pindli wala tha. In riwayaton mein jo Huzoor ﷺ ka farman hai ke kaun mera qarz apnay zimmay leta hai aur meri ahl ki meray baad hifazat apnay zimmay leta hai? Is se matlab aap ka yeh tha ke jab main is tableegh-e-deen ko phailaon ga aur logon ko Allah ki tauheed ki taraf bulaon ga to sab ke sab meray dushman hojayen ge aur mujhay qatl kardain ge. Yahi khatka aap ko laga raha yahan tak ke yeh aayat utri (وَاللّٰهُ يَعْصِمُكَ مِنَ النَّاسِ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 67) Allah Ta'ala tujhay logon ki eza-rasani se bacha lay ga. Is waqt aap be-khatar hogaye. Is se pehlay aap apni pehra choki bhi bithatay thay lekin is aayat ke utarnay ke baad woh bhi hata di. Is waqt fi-alwaqay tamam Banu Hashim mein Hazrat Ali R.A se zyada imaan wala aur tasdeeq-o-yaqeen wala koi na tha. Is liye hi aap ne Huzoor ﷺ ke sath iqrar kiya. Is ke baad Huzoor ﷺ ne Koh-e-Safa par aam dawat di aur logon ko tauheed-e-khalis ki taraf bulaya aur apni nabuwwat ka elaan kiya. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke aik martaba Hazrat Abu Darda R.A apni masjid mein baithay huay wa'az farma rahay thay fatway de rahay thay. Majlis khacha-khach bhari hui thi. Har aik ki nigahain aap ke chehray par thin aur shauq se sun rahay thay lekin aap ke larkay aur ghar ke aadmi aapas mein be-parwahi se apni baton mein mashghool thay.

Kisi ne Hazrat Abu Darda R.A ki is taraf tawajjah dilayi ke aur sab log toh dil se aap ki ilmi baaton mein dilchaspi le rahe hain aur aap ke ahl-e-bait is se bilkul be-parwah hain, woh apni baaton mein nihayat be-parwahi se mashghool hain, toh aap ne jawab mein farmaya: Main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai, duniya se bilkul kinara-kashi karne wale Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) hote hain aur un par sab se zyada sakht aur bhari un ke qarabat-dar hue hain. Isi baare mein aayat (Wa-anzir se ta'maloon) tak hai. Phir farmata hai, apne tamam umoor mein Allah hi par bharosa rakho, wahi tumhara hafiz-o-nasir hai, wahi tumhari ta'eed karne wala aur tumhare kalme ko buland karne wala hai. Us ki nigahein har waqt tum par hain, jaise farman hai: Aayat (WASHBIR LI-HUKMI RABBIKA FA-INNAKA BI-A'YUNINA WASABBIH BI-HAMDI RABBIKA HEENA TAQOOM) (Surah At-Tur: 48). Apne Rab ke hukmon par sabr kar, tu hamari aankhon ke samne hai. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke jab tu namaz ke liye khada hota hai toh hamari aankhon ke samne hota hai. Hum tumhare ruku-sujood dekhte hain, khade ho ya baithe ho ya kisi halat mein ho, hamari nazron mein ho. Yani tanhayi mein toh namaz padhe toh hum dekhte hain aur jamaat se padhe toh tu hamari nigah ke samne hota hai. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke Allah Ta'ala halat-e-namaz mein aap ko jis tarah aap ke samne ki cheezein dikhata tha, aap ﷺ ke peeche ke muqtadi bhi aap ﷺ ki nigah mein rehte the. Chunancha sahih hadith mein hai, Huzoor ﷺ farmaya karte the, safein durust kar liya karo, main tumhein apne peeche se dekhta rehta hoon. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A yeh matlab bhi bayan karte hain ke ek Nabi ki peeth se dusre Nabi ki peeth ki taraf muntaqil hona barabar dekhte rahe hain, yahan tak ke aap bahaisiyat-e-Nabi duniya mein aaye. Woh Allah apne bandon ki baatein khoob sunta hai, un ki harkaat-o-saknaat ko khoob jaanta hai, jaise farmata hai: Aayat (WAMA TAKOONU FEE SHA'NIN WAMA TATLOO MINHU MIN QUR'ANIN WALA TA'MALOONA MIN AMALIN ILLA KUNNA ALAIKUM SHUHOODAN IDH TUFEEDOONA FEEH) (Surah Yunus: 61), toh jis halat mein ho, tum jitna Quran padho, tum jo amal karo, us par hum shahid hain.

Mustahiq-e-saza logon se alag ho jao. Khud apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se khitab kar ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke sirf meri hi ibadat kar. Mere sath kisi ko sharik na kar, jo bhi aisa karega woh zaroor mustahiq-e-saza hai. Apne qareebi rishtedaron ko hoshiyar karde ke bajuz iman ke koi cheez nijat dahinda nahin. Phir hukum deta hai ke muwahid muttabi-e-sunnat logon se farotani ke sath milta julta reh. Aur jo bhi mere hukum na mane khwah koi ho to us se betaluq ho ja. Aur apni bezari ka izhar karde. Yeh khas taur ki khas logon ki tanbeeh aam logon ki tanbeeh ke manafi nahin kyunke yeh us ka juz hai. Aur jagah irshad hai: "Tu us qoum ko dara de jin ke bade bhi daraye nahin gaye aur jo ghaflat mein pade hue hain." Aur ayat mein hai: (وَلِتُنْذِرَ اُمَّ الْقُرٰي وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا 92؀) (Surah Al-An'am: 92) "Taake tu Makkah walon ko aur us ke gird walon ko sab ko daraye." Aur ayat mein hai: "Tu is Quran se unhein hoshiyar karde jo apne Rab ke paas jama hone se khauf zada ho rahe hain." Deegar ayat mein irshad farmaya ke: "Tu is Quran se parhezgaron ko khushkhabri suna de aur sarkashon ko dara de." Aur ayat mein farmaya: (لِاُنْذِرَكُمْ بِهٖ وَمَنْۢ بَلَغَ ۭ 19؀ۘ) (Surah Al-An'am: 19) "Taake main isi Quran ke sath tumhein aur jise bhi yeh pahunche dara doon." Itne mein Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S) aaye aur farmane lage, Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) agar aap ne tameel-e-irshad mein takheer ki toh dar hai ke aap ko saza hogi. Isi waqt Aap ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) ko bulaya aur farmaya, mujhe hukm hua hai ke main apne qareebi rishtedaron ko dara doon. Maine yeh khayal karke agar pehle hi se in se kaha gaya toh yeh mujhe aisa jawab denge jis se mujhe eeza pahunche main khamosh raha, lekin Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S) aaye aur kaha ke agar tu ne aisa na kiya toh tujhe azaab hoga. Toh ab ae Ali tum ek bakri zibah karke gosht pakalo aur koi teen seer anaaj bhi tayyar karlo aur ek budhna doodh ka bhi bhar lo aur aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib ko bhi jama karlo. Maine aisa hi kiya aur sab ko dawat de di, chalis aadmi jama hue ya ek aadh kam ya ek aadh zyada, in mein Aap ke chacha bhi the, Abu Talib, Hamza, Abbas, aur Abu Lahab kafir khabeeth. Maine saalan pesh kiya toh Aap ne is mein se ek boti le kar kuch khai phir ise handiya mein daal diya aur farmaya lo Allah ka naam lo aur khana shuru karo. Sab ne khana shuru kiya yahan tak ke pet bhar gaye lekin Allah ki qasam gosht utna hi tha jitna rakhte waqt rakha tha, sirf in ki ungliyon ke nishanat toh the magar gosht kuch bhi na ghata tha, halankeh in mein se ek ek itna gosht toh kha leta tha. Phir mujh se farmaya ae Ali inhe pilao. Main woh budhna laya, sab ne bari bari shikam-seer ho kar piya aur khoob aasooda ho gaye lekin doodh bilkul kam na hua, halankeh in mein se ek ek itna doodh pi liya karta tha. Ab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kuch farmana chaha lekin Abu Lahab jaldi se uth khada hua aur kehne laga, lo sahab ab maloom hua ke yeh tamam jadugari mahaz is liye thi. Chunancha majma isi waqt ukhad gaya aur har ek apni raah lag gaya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko nasihat-o-tableegh ka mauqa na mila. Dusre roz Aap ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) se farmaya aaj phir isi tarah in sab ki dawat karo kyunke kal us ne mujhe kuch kehne ka waqt hi nahin diya. Maine phir isi tarah ka intezam kiya, sab ko dawat di, aaye khaya piya, phir kal ki tarah aaj bhi Abu Lahab ne khade ho kar wahi baat kahi aur isi tarah sab tatar-batar ho gaye. Teesre din phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) se yahi farmaya, aaj jab sab kha pi chuke toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jaldi se apni guftagu shuru kar di aur farmaya, ae Banu Abdul Muttalib, wallah koi naujawan shakhs apni qoum ke paas is se behtar bhalai nahin laya jo main tumhare paas laya hoon, main duniya aur aakhirat ki bhalai laya hoon. Aur riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Aap ne farmaya ke ab batao tum mein se kaun mere sath ittefaq karta hai aur kaun mera sath deta hai? Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ka hukm hua hai ke pehle main tumhein is ki dawat doon, jo aaj meri maan le ga woh mera bhai hoga aur yeh darje milenge.

Log sab khamosh hogaye lekin Hazrat Ali R.A jo us waqt is majmay mein sab se kam umr thay aur dukhti aankhon walay aur motay pait walay aur bhari pindliyon walay thay, bol uthay Ya Rasool Allah! Is amr mein aap ki wizarat mein qabool karta hoon. Aap ne meri gardan par haath rakh kar farmaya ke yeh mera bhai hai aur aisi fazilaton wala hai tum is ki suno aur mano. Yeh sun kar woh sab log hanstay huay uth kharay huay aur Abu Talib se kehnay lagay le ab tu apnay bachay ki sun aur maan lekin is ka rawi Abdul Ghaffar bin Qasim bin Abi Maryam matrook hai kazzab hai aur hai bhi Shia. Ibn-e-Madini waghera farmatay hain yeh hadeesain ghar liya karta tha, deegar aimma-e-hadees ne bhi is ko zaeef likha hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke is dawat mein sirf bakri ke aik paon ka gosht paka tha is mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ khutba denay lagay to unhon ne jhat se keh diya ke aaj jaisa jadoo to hum ne kabhi nahin dekha. Is par aap khamosh hogaye. Is mein aap ka khutba yeh hai ke kaun hai jo mera qarz apnay zimmay le aur meri ahl mein mera khalifa banay? Is par sab khamosh rahay aur Abbas R.A bhi chup thay sirf apnay maal ki bukhal ki wajah se. Main Abbas R.A ko khamosh dekh kar khamosh ho raha. Aap ne dobara yahi farmaya dobara bhi sab taraf khamoshi thi mujh se raha na gaya aur main bol para. Main us waqt in sab se giri pari halat wala, chandhi aankhon wala baray pait wala aur bojhal pindli wala tha. In riwayaton mein jo Huzoor ﷺ ka farman hai ke kaun mera qarz apnay zimmay leta hai aur meri ahl ki meray baad hifazat apnay zimmay leta hai? Is se matlab aap ka yeh tha ke jab main is tableegh-e-deen ko phailaon ga aur logon ko Allah ki tauheed ki taraf bulaon ga to sab ke sab meray dushman hojayen ge aur mujhay qatl kardain ge. Yahi khatka aap ko laga raha yahan tak ke yeh aayat utri (وَاللّٰهُ يَعْصِمُكَ مِنَ النَّاسِ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 67) Allah Ta'ala tujhay logon ki eza-rasani se bacha lay ga. Is waqt aap be-khatar hogaye. Is se pehlay aap apni pehra choki bhi bithatay thay lekin is aayat ke utarnay ke baad woh bhi hata di. Is waqt fi-alwaqay tamam Banu Hashim mein Hazrat Ali R.A se zyada imaan wala aur tasdeeq-o-yaqeen wala koi na tha. Is liye hi aap ne Huzoor ﷺ ke sath iqrar kiya. Is ke baad Huzoor ﷺ ne Koh-e-Safa par aam dawat di aur logon ko tauheed-e-khalis ki taraf bulaya aur apni nabuwwat ka elaan kiya. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke aik martaba Hazrat Abu Darda R.A apni masjid mein baithay huay wa'az farma rahay thay fatway de rahay thay. Majlis khacha-khach bhari hui thi. Har aik ki nigahain aap ke chehray par thin aur shauq se sun rahay thay lekin aap ke larkay aur ghar ke aadmi aapas mein be-parwahi se apni baton mein mashghool thay.

Kisi ne Hazrat Abu Darda R.A ki is taraf tawajjah dilayi ke aur sab log toh dil se aap ki ilmi baaton mein dilchaspi le rahe hain aur aap ke ahl-e-bait is se bilkul be-parwah hain, woh apni baaton mein nihayat be-parwahi se mashghool hain, toh aap ne jawab mein farmaya: Main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai, duniya se bilkul kinara-kashi karne wale Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) hote hain aur un par sab se zyada sakht aur bhari un ke qarabat-dar hue hain. Isi baare mein aayat (Wa-anzir se ta'maloon) tak hai. Phir farmata hai, apne tamam umoor mein Allah hi par bharosa rakho, wahi tumhara hafiz-o-nasir hai, wahi tumhari ta'eed karne wala aur tumhare kalme ko buland karne wala hai. Us ki nigahein har waqt tum par hain, jaise farman hai: Aayat (WASHBIR LI-HUKMI RABBIKA FA-INNAKA BI-A'YUNINA WASABBIH BI-HAMDI RABBIKA HEENA TAQOOM) (Surah At-Tur: 48). Apne Rab ke hukmon par sabr kar, tu hamari aankhon ke samne hai. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke jab tu namaz ke liye khada hota hai toh hamari aankhon ke samne hota hai. Hum tumhare ruku-sujood dekhte hain, khade ho ya baithe ho ya kisi halat mein ho, hamari nazron mein ho. Yani tanhayi mein toh namaz padhe toh hum dekhte hain aur jamaat se padhe toh tu hamari nigah ke samne hota hai. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke Allah Ta'ala halat-e-namaz mein aap ko jis tarah aap ke samne ki cheezein dikhata tha, aap ﷺ ke peeche ke muqtadi bhi aap ﷺ ki nigah mein rehte the. Chunancha sahih hadith mein hai, Huzoor ﷺ farmaya karte the, safein durust kar liya karo, main tumhein apne peeche se dekhta rehta hoon. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A yeh matlab bhi bayan karte hain ke ek Nabi ki peeth se dusre Nabi ki peeth ki taraf muntaqil hona barabar dekhte rahe hain, yahan tak ke aap bahaisiyat-e-Nabi duniya mein aaye. Woh Allah apne bandon ki baatein khoob sunta hai, un ki harkaat-o-saknaat ko khoob jaanta hai, jaise farmata hai: Aayat (WAMA TAKOONU FEE SHA'NIN WAMA TATLOO MINHU MIN QUR'ANIN WALA TA'MALOONA MIN AMALIN ILLA KUNNA ALAIKUM SHUHOODAN IDH TUFEEDOONA FEEH) (Surah Yunus: 61), toh jis halat mein ho, tum jitna Quran padho, tum jo amal karo, us par hum shahid hain.

Mustahiq-e-saza logon se alag ho jao. Khud apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se khitab kar ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke sirf meri hi ibadat kar. Mere sath kisi ko sharik na kar, jo bhi aisa karega woh zaroor mustahiq-e-saza hai. Apne qareebi rishtedaron ko hoshiyar karde ke bajuz iman ke koi cheez nijat dahinda nahin. Phir hukum deta hai ke muwahid muttabi-e-sunnat logon se farotani ke sath milta julta reh. Aur jo bhi mere hukum na mane khwah koi ho to us se betaluq ho ja. Aur apni bezari ka izhar karde. Yeh khas taur ki khas logon ki tanbeeh aam logon ki tanbeeh ke manafi nahin kyunke yeh us ka juz hai. Aur jagah irshad hai: "Tu us qoum ko dara de jin ke bade bhi daraye nahin gaye aur jo ghaflat mein pade hue hain." Aur ayat mein hai: (وَلِتُنْذِرَ اُمَّ الْقُرٰي وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا 92؀) (Surah Al-An'am: 92) "Taake tu Makkah walon ko aur us ke gird walon ko sab ko daraye." Aur ayat mein hai: "Tu is Quran se unhein hoshiyar karde jo apne Rab ke paas jama hone se khauf zada ho rahe hain." Deegar ayat mein irshad farmaya ke: "Tu is Quran se parhezgaron ko khushkhabri suna de aur sarkashon ko dara de." Aur ayat mein farmaya: (لِاُنْذِرَكُمْ بِهٖ وَمَنْۢ بَلَغَ ۭ 19؀ۘ) (Surah Al-An'am: 19) "Taake main isi Quran ke sath tumhein aur jise bhi yeh pahunche dara doon." Aur farman hai: "Is ke sath in tamam firqon mein se jo bhi kufr kare us ki saza jahannam hai." Sahih Muslim ki hadith mein hai: "Us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, is ummat mein se jis ke kaan meri risalat ki baat pad jaye khwah Yahudi ho ya Nasrani, phir woh mujh par iman na laye to zaroor woh jahannam mein jayega." Is ayat ki tafsir mein bahut si hadithein hain, unhein sun lijiye. 001 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai: Jab Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat utari to An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Safa pahad par chadh gaye. Aur "Ya Sabaha" keh kar awaz di. Log jama ho gaye, jo nahin aa sakte the unhon ne apne aadmi bhej diye. Us waqt Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Ae aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib! Ae aulad-e-Fahr! Batao agar main tum se kahoon ke is pahad ki pusht par tumhare dushman ka lashkar pada hua hai aur ghaat mein hai, mauqa pate hi tum sab ko qatl kar dalega to kya tum mujhe sacha samjhoge?" Sab ne yak-zaban kaha ke haan, hum aap ko sacha hi samjhenge. Ab aap ne farmaya: "Sun lo, main tumhein aane wale sakht azabon se darane wala hoon." Is par Abu Lahab mal'oon ne kaha: "Tu halak ho jaye, yahi sunane ke liye to tune hamein bulaya tha?" Is ke jawab mein Surah Tabbat Yada utri (Bukhari, Muslim waghera). 002 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai: Is ayat ke utarte hi Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khade ho gaye aur farmane lage: "Ae Fatima bint-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Ae Safiya bint-e-Abdul Muttalib! Suno, main tumhein Allah ke haan kuch kaam nahin aa sakta. Haan, mere paas jo maal ho jitna tum chaho main dene ke liye tayyar hoon" (Muslim). 003 Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain ke is ayat ke utarte hi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Quraishiyon ko bulaya aur unhein ek-ek karke aur aam taur par khitab karke farmaya: "Ae Quraishiyo! Apni jaanein jahannam se bacha lo, ae Ka'ab ke khandan walo!"

Apni jaanein aag se bachalo, ae Hashim ki aulad ke logo! Apne aap ko Allah ke azabon se chhudwalo. Ae Abdul Muttalib ke ladko! Allah ke azabon se bachne ki koshish karo. Ae Fatima (R.A) bint-e-Muhammad! Apni jaan ko dozakh se bachale, qasam Allah ki, main Allah ke yahan ki kisi cheez ka maalik nahin. Beshak tumhari qarabat-dari hai, jis ke dunyawi haqooq main har tarah ada karne ko tayyar hoon. (Muslim waghera). Bukhari, Muslim mein bhi qadre alfaaz ki tabdeeli se yeh hadith marwi hai, ismein yeh bhi hai ke aap (ﷺ) ne apni phuphi Hazrat Safiya (R.A) aur apni sahibzadi Hazrat Fatima (R.A) se yeh bhi farmaya ke mere maal mein se jo chaho mujh se talab karlo. Abu Ya'la mein hai ke aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Qusay, ae Hashim, ae Abd-e-Manaf ki aulado! Yaad rakho main darane wala hoon aur maut badla dene wali hai, is ka chhapa padne hi wala hai aur Qayamat wa'da-gah hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ) par yeh aayat utri to aap (ﷺ) ek pahadi par chadh gaye jis ki choti par patthar the, wahan pahunch kar aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Bani Abd-e-Manaf! Main to sirf chaukanna kar dene wala hoon, meri aur tumhari misaal aisi hai jaise kisi shakhs ne dushman ko dekha aur daud kar apne azizon ko hoshiyar karne ke liye aaya taake woh bachao kar lein, door se hi us ne ghul machana shuru kar diya ke pehle hi khabardar ho jayein. (Muslim, Nasai waghera). Hazrat Ali (R.A) se marwi hai ke jab yeh aayat utri to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apne Ahl-e-Bait ko jama kar liya, yeh tees shakhs the. Jab yeh kha pee chuke to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Kaun hai jo mera qarz apne zimme le aur mere baad mere wa'de poore kare, woh Jannat mein bhi mera saathi aur meri ahl mein khalifa hoga. To ek shakhs ne kaha: Aap to samundar hain, aap ke saath kaun khada ho sakta hai? Teen dafa aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya lekin koi tayyar na hua, to main ne kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Main is ke liye tayyar hoon. (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ek aur sanad mein is se zyada tafseel ke saath marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Banu Abdul Muttalib ko jama kiya, yeh ek jamaat ki jamaat thi aur bade khaoo the, ek shakhs ek-ek bakri ka bacha kha jata tha aur ek bada budhna doodh ka pee jata tha. Aap (ﷺ) ne un sab ke khane ke liye sirf teen pao ke qareeb khana pakwaya, lekin Allah ne isi mein itni barkat di ke sab pet bhar kar kha chuke aur khoob aasooda ho kar pee chuke, lekin na to khane mein kami nazar aayi thi na peene ki cheez ghatti hui maloom hoti thi. Phir aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib! Main tumhari taraf khusoosan aur tamam logon ki taraf umooman Nabi bana kar bheja gaya hoon. Is waqt tum ek mo'jiza bhi mera dekh chuke ho. Ab tum mein se kaun tayyar hai ke mujh se bai'at kare, woh mera bhai aur mera saathi hoga? Lekin ek shakhs bhi majmay se khada na hua siwaye mere aur main is waqt umr ke lihaz se un sab se chhota tha. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Tum baith jao. Teen martaba aap (ﷺ) ne yahi farmaya aur teenon martaba bajuz mere aur koi khada na hua. Teesri martaba aap (ﷺ) ne meri bai'at li.
