Is waqt fi-alwaqay tamam Banu Hashim mein Hazrat Ali R.A se zyada imaan wala aur tasdeeq-o-yaqeen wala koi na tha. Is liye hi aap ne Huzoor ﷺ ke sath iqrar kiya. Is ke baad Huzoor ﷺ ne Koh-e-Safa par aam dawat di aur logon ko tauheed-e-khalis ki taraf bulaya aur apni nabuwwat ka elaan kiya. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke aik martaba Hazrat Abu Darda R.A apni masjid mein baithay huay wa'az farma rahay thay fatway de rahay thay. Majlis khacha-khach bhari hui thi. Har aik ki nigahain aap ke chehray par thin aur shauq se sun rahay thay lekin aap ke larkay aur ghar ke aadmi aapas mein be-parwahi se apni baton mein mashghool thay.

Kisi ne Hazrat Abu Darda R.A ki is taraf tawajjah dilayi ke aur sab log toh dil se aap ki ilmi baaton mein dilchaspi le rahe hain aur aap ke ahl-e-bait is se bilkul be-parwah hain, woh apni baaton mein nihayat be-parwahi se mashghool hain, toh aap ne jawab mein farmaya: Main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai, duniya se bilkul kinara-kashi karne wale Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) hote hain aur un par sab se zyada sakht aur bhari un ke qarabat-dar hue hain. Isi baare mein aayat (Wa-anzir se ta'maloon) tak hai. Phir farmata hai, apne tamam umoor mein Allah hi par bharosa rakho, wahi tumhara hafiz-o-nasir hai, wahi tumhari ta'eed karne wala aur tumhare kalme ko buland karne wala hai. Us ki nigahein har waqt tum par hain, jaise farman hai: Aayat (WASHBIR LI-HUKMI RABBIKA FA-INNAKA BI-A'YUNINA WASABBIH BI-HAMDI RABBIKA HEENA TAQOOM) (Surah At-Tur: 48). Apne Rab ke hukmon par sabr kar, tu hamari aankhon ke samne hai. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke jab tu namaz ke liye khada hota hai toh hamari aankhon ke samne hota hai. Hum tumhare ruku-sujood dekhte hain, khade ho ya baithe ho ya kisi halat mein ho, hamari nazron mein ho. Yani tanhayi mein toh namaz padhe toh hum dekhte hain aur jamaat se padhe toh tu hamari nigah ke samne hota hai. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke Allah Ta'ala halat-e-namaz mein aap ko jis tarah aap ke samne ki cheezein dikhata tha, aap ﷺ ke peeche ke muqtadi bhi aap ﷺ ki nigah mein rehte the. Chunancha sahih hadith mein hai, Huzoor ﷺ farmaya karte the, safein durust kar liya karo, main tumhein apne peeche se dekhta rehta hoon. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A yeh matlab bhi bayan karte hain ke ek Nabi ki peeth se dusre Nabi ki peeth ki taraf muntaqil hona barabar dekhte rahe hain, yahan tak ke aap bahaisiyat-e-Nabi duniya mein aaye. Woh Allah apne bandon ki baatein khoob sunta hai, un ki harkaat-o-saknaat ko khoob jaanta hai, jaise farmata hai: Aayat (WAMA TAKOONU FEE SHA'NIN WAMA TATLOO MINHU MIN QUR'ANIN WALA TA'MALOONA MIN AMALIN ILLA KUNNA ALAIKUM SHUHOODAN IDH TUFEEDOONA FEEH) (Surah Yunus: 61), toh jis halat mein ho, tum jitna Quran padho, tum jo amal karo, us par hum shahid hain.

Mustahiq-e-saza logon se alag ho jao. Khud apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se khitab kar ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke sirf meri hi ibadat kar. Mere sath kisi ko sharik na kar, jo bhi aisa karega woh zaroor mustahiq-e-saza hai. Apne qareebi rishtedaron ko hoshiyar karde ke bajuz iman ke koi cheez nijat dahinda nahin. Phir hukum deta hai ke muwahid muttabi-e-sunnat logon se farotani ke sath milta julta reh. Aur jo bhi mere hukum na mane khwah koi ho to us se betaluq ho ja. Aur apni bezari ka izhar karde. Yeh khas taur ki khas logon ki tanbeeh aam logon ki tanbeeh ke manafi nahin kyunke yeh us ka juz hai. Aur jagah irshad hai: "Tu us qoum ko dara de jin ke bade bhi daraye nahin gaye aur jo ghaflat mein pade hue hain." Aur ayat mein hai: (وَلِتُنْذِرَ اُمَّ الْقُرٰي وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا 92؀) (Surah Al-An'am: 92) "Taake tu Makkah walon ko aur us ke gird walon ko sab ko daraye." Aur ayat mein hai: "Tu is Quran se unhein hoshiyar karde jo apne Rab ke paas jama hone se khauf zada ho rahe hain." Deegar ayat mein irshad farmaya ke: "Tu is Quran se parhezgaron ko khushkhabri suna de aur sarkashon ko dara de." Aur ayat mein farmaya: (لِاُنْذِرَكُمْ بِهٖ وَمَنْۢ بَلَغَ ۭ 19؀ۘ) (Surah Al-An'am: 19) "Taake main isi Quran ke sath tumhein aur jise bhi yeh pahunche dara doon." Aur farman hai: "Is ke sath in tamam firqon mein se jo bhi kufr kare us ki saza jahannam hai." Sahih Muslim ki hadith mein hai: "Us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, is ummat mein se jis ke kaan meri risalat ki baat pad jaye khwah Yahudi ho ya Nasrani, phir woh mujh par iman na laye to zaroor woh jahannam mein jayega." Is ayat ki tafsir mein bahut si hadithein hain, unhein sun lijiye. 001 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai: Jab Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat utari to An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Safa pahad par chadh gaye. Aur "Ya Sabaha" keh kar awaz di. Log jama ho gaye, jo nahin aa sakte the unhon ne apne aadmi bhej diye. Us waqt Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Ae aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib! Ae aulad-e-Fahr! Batao agar main tum se kahoon ke is pahad ki pusht par tumhare dushman ka lashkar pada hua hai aur ghaat mein hai, mauqa pate hi tum sab ko qatl kar dalega to kya tum mujhe sacha samjhoge?" Sab ne yak-zaban kaha ke haan, hum aap ko sacha hi samjhenge. Ab aap ne farmaya: "Sun lo, main tumhein aane wale sakht azabon se darane wala hoon." Is par Abu Lahab mal'oon ne kaha: "Tu halak ho jaye, yahi sunane ke liye to tune hamein bulaya tha?" Is ke jawab mein Surah Tabbat Yada utri (Bukhari, Muslim waghera). 002 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai: Is ayat ke utarte hi Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khade ho gaye aur farmane lage: "Ae Fatima bint-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Ae Safiya bint-e-Abdul Muttalib! Suno, main tumhein Allah ke haan kuch kaam nahin aa sakta. Haan, mere paas jo maal ho jitna tum chaho main dene ke liye tayyar hoon" (Muslim). 003 Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain ke is ayat ke utarte hi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Quraishiyon ko bulaya aur unhein ek-ek karke aur aam taur par khitab karke farmaya: "Ae Quraishiyo! Apni jaanein jahannam se bacha lo, ae Ka'ab ke khandan walo!"

Apni jaanein aag se bachalo, ae Hashim ki aulad ke logo! Apne aap ko Allah ke azabon se chhudwalo. Ae Abdul Muttalib ke ladko! Allah ke azabon se bachne ki koshish karo. Ae Fatima (R.A) bint-e-Muhammad! Apni jaan ko dozakh se bachale, qasam Allah ki, main Allah ke yahan ki kisi cheez ka maalik nahin. Beshak tumhari qarabat-dari hai, jis ke dunyawi haqooq main har tarah ada karne ko tayyar hoon. (Muslim waghera). Bukhari, Muslim mein bhi qadre alfaaz ki tabdeeli se yeh hadith marwi hai, ismein yeh bhi hai ke aap (ﷺ) ne apni phuphi Hazrat Safiya (R.A) aur apni sahibzadi Hazrat Fatima (R.A) se yeh bhi farmaya ke mere maal mein se jo chaho mujh se talab karlo. Abu Ya'la mein hai ke aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Qusay, ae Hashim, ae Abd-e-Manaf ki aulado! Yaad rakho main darane wala hoon aur maut badla dene wali hai, is ka chhapa padne hi wala hai aur Qayamat wa'da-gah hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ) par yeh aayat utri to aap (ﷺ) ek pahadi par chadh gaye jis ki choti par patthar the, wahan pahunch kar aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Bani Abd-e-Manaf! Main to sirf chaukanna kar dene wala hoon, meri aur tumhari misaal aisi hai jaise kisi shakhs ne dushman ko dekha aur daud kar apne azizon ko hoshiyar karne ke liye aaya taake woh bachao kar lein, door se hi us ne ghul machana shuru kar diya ke pehle hi khabardar ho jayein. (Muslim, Nasai waghera). Hazrat Ali (R.A) se marwi hai ke jab yeh aayat utri to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apne Ahl-e-Bait ko jama kar liya, yeh tees shakhs the. Jab yeh kha pee chuke to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Kaun hai jo mera qarz apne zimme le aur mere baad mere wa'de poore kare, woh Jannat mein bhi mera saathi aur meri ahl mein khalifa hoga. To ek shakhs ne kaha: Aap to samundar hain, aap ke saath kaun khada ho sakta hai? Teen dafa aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya lekin koi tayyar na hua, to main ne kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Main is ke liye tayyar hoon. (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ek aur sanad mein is se zyada tafseel ke saath marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Banu Abdul Muttalib ko jama kiya, yeh ek jamaat ki jamaat thi aur bade khaoo the, ek shakhs ek-ek bakri ka bacha kha jata tha aur ek bada budhna doodh ka pee jata tha. Aap (ﷺ) ne un sab ke khane ke liye sirf teen pao ke qareeb khana pakwaya, lekin Allah ne isi mein itni barkat di ke sab pet bhar kar kha chuke aur khoob aasooda ho kar pee chuke, lekin na to khane mein kami nazar aayi thi na peene ki cheez ghatti hui maloom hoti thi. Phir aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib! Main tumhari taraf khusoosan aur tamam logon ki taraf umooman Nabi bana kar bheja gaya hoon. Is waqt tum ek mo'jiza bhi mera dekh chuke ho. Ab tum mein se kaun tayyar hai ke mujh se bai'at kare, woh mera bhai aur mera saathi hoga? Lekin ek shakhs bhi majmay se khada na hua siwaye mere aur main is waqt umr ke lihaz se un sab se chhota tha. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Tum baith jao. Teen martaba aap (ﷺ) ne yahi farmaya aur teenon martaba bajuz mere aur koi khada na hua. Teesri martaba aap (ﷺ) ne meri bai'at li.

Imam Baihaqi (R.H) Dala'il-un-Nubuwwah mein laye hain ke jab yeh aayat utri toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar main apni qoum ke samne abhi hi ise pesh karunga toh woh na manenge. Aur aisa jawab denge jo mujh par garan guzre, pas Aap khamosh ho gaye. Itne mein Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S) aaye aur farmane lage, Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) agar aap ne tameel-e-irshad mein takheer ki toh dar hai ke aap ko saza hogi. Isi waqt Aap ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) ko bulaya aur farmaya, mujhe hukm hua hai ke main apne qareebi rishtedaron ko dara doon. Maine yeh khayal karke agar pehle hi se in se kaha gaya toh yeh mujhe aisa jawab denge jis se mujhe eeza pahunche main khamosh raha, lekin Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S) aaye aur kaha ke agar tu ne aisa na kiya toh tujhe azaab hoga. Toh ab ae Ali tum ek bakri zibah karke gosht pakalo aur koi teen seer anaaj bhi tayyar karlo aur ek budhna doodh ka bhi bhar lo aur aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib ko bhi jama karlo. Maine aisa hi kiya aur sab ko dawat de di, chalis aadmi jama hue ya ek aadh kam ya ek aadh zyada, in mein Aap ke chacha bhi the, Abu Talib, Hamza, Abbas, aur Abu Lahab kafir khabeeth. Maine saalan pesh kiya toh Aap ne is mein se ek boti le kar kuch khai phir ise handiya mein daal diya aur farmaya lo Allah ka naam lo aur khana shuru karo. Sab ne khana shuru kiya yahan tak ke pet bhar gaye lekin Allah ki qasam gosht utna hi tha jitna rakhte waqt rakha tha, sirf in ki ungliyon ke nishanat toh the magar gosht kuch bhi na ghata tha, halankeh in mein se ek ek itna gosht toh kha leta tha. Phir mujh se farmaya ae Ali inhe pilao. Main woh budhna laya, sab ne bari bari shikam-seer ho kar piya aur khoob aasooda ho gaye lekin doodh bilkul kam na hua, halankeh in mein se ek ek itna doodh pi liya karta tha. Ab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kuch farmana chaha lekin Abu Lahab jaldi se uth khada hua aur kehne laga, lo sahab ab maloom hua ke yeh tamam jadugari mahaz is liye thi. Chunancha majma isi waqt ukhad gaya aur har ek apni raah lag gaya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko nasihat-o-tableegh ka mauqa na mila. Dusre roz Aap ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) se farmaya aaj phir isi tarah in sab ki dawat karo kyunke kal us ne mujhe kuch kehne ka waqt hi nahin diya. Maine phir isi tarah ka intezam kiya, sab ko dawat di, aaye khaya piya, phir kal ki tarah aaj bhi Abu Lahab ne khade ho kar wahi baat kahi aur isi tarah sab tatar-batar ho gaye. Teesre din phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) se yahi farmaya, aaj jab sab kha pi chuke toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jaldi se apni guftagu shuru kar di aur farmaya, ae Banu Abdul Muttalib, wallah koi naujawan shakhs apni qoum ke paas is se behtar bhalai nahin laya jo main tumhare paas laya hoon, main duniya aur aakhirat ki bhalai laya hoon. Aur riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Aap ne farmaya ke ab batao tum mein se kaun mere sath ittefaq karta hai aur kaun mera sath deta hai? Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ka hukm hua hai ke pehle main tumhein is ki dawat doon, jo aaj meri maan le ga woh mera bhai hoga aur yeh darje milenge.

Log sab khamosh hogaye lekin Hazrat Ali R.A jo us waqt is majmay mein sab se kam umr thay aur dukhti aankhon walay aur motay pait walay aur bhari pindliyon walay thay, bol uthay Ya Rasool Allah! Is amr mein aap ki wizarat mein qabool karta hoon. Aap ne meri gardan par haath rakh kar farmaya ke yeh mera bhai hai aur aisi fazilaton wala hai tum is ki suno aur mano. Yeh sun kar woh sab log hanstay huay uth kharay huay aur Abu Talib se kehnay lagay le ab tu apnay bachay ki sun aur maan lekin is ka rawi Abdul Ghaffar bin Qasim bin Abi Maryam matrook hai kazzab hai aur hai bhi Shia. Ibn-e-Madini waghera farmatay hain yeh hadeesain ghar liya karta tha, deegar aimma-e-hadees ne bhi is ko zaeef likha hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke is dawat mein sirf bakri ke aik paon ka gosht paka tha is mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ khutba denay lagay to unhon ne jhat se keh diya ke aaj jaisa jadoo to hum ne kabhi nahin dekha. Is par aap khamosh hogaye. Is mein aap ka khutba yeh hai ke kaun hai jo mera qarz apnay zimmay le aur meri ahl mein mera khalifa banay? Is par sab khamosh rahay aur Abbas R.A bhi chup thay sirf apnay maal ki bukhal ki wajah se. Main Abbas R.A ko khamosh dekh kar khamosh ho raha. Aap ne dobara yahi farmaya dobara bhi sab taraf khamoshi thi mujh se raha na gaya aur main bol para. Main us waqt in sab se giri pari halat wala, chandhi aankhon wala baray pait wala aur bojhal pindli wala tha. In riwayaton mein jo Huzoor ﷺ ka farman hai ke kaun mera qarz apnay zimmay leta hai aur meri ahl ki meray baad hifazat apnay zimmay leta hai? Is se matlab aap ka yeh tha ke jab main is tableegh-e-deen ko phailaon ga aur logon ko Allah ki tauheed ki taraf bulaon ga to sab ke sab meray dushman hojayen ge aur mujhay qatl kardain ge. Sahih Muslim ki hadith mein hai: "Us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, is ummat mein se jis ke kaan meri risalat ki baat pad jaye khwah Yahudi ho ya Nasrani, phir woh mujh par iman na laye to zaroor woh jahannam mein jayega." Is ayat ki tafsir mein bahut si hadithein hain, unhein sun lijiye. 001 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai: Jab Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat utari to An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Safa pahad par chadh gaye. Aur "Ya Sabaha" keh kar awaz di. Log jama ho gaye, jo nahin aa sakte the unhon ne apne aadmi bhej diye. Us waqt Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Ae aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib! Ae aulad-e-Fahr! Batao agar main tum se kahoon ke is pahad ki pusht par tumhare dushman ka lashkar pada hua hai aur ghaat mein hai, mauqa pate hi tum sab ko qatl kar dalega to kya tum mujhe sacha samjhoge?" Sab ne yak-zaban kaha ke haan, hum aap ko sacha hi samjhenge. Ab aap ne farmaya: "Sun lo, main tumhein aane wale sakht azabon se darane wala hoon." Is par Abu Lahab mal'oon ne kaha: "Tu halak ho jaye, yahi sunane ke liye to tune hamein bulaya tha?" Is ke jawab mein Surah Tabbat Yada utri (Bukhari, Muslim waghera). 002 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai: Is ayat ke utarte hi Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khade ho gaye aur farmane lage: "Ae Fatima bint-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Ae Safiya bint-e-Abdul Muttalib! Suno, main tumhein Allah ke haan kuch kaam nahin aa sakta. Haan, mere paas jo maal ho jitna tum chaho main dene ke liye tayyar hoon" (Muslim). 003 Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain ke is ayat ke utarte hi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Quraishiyon ko bulaya aur unhein ek-ek karke aur aam taur par khitab karke farmaya: "Ae Quraishiyo! Apni jaanein jahannam se bacha lo, ae Ka'ab ke khandan walo!"

Apni jaanein aag se bachalo, ae Hashim ki aulad ke logo! Apne aap ko Allah ke azabon se chhudwalo. Ae Abdul Muttalib ke ladko! Allah ke azabon se bachne ki koshish karo. Ae Fatima (R.A) bint-e-Muhammad! Apni jaan ko dozakh se bachale, qasam Allah ki, main Allah ke yahan ki kisi cheez ka maalik nahin. Beshak tumhari qarabat-dari hai, jis ke dunyawi haqooq main har tarah ada karne ko tayyar hoon. (Muslim waghera). Bukhari, Muslim mein bhi qadre alfaaz ki tabdeeli se yeh hadith marwi hai, ismein yeh bhi hai ke aap (ﷺ) ne apni phuphi Hazrat Safiya (R.A) aur apni sahibzadi Hazrat Fatima (R.A) se yeh bhi farmaya ke mere maal mein se jo chaho mujh se talab karlo. Abu Ya'la mein hai ke aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Qusay, ae Hashim, ae Abd-e-Manaf ki aulado! Yaad rakho main darane wala hoon aur maut badla dene wali hai, is ka chhapa padne hi wala hai aur Qayamat wa'da-gah hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ) par yeh aayat utri to aap (ﷺ) ek pahadi par chadh gaye jis ki choti par patthar the, wahan pahunch kar aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Bani Abd-e-Manaf! Main to sirf chaukanna kar dene wala hoon, meri aur tumhari misaal aisi hai jaise kisi shakhs ne dushman ko dekha aur daud kar apne azizon ko hoshiyar karne ke liye aaya taake woh bachao kar lein, door se hi us ne ghul machana shuru kar diya ke pehle hi khabardar ho jayein. (Muslim, Nasai waghera). Hazrat Ali (R.A) se marwi hai ke jab yeh aayat utri to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apne Ahl-e-Bait ko jama kar liya, yeh tees shakhs the. Jab yeh kha pee chuke to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Kaun hai jo mera qarz apne zimme le aur mere baad mere wa'de poore kare, woh Jannat mein bhi mera saathi aur meri ahl mein khalifa hoga. To ek shakhs ne kaha: Aap to samundar hain, aap ke saath kaun khada ho sakta hai? Teen dafa aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya lekin koi tayyar na hua, to main ne kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Main is ke liye tayyar hoon. (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ek aur sanad mein is se zyada tafseel ke saath marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Banu Abdul Muttalib ko jama kiya, yeh ek jamaat ki jamaat thi aur bade khaoo the, ek shakhs ek-ek bakri ka bacha kha jata tha aur ek bada budhna doodh ka pee jata tha. Aap (ﷺ) ne un sab ke khane ke liye sirf teen pao ke qareeb khana pakwaya, lekin Allah ne isi mein itni barkat di ke sab pet bhar kar kha chuke aur khoob aasooda ho kar pee chuke, lekin na to khane mein kami nazar aayi thi na peene ki cheez ghatti hui maloom hoti thi. Phir aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib! Main tumhari taraf khusoosan aur tamam logon ki taraf umooman Nabi bana kar bheja gaya hoon. Is waqt tum ek mo'jiza bhi mera dekh chuke ho. Ab tum mein se kaun tayyar hai ke mujh se bai'at kare, woh mera bhai aur mera saathi hoga? Lekin ek shakhs bhi majmay se khada na hua siwaye mere aur main is waqt umr ke lihaz se un sab se chhota tha. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Tum baith jao. Teen martaba aap (ﷺ) ne yahi farmaya aur teenon martaba bajuz mere aur koi khada na hua. Teesri martaba aap (ﷺ) ne meri bai'at li.

Imam Baihaqi (R.H) Dala'il-un-Nubuwwah mein laye hain ke jab yeh aayat utri toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar main apni qoum ke samne abhi hi ise pesh karunga toh woh na manenge. Aur aisa jawab denge jo mujh par garan guzre, pas Aap khamosh ho gaye. Itne mein Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S) aaye aur farmane lage, Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) agar aap ne tameel-e-irshad mein takheer ki toh dar hai ke aap ko saza hogi. Isi waqt Aap ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) ko bulaya aur farmaya, mujhe hukm hua hai ke main apne qareebi rishtedaron ko dara doon. Maine yeh khayal karke agar pehle hi se in se kaha gaya toh yeh mujhe aisa jawab denge jis se mujhe eeza pahunche main khamosh raha, lekin Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S) aaye aur kaha ke agar tu ne aisa na kiya toh tujhe azaab hoga. Toh ab ae Ali tum ek bakri zibah karke gosht pakalo aur koi teen seer anaaj bhi tayyar karlo aur ek budhna doodh ka bhi bhar lo aur aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib ko bhi jama karlo. Maine aisa hi kiya aur sab ko dawat de di, chalis aadmi jama hue ya ek aadh kam ya ek aadh zyada, in mein Aap ke chacha bhi the, Abu Talib, Hamza, Abbas, aur Abu Lahab kafir khabeeth. Maine saalan pesh kiya toh Aap ne is mein se ek boti le kar kuch khai phir ise handiya mein daal diya aur farmaya lo Allah ka naam lo aur khana shuru karo. Sab ne khana shuru kiya yahan tak ke pet bhar gaye lekin Allah ki qasam gosht utna hi tha jitna rakhte waqt rakha tha, sirf in ki ungliyon ke nishanat toh the magar gosht kuch bhi na ghata tha, halankeh in mein se ek ek itna gosht toh kha leta tha. Phir mujh se farmaya ae Ali inhe pilao. Main woh budhna laya, sab ne bari bari shikam-seer ho kar piya aur khoob aasooda ho gaye lekin doodh bilkul kam na hua, halankeh in mein se ek ek itna doodh pi liya karta tha. Ab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kuch farmana chaha lekin Abu Lahab jaldi se uth khada hua aur kehne laga, lo sahab ab maloom hua ke yeh tamam jadugari mahaz is liye thi. Chunancha majma isi waqt ukhad gaya aur har ek apni raah lag gaya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko nasihat-o-tableegh ka mauqa na mila. Dusre roz Aap ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) se farmaya aaj phir isi tarah in sab ki dawat karo kyunke kal us ne mujhe kuch kehne ka waqt hi nahin diya. Maine phir isi tarah ka intezam kiya, sab ko dawat di, aaye khaya piya, phir kal ki tarah aaj bhi Abu Lahab ne khade ho kar wahi baat kahi aur isi tarah sab tatar-batar ho gaye. Teesre din phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) se yahi farmaya, aaj jab sab kha pi chuke toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jaldi se apni guftagu shuru kar di aur farmaya, ae Banu Abdul Muttalib, wallah koi naujawan shakhs apni qoum ke paas is se behtar bhalai nahin laya jo main tumhare paas laya hoon, main duniya aur aakhirat ki bhalai laya hoon. Aur riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Aap ne farmaya ke ab batao tum mein se kaun mere sath ittefaq karta hai aur kaun mera sath deta hai? Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ka hukm hua hai ke pehle main tumhein is ki dawat doon, jo aaj meri maan le ga woh mera bhai hoga aur yeh darje milenge.

Log sab khamosh hogaye lekin Hazrat Ali R.A jo us waqt is majmay mein sab se kam umr thay aur dukhti aankhon walay aur motay pait walay aur bhari pindliyon walay thay, bol uthay Ya Rasool Allah! Is amr mein aap ki wizarat mein qabool karta hoon. Aap ne meri gardan par haath rakh kar farmaya ke yeh mera bhai hai aur aisi fazilaton wala hai tum is ki suno aur mano. Yeh sun kar woh sab log hanstay huay uth kharay huay aur Abu Talib se kehnay lagay le ab tu apnay bachay ki sun aur maan lekin is ka rawi Abdul Ghaffar bin Qasim bin Abi Maryam matrook hai kazzab hai aur hai bhi Shia. Ibn-e-Madini waghera farmatay hain yeh hadeesain ghar liya karta tha, deegar aimma-e-hadees ne bhi is ko zaeef likha hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke is dawat mein sirf bakri ke aik paon ka gosht paka tha is mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ khutba denay lagay to unhon ne jhat se keh diya ke aaj jaisa jadoo to hum ne kabhi nahin dekha. Is par aap khamosh hogaye. Is mein aap ka khutba yeh hai ke kaun hai jo mera qarz apnay zimmay le aur meri ahl mein mera khalifa banay? Is par sab khamosh rahay aur Abbas R.A bhi chup thay sirf apnay maal ki bukhal ki wajah se. Main Abbas R.A ko khamosh dekh kar khamosh ho raha. Aap ne dobara yahi farmaya dobara bhi sab taraf khamoshi thi mujh se raha na gaya aur main bol para. Main us waqt in sab se giri pari halat wala, chandhi aankhon wala baray pait wala aur bojhal pindli wala tha. In riwayaton mein jo Huzoor ﷺ ka farman hai ke kaun mera qarz apnay zimmay leta hai aur meri ahl ki meray baad hifazat apnay zimmay leta hai? Is se matlab aap ka yeh tha ke jab main is tableegh-e-deen ko phailaon ga aur logon ko Allah ki tauheed ki taraf bulaon ga to sab ke sab meray dushman hojayen ge aur mujhay qatl kardain ge. Yahi khatka aap ko laga raha yahan tak ke yeh aayat utri (وَاللّٰهُ يَعْصِمُكَ مِنَ النَّاسِ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 67) Allah Ta'ala tujhay logon ki eza-rasani se bacha lay ga. Is waqt aap be-khatar hogaye. Is se pehlay aap apni pehra choki bhi bithatay thay lekin is aayat ke utarnay ke baad woh bhi hata di. Is waqt fi-alwaqay tamam Banu Hashim mein Hazrat Ali R.A se zyada imaan wala aur tasdeeq-o-yaqeen wala koi na tha. Is liye hi aap ne Huzoor ﷺ ke sath iqrar kiya. Is ke baad Huzoor ﷺ ne Koh-e-Safa par aam dawat di aur logon ko tauheed-e-khalis ki taraf bulaya aur apni nabuwwat ka elaan kiya. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke aik martaba Hazrat Abu Darda R.A apni masjid mein baithay huay wa'az farma rahay thay fatway de rahay thay. Majlis khacha-khach bhari hui thi. Har aik ki nigahain aap ke chehray par thin aur shauq se sun rahay thay lekin aap ke larkay aur ghar ke aadmi aapas mein be-parwahi se apni baton mein mashghool thay.

Kisi ne Hazrat Abu Darda R.A ki is taraf tawajjah dilayi ke aur sab log toh dil se aap ki ilmi baaton mein dilchaspi le rahe hain aur aap ke ahl-e-bait is se bilkul be-parwah hain, woh apni baaton mein nihayat be-parwahi se mashghool hain, toh aap ne jawab mein farmaya: Main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai, duniya se bilkul kinara-kashi karne wale Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) hote hain aur un par sab se zyada sakht aur bhari un ke qarabat-dar hue hain. Isi baare mein aayat (Wa-anzir se ta'maloon) tak hai. Phir farmata hai, apne tamam umoor mein Allah hi par bharosa rakho, wahi tumhara hafiz-o-nasir hai, wahi tumhari ta'eed karne wala aur tumhare kalme ko buland karne wala hai. Us ki nigahein har waqt tum par hain, jaise farman hai: Aayat (WASHBIR LI-HUKMI RABBIKA FA-INNAKA BI-A'YUNINA WASABBIH BI-HAMDI RABBIKA HEENA TAQOOM) (Surah At-Tur: 48). Apne Rab ke hukmon par sabr kar, tu hamari aankhon ke samne hai. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke jab tu namaz ke liye khada hota hai toh hamari aankhon ke samne hota hai. Hum tumhare ruku-sujood dekhte hain, khade ho ya baithe ho ya kisi halat mein ho, hamari nazron mein ho. Yani tanhayi mein toh namaz padhe toh hum dekhte hain aur jamaat se padhe toh tu hamari nigah ke samne hota hai. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke Allah Ta'ala halat-e-namaz mein aap ko jis tarah aap ke samne ki cheezein dikhata tha, aap ﷺ ke peeche ke muqtadi bhi aap ﷺ ki nigah mein rehte the. Chunancha sahih hadith mein hai, Huzoor ﷺ farmaya karte the, safein durust kar liya karo, main tumhein apne peeche se dekhta rehta hoon. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A yeh matlab bhi bayan karte hain ke ek Nabi ki peeth se dusre Nabi ki peeth ki taraf muntaqil hona barabar dekhte rahe hain, yahan tak ke aap bahaisiyat-e-Nabi duniya mein aaye. Woh Allah apne bandon ki baatein khoob sunta hai, un ki harkaat-o-saknaat ko khoob jaanta hai, jaise farmata hai: Aayat (WAMA TAKOONU FEE SHA'NIN WAMA TATLOO MINHU MIN QUR'ANIN WALA TA'MALOONA MIN AMALIN ILLA KUNNA ALAIKUM SHUHOODAN IDH TUFEEDOONA FEEH) (Surah Yunus: 61), toh jis halat mein ho, tum jitna Quran padho, tum jo amal karo, us par hum shahid hain.

Shayateen aur jadugar mushrikeen kaha karte the ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka laya hua yeh Quran bar-haq nahin. Is ne is ko khud ghar liya hai ya is ke paas jinnon ka koi sardar aata hai jo isay yeh sikha jata hai. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne Rasool ko is aitraz se pak kiya aur sabit kiya ke aap jis Quran ko laye hain woh Allah ka kalam hai, usi ka utara hua hai. Buzurg, ameen, taqatwar farishta isay laya hai. Yeh kisi shaitan ya jin ki taraf se nahin, shayateen to taleem-e-Quran se chidte hain, is ki taleemat un ke yaksar khilaf hain. Unhein kya padi ke aisa pakeeza aur rah-e-rast par lagane wala Quran woh layein aur logon ko nek rah batayein? Woh to apne jaise insani shayateen ke paas aate hain jo pet bhar kar jhoot bolne wale hon, bad-kirdar aur gunahgar hon. Aise kahinon aur bad-kirdaron aur jhoote logon ke paas jinat aur shayateen pahunchte hain kyunke woh bhi jhoote aur bad-aamal hain. Uchat-ti hui koi ek aadh baat suni sunayi pahunchate hain aur woh ek jo aasman se chhupe chhuppaye sun li to sau jhoot is mein mila kar kahinon ke kaan mein daal di. Unhon ne apni taraf se phir bahut si baatein shamil kar ke logon mein deengein maar dein. Ab ek aadh baat to sachi nikli lekin logon ne un ki aur sau jhooti baatein bhi sachi maan lein aur tabah huye. Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke logon ne kahinon ke bare mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya to aap ne farmaya woh koi cheez nahin hain. Logon ne kaha Huzoor! kabhi kabhi to un ki koi baat khari bhi nikal aati hai? Aap ne farmaya haan, yeh wohi baat hoti hai jo jinat aasman se uda late hain aur un ke kaan mein keh kar jate hain, phir is ke sath jhoot apni taraf se mila kar keh dete hain. Sahih Bukhari Shareef ki ek hadith mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala kisi kaam ka faisla aasman par karta hai to farishte ba-adab apne par jhuka dete hain. Aisi aawaz aati hai jaise kisi chattan par zanjeer bajayi jati ho. Jab woh ghabrahat un ke dilon se door hoti hai to aapas mein daryaft karte hain ke Rabb ka kya hukm sadir hua hai? Dusre jawab dete hain ke Rabb ne yeh farmaya aur woh aali-shan aur bahut badi kibriya wala hai. Kabhi kabhi Amr-e-Ilahi se chori chhupe sunne wale kisi jin ke kaan mein bhunak pad jati hai jo is tarah ek par ek par ho kar wahan tak pahunch jate hain. Rawi-e-Hadith Hazrat Sufyan ne apne hathon ki ungliyan phaila kar is par dusra hath is tarah rakh kar unhein hila kar bataya ke is tarah. Ab upar wala neeche wale ko aur woh apne se neeche wale ko woh baat batla deta hai yahan tak ke jadugar aur kahin ko woh pahuncha dete hain. Kabhi aisa bhi hota hai ke baat pahunchate is se pehle shola pahunch jata hai aur kabhi is ke pehle hi woh pahuncha dete hain. Is mein kahin-o-jadugar apne sau jhoot shamil kar ke mashhoor karta hai, chunke woh ek baat sachi nikalti hai, log sab baton ko hi sacha samajhne lagte hain.

In tamam ahadees ka bayan aayat (Hatta iza fuzzi'a an quloobihim qalu maza, qala rabbukum, qalul haq, wa huwal aliyyul kabeer) (Surah Saba: 23) ki tafseer mein aayega. Insha'Allah. Bukhari Shareef ki ek hadees mein yeh bhi hai ke farishtay aasmani amr ki baat cheet badalon par karte hain jisay shaitan sun kar kahinon tak pahunchate hain aur woh ek sach mein sau jhoot milate hain. Phir farmaya ke kafir shairon ki itteba gumrah log karte hain. Arab ke shairon ka dastoor tha kisi ki muzammat aur hajv mein kuch keh daalte thay, logon ki ek jamaat unke saath ho jaati thi aur uski haan mein haan milane lagti thi. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Sahaba (R.A) ki ek jamaat ke saath 'Arj mein ja rahe thay, raastay mein ek shair sher-khwani karte hue mila. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya is shaitan ko pakad lo ya farmaya roko. Tum mein se koi shakhs khoon aur peep se apna pait bhar le, yeh is se behtar hai ke woh sheron se apna pait bhare. Inhein har jangal ki thokarain khaate kisi ne nahin dekha? Har laghv mein yeh ghus jaate hain. Kalam ke har fan mein bolte hain. Kabhi kisi ki tareef mein zameen aur aasman ke qulabey milate hain. Kabhi kisi ki muzammat mein aasman-o-zameen sar par uthate hain, jhooti khushamad, jhooti buraiyan, ghadi hui badiyan inke hissay mein aayi hain. Yeh zaban ke bhand hote hain lekin kaam ke kaahil. Ek Ansari aur ek doosri qoum ke shakhs ne hajv ka muqabla kiya jis mein dono ki qoum ke bade bade log bhi unke saath ho gaye. Pas is aayat mein yahi hai ke unka saath dene wale gumrah log hain. Woh woh baatein baka karte hain jinhein kisi ne kabhi kiya na ho. Isi liye ulama ne is baat mein ikhtilaf kiya hai ke agar kisi shair ne apne sher mein kisi aisay gunah ka iqrar kiya ho jis par had-e-shara wajib hoti ho to aaya woh had us par jaari ki jayegi ya nahin? Dono taraf ulama gaye. Waqai woh fakhr-o-ghuroor ke saath aisi baatein bak dete hain ke main ne yeh kiya aur woh kiya, halankeh na kuch kiya ho aur na hi kar sakte hon. Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne apni khilafat ke zamane mein Hazrat Numan bin Adi bin Fazla ko Basra ke shehar Misan ka governor muqarrar kiya tha. Woh shair thay, ek martaba apne sheron mein kaha ke kya haseenon ko yeh ittila nahin hui ke unka mehboob Misan mein hai jahan har waqt sheeshay ke glasson mein daur-e-sharab chal raha hai aur gaon ki bholi ladkiyon ke gaanay aur unke raqs-o-suroor muhayya hain. Haan agar mere kisi dost se ho sakay to is baday aur bharey hue jaam mujhe pilaye lekin un se chotay jaam mujhe sakht na-pasand hain. Allah karay Ameer-ul-Momineen ko yeh khabar na pahunchay warna bura maanenge aur saza denge. Yeh ashaar sach much Hazrat Ameer-ul-Momineen (R.A) tak pahunch gaye, Aap (R.A) sakht naraz hue aur usi waqt aadmi bheja ke main ne tujhe tere ohday se mazool kiya. Aur Aap (R.A) ne ek khat bheja jis mein Bismillah ke baad Ha-Meem ki teen aayatein (Ilayhil Maseer) tak likh kar phir tehreer farmaya ke tere ashaar se mujhe sakht ranj hua.

Main tujhe tere ohday se mazool karta hoon. Chunancha is khat ko parhte hi Hazrat Noman darbar-e-khilafat mein hazir hue aur ba-adab arz kiya ke Amir-ul-Momineen wallah na main ne kabhi sharab pi, na naach rang-o-gana bajana dekha, na suna. Yeh toh sirf shairana tarang thi. Aap ne farmaya yahi mera khayal hai lekin meri toh himmat nahin parti ke aisay fahash-go shair ko koi ohda do. Pas maloom hua ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke nazdeek bhi shair apne sheron mein kisi jurm ke elaan par agarche woh qabil-e-hadd ho toh hadd nahin lagayi jaye gi is liye ke woh jo kehte hain so karte nahin, haan woh qabil-e-malamat aur laiq-e-sarzanish zaroor hain. Chunancha hadith mein hai ke pait ko lahoo peep se bhar lena ashaar se bhar lene se badtar hai. Matlab yeh ke Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ) na toh shair hain, na sahir, na kahin, na muftari hain. Aap ka zahir-e-haal hi aap ke in ayoob se bara'at ka bohat bada aadil gawah hai jaise farman hai ke toh hum ne inhe shair-goi sikhayi hai na is ke laiq hai, yeh toh sirf nasihat aur Quran-e-Mubeen hai. Aur aayat mein hai yeh Rasool-e-Kareem ka qaul hai kisi shair ka nahin, tum mein imaan ki kami hai, yeh kisi kahin ka qaul nahin. Tum mein nasihat maanne ka mada kam hai, yeh toh Rabb-ul-Alameen ki utari hui kitab hai. Is surat mein bhi yahi farmaya gaya ke yeh Rabb-ul-Alameen ki taraf se utri hai. Rooh-ul-Ameen ne tere dil par nazil farmayi hai, Arabi zaban mein hai is liye ke tu logon ko aagah kar de, isay shaitan le kar nahin aaye, na yeh un ke laiq hai na un ki bas ki baat hai, woh toh is ke sunne se bhi alag kar diye gaye hain. Jo jhootay muftari aur bad-kirdar hotay hain un ke paas shaitan aatay hain jo uchat-ti baatein sun suna kar un ke kaanon mein aa kar daal jatay hain. Mehez jhoot bolne walay yeh khud hotay hain, shairon ki pusht panahi obashon ka kaam hai, woh toh har wadi mein sar-gardan hotay hain, zabani baatein banatay hain, amal se koray rehtay hain. Is ke baad jo farman hai is ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke is se agli aayat jis mein shairon ki muzammat hai jab utri toh darbar-e-Rasool ke shu'ara Hazrat Hassan bin Sabit, Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawaha, Hazrat Ka'ab bin Malik (R.A) rotay hue darbar-e-Nabi (ﷺ) mein hazir hue aur kehne lage ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) shairon ki toh yeh gat bani aur hum bhi shair hain, isi waqt aap ne yeh dusri aayat tilawat farmayi ke imaan lane walay aur naik amal karne walay tum ho, zikr-e-Allah bakasrat karne walay tum ho, mazloom ho kar badla lene walay tum ho, pas tum un se mustasna ho (Ibn Abi Hatim waghera). Ek riwayat mein Hazrat Ka'ab ka naam hai, ek riwayat mein sirf Abdullah ki is shikayat par ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) shair toh main bhi hoon is dusri aayat ka nazil hona marwi hai lekin yeh qabil-e-nazar.

Is liye ke yeh Surah Makkiyah hai, shu'ara-e-Ansar jitne bhi thay woh sab Madine mein thay, phir un ke bare mein is aayat ka nazil hona yaqeenan mahal-e-ghaur hoga aur jo hadeesein bayan huin woh mursal hain, is wajah se aitimaad nahin ho sakta hai. Yeh aayat ka nazool beshak istisna ke bare mein hai aur sirf yahi Ansari shu'ara R.A hi nahin, balkeh agar kisi shayar ne apni jahiliyat ke zamane mein Islam aur musalmanon ke khilaf bhi ashaar kahe hon aur phir musalman ho jaye, tauba kar le aur us ke muqable mein zikr-e-Allah bakasrat kare, woh beshak is burai se alag hai. Hasanat sayyi'aat ko door kar deti hain, jabkeh us ne musalman ko aur deen-e-haq ko bura kaha tha woh bura tha, lekin jab us ne un ki madh ki toh burai bhalai se badal gayi. Jaise Hazrat Abdullah bin Ziba'ri R.A ne Islam se pehle Huzoor ﷺ ki hajv bayan ki thi lekin Islam ke baad badi madh bayan ki aur apne ashaar mein is hajv ka uzr bhi bayan karte hue kaha: "Main us waqt shaitani panja mein phansa hua tha." Isi tarah Abu Sufyan bin Haris bin Abdul Muttalib bawajood aap ka chacha zaad bhai hone ke aap ka jaani dushman tha aur bahut hajv kiya karta tha, jab musalman hue toh aise musalman hue ke duniya bhar mein Huzoor ﷺ se zyada mehboob unhein koi na tha. Aksar aap ki madh kiya karte thay aur bahut hi aqeedat-o-mohabbat rakhte thay. Sahih Muslim mein Ibn Abbas R.A se marvi hai ke Abu Sufyan Sakhr bin Harb jab musalman hua toh Huzoor ﷺ se kehne laga: "Mujhe teen cheezein ata farmaiye, ek toh yeh ke mere ladke Mu'awiyah ko apna katib bana lijiye. Dusre mujhe kafiron se jihad ke liye bhejiye aur mere sath koi lashkar dijiye taake jis tarah kufr mein musalmanon se lada karta tha ab Islam mein kafiron ki khabar loon." Aap ne dono baatein qabool farmayin, ek teesri darkhwast bhi ki jo qabool ki gayi. Pas aise log is aayat ke hukm se is dusri aayat se alag kar liye gaye. Zikr-e-Allah khwah woh apne sher'on mein bakasrat karein khwah aur tarah apne kalam mein, yaqeenan woh agle gunahon ka badla aur kaffara hai. Apni mazloomi ka badla lete hain, yani kafiron ki hajv ka jawab dete hain. Khud Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Hassan R.A se farmaya tha: "In kuffar ki hajv karo, Jibraeel A.S tumhare sath hain." Hazrat Ka'ab bin Malik R.A shayar ne jab shu'ara ki burai Quran mein suni toh Huzoor ﷺ se arz kiya, aap ne farmaya: "Tum in mein nahin ho, momin toh jis tarah apni jaan se jihad karta hai apni zaban se bhi jihad karta hai. Wallah tum logon ke ashaar toh unhein mujahideen ke teeron ki tarah chhed daalte hain." Phir farmaya: "Zalimon ko apna anjam abhi maloom ho jayega." Unhein uzr-o-ma'azrat bhi kuch kaam na aayegi. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain: "Zalim se bacho, is se maidan-e-Qayamat mein andheron mein reh jaoge." Aayat aam hai, khwah shayar hon khwah shayar na hon, sab shamil hain. Hazrat Hasan R.H ne ek Nasrani ke janaze ko jaate hue dekh kar yahi aayat tilawat farmayi thi. Aap jab is aayat ki tilawat karte toh is qadar rote ke hichki bandh jaati.

Rum mein jab Hazrat Fudala bin Ubaid tashreef le gaye us waqt ek sahib namaz parh rahe thay jab unhon ne is aayat ki tilawat ki toh aap ne farmaya is se murad Baitullah ki barbadi karne wale hain. Kaha gaya ke is se murad Ahl-e-Makkah hain, yeh bhi marwi hai ke murad mushrik hain. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke aayat aam hai sab par mushtamil hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain mere walid Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ne apne inteqal ke waqt apni wasiyat sirf do satron mein likhi. Jo yeh thi: Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim. Yeh hai wasiyat Abu Bakr bin Abi Quhafa ki. Us waqt ki jab ke woh duniya chhor rahe thay. Jis waqt kafir bhi momin ho jata, fajir bhi tauba kar leta tab kazib ko bhi sacha samajhta hai. Main tum par apna khalifa Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko bana ja raha hoon. Agar woh adl kare toh bahut achha aur mera guman bhi un ke sath yahi hai aur agar woh zulm kare aur koi tabdeeli kar de toh main ghaib nahin janta. Zalimon ko bahut jald maloom ho jayega ke kis lautne ki jagah woh laut-te hain. Surah Ash-Shu'ara ki tafsir bihamdillah khatam hui.

Shayateen aur jadugar mushrikeen kaha karte the ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka laya hua yeh Quran bar-haq nahin. Is ne is ko khud ghar liya hai ya is ke paas jinnon ka koi sardar aata hai jo isay yeh sikha jata hai. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne Rasool ko is aitraz se pak kiya aur sabit kiya ke aap jis Quran ko laye hain woh Allah ka kalam hai, usi ka utara hua hai. Buzurg, ameen, taqatwar farishta isay laya hai. Yeh kisi shaitan ya jin ki taraf se nahin, shayateen to taleem-e-Quran se chidte hain, is ki taleemat un ke yaksar khilaf hain. Unhein kya padi ke aisa pakeeza aur rah-e-rast par lagane wala Quran woh layein aur logon ko nek rah batayein? Woh to apne jaise insani shayateen ke paas aate hain jo pet bhar kar jhoot bolne wale hon, bad-kirdar aur gunahgar hon. Aise kahinon aur bad-kirdaron aur jhoote logon ke paas jinat aur shayateen pahunchte hain kyunke woh bhi jhoote aur bad-aamal hain. Uchat-ti hui koi ek aadh baat suni sunayi pahunchate hain aur woh ek jo aasman se chhupe chhuppaye sun li to sau jhoot is mein mila kar kahinon ke kaan mein daal di. Unhon ne apni taraf se phir bahut si baatein shamil kar ke logon mein deengein maar dein. Ab ek aadh baat to sachi nikli lekin logon ne un ki aur sau jhooti baatein bhi sachi maan lein aur tabah huye. Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke logon ne kahinon ke bare mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya to aap ne farmaya woh koi cheez nahin hain. Logon ne kaha Huzoor! kabhi kabhi to un ki koi baat khari bhi nikal aati hai? Aap ne farmaya haan, yeh wohi baat hoti hai jo jinat aasman se uda late hain aur un ke kaan mein keh kar jate hain, phir is ke sath jhoot apni taraf se mila kar keh dete hain. Sahih Bukhari Shareef ki ek hadith mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala kisi kaam ka faisla aasman par karta hai to farishte ba-adab apne par jhuka dete hain. Aisi aawaz aati hai jaise kisi chattan par zanjeer bajayi jati ho. Jab woh ghabrahat un ke dilon se door hoti hai to aapas mein daryaft karte hain ke Rabb ka kya hukm sadir hua hai? Dusre jawab dete hain ke Rabb ne yeh farmaya aur woh aali-shan aur bahut badi kibriya wala hai. Kabhi kabhi Amr-e-Ilahi se chori chhupe sunne wale kisi jin ke kaan mein bhunak pad jati hai jo is tarah ek par ek par ho kar wahan tak pahunch jate hain. Rawi-e-Hadith Hazrat Sufyan ne apne hathon ki ungliyan phaila kar is par dusra hath is tarah rakh kar unhein hila kar bataya ke is tarah. Ab upar wala neeche wale ko aur woh apne se neeche wale ko woh baat batla deta hai yahan tak ke jadugar aur kahin ko woh pahuncha dete hain. Kabhi aisa bhi hota hai ke baat pahunchate is se pehle shola pahunch jata hai aur kabhi is ke pehle hi woh pahuncha dete hain. Is mein kahin-o-jadugar apne sau jhoot shamil kar ke mashhoor karta hai, chunke woh ek baat sachi nikalti hai, log sab baton ko hi sacha samajhne lagte hain.

In tamam ahadees ka bayan aayat (Hatta iza fuzzi'a an quloobihim qalu maza, qala rabbukum, qalul haq, wa huwal aliyyul kabeer) (Surah Saba: 23) ki tafseer mein aayega. Insha'Allah. Bukhari Shareef ki ek hadees mein yeh bhi hai ke farishtay aasmani amr ki baat cheet badalon par karte hain jisay shaitan sun kar kahinon tak pahunchate hain aur woh ek sach mein sau jhoot milate hain. Phir farmaya ke kafir shairon ki itteba gumrah log karte hain. Arab ke shairon ka dastoor tha kisi ki muzammat aur hajv mein kuch keh daalte thay, logon ki ek jamaat unke saath ho jaati thi aur uski haan mein haan milane lagti thi. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Sahaba (R.A) ki ek jamaat ke saath 'Arj mein ja rahe thay, raastay mein ek shair sher-khwani karte hue mila. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya is shaitan ko pakad lo ya farmaya roko. Tum mein se koi shakhs khoon aur peep se apna pait bhar le, yeh is se behtar hai ke woh sheron se apna pait bhare. Inhein har jangal ki thokarain khaate kisi ne nahin dekha? Har laghv mein yeh ghus jaate hain. Kalam ke har fan mein bolte hain. Kabhi kisi ki tareef mein zameen aur aasman ke qulabey milate hain. Kabhi kisi ki muzammat mein aasman-o-zameen sar par uthate hain, jhooti khushamad, jhooti buraiyan, ghadi hui badiyan inke hissay mein aayi hain. Yeh zaban ke bhand hote hain lekin kaam ke kaahil. Ek Ansari aur ek doosri qoum ke shakhs ne hajv ka muqabla kiya jis mein dono ki qoum ke bade bade log bhi unke saath ho gaye. Pas is aayat mein yahi hai ke unka saath dene wale gumrah log hain. Woh woh baatein baka karte hain jinhein kisi ne kabhi kiya na ho. Isi liye ulama ne is baat mein ikhtilaf kiya hai ke agar kisi shair ne apne sher mein kisi aisay gunah ka iqrar kiya ho jis par had-e-shara wajib hoti ho to aaya woh had us par jaari ki jayegi ya nahin? Dono taraf ulama gaye. Waqai woh fakhr-o-ghuroor ke saath aisi baatein bak dete hain ke main ne yeh kiya aur woh kiya, halankeh na kuch kiya ho aur na hi kar sakte hon. Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne apni khilafat ke zamane mein Hazrat Numan bin Adi bin Fazla ko Basra ke shehar Misan ka governor muqarrar kiya tha. Woh shair thay, ek martaba apne sheron mein kaha ke kya haseenon ko yeh ittila nahin hui ke unka mehboob Misan mein hai jahan har waqt sheeshay ke glasson mein daur-e-sharab chal raha hai aur gaon ki bholi ladkiyon ke gaanay aur unke raqs-o-suroor muhayya hain. Haan agar mere kisi dost se ho sakay to is baday aur bharey hue jaam mujhe pilaye lekin un se chotay jaam mujhe sakht na-pasand hain. Allah karay Ameer-ul-Momineen ko yeh khabar na pahunchay warna bura maanenge aur saza denge. Yeh ashaar sach much Hazrat Ameer-ul-Momineen (R.A) tak pahunch gaye, Aap (R.A) sakht naraz hue aur usi waqt aadmi bheja ke main ne tujhe tere ohday se mazool kiya. Aur Aap (R.A) ne ek khat bheja jis mein Bismillah ke baad Ha-Meem ki teen aayatein (Ilayhil Maseer) tak likh kar phir tehreer farmaya ke tere ashaar se mujhe sakht ranj hua.

Unhein kya padi ke aisa pakeeza aur rah-e-rast par lagane wala Quran woh layein aur logon ko nek rah batayein? Woh to apne jaise insani shayateen ke paas aate hain jo pet bhar kar jhoot bolne wale hon, bad-kirdar aur gunahgar hon. Aise kahinon aur bad-kirdaron aur jhoote logon ke paas jinat aur shayateen pahunchte hain kyunke woh bhi jhoote aur bad-aamal hain. Uchat-ti hui koi ek aadh baat suni sunayi pahunchate hain aur woh ek jo aasman se chhupe chhuppaye sun li to sau jhoot is mein mila kar kahinon ke kaan mein daal di. Unhon ne apni taraf se phir bahut si baatein shamil kar ke logon mein deengein maar dein. Ab ek aadh baat to sachi nikli lekin logon ne un ki aur sau jhooti baatein bhi sachi maan lein aur tabah huye. Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke logon ne kahinon ke bare mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya to aap ne farmaya woh koi cheez nahin hain. Logon ne kaha Huzoor! kabhi kabhi to un ki koi baat khari bhi nikal aati hai? Aap ne farmaya haan, yeh wohi baat hoti hai jo jinat aasman se uda late hain aur un ke kaan mein keh kar jate hain, phir is ke sath jhoot apni taraf se mila kar keh dete hain. Sahih Bukhari Shareef ki ek hadith mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala kisi kaam ka faisla aasman par karta hai to farishte ba-adab apne par jhuka dete hain. Aisi aawaz aati hai jaise kisi chattan par zanjeer bajayi jati ho. Jab woh ghabrahat un ke dilon se door hoti hai to aapas mein daryaft karte hain ke Rabb ka kya hukm sadir hua hai? Dusre jawab dete hain ke Rabb ne yeh farmaya aur woh aali-shan aur bahut badi kibriya wala hai. Kabhi kabhi Amr-e-Ilahi se chori chhupe sunne wale kisi jin ke kaan mein bhunak pad jati hai jo is tarah ek par ek par ho kar wahan tak pahunch jate hain. Rawi-e-Hadith Hazrat Sufyan ne apne hathon ki ungliyan phaila kar is par dusra hath is tarah rakh kar unhein hila kar bataya ke is tarah. Ab upar wala neeche wale ko aur woh apne se neeche wale ko woh baat batla deta hai yahan tak ke jadugar aur kahin ko woh pahuncha dete hain. Kabhi aisa bhi hota hai ke baat pahunchate is se pehle shola pahunch jata hai aur kabhi is ke pehle hi woh pahuncha dete hain. Is mein kahin-o-jadugar apne sau jhoot shamil kar ke mashhoor karta hai, chunke woh ek baat sachi nikalti hai, log sab baton ko hi sacha samajhne lagte hain.

In tamam ahadees ka bayan aayat (Hatta iza fuzzi'a an quloobihim qalu maza, qala rabbukum, qalul haq, wa huwal aliyyul kabeer) (Surah Saba: 23) ki tafseer mein aayega. Insha'Allah. Bukhari Shareef ki ek hadees mein yeh bhi hai ke farishtay aasmani amr ki baat cheet badalon par karte hain jisay shaitan sun kar kahinon tak pahunchate hain aur woh ek sach mein sau jhoot milate hain. Phir farmaya ke kafir shairon ki itteba gumrah log karte hain. Arab ke shairon ka dastoor tha kisi ki muzammat aur hajv mein kuch keh daalte thay, logon ki ek jamaat unke saath ho jaati thi aur uski haan mein haan milane lagti thi. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Sahaba (R.A) ki ek jamaat ke saath 'Arj mein ja rahe thay, raastay mein ek shair sher-khwani karte hue mila. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya is shaitan ko pakad lo ya farmaya roko. Tum mein se koi shakhs khoon aur peep se apna pait bhar le, yeh is se behtar hai ke woh sheron se apna pait bhare. Inhein har jangal ki thokarain khaate kisi ne nahin dekha? Har laghv mein yeh ghus jaate hain. Kalam ke har fan mein bolte hain. Kabhi kisi ki tareef mein zameen aur aasman ke qulabey milate hain. Kabhi kisi ki muzammat mein aasman-o-zameen sar par uthate hain, jhooti khushamad, jhooti buraiyan, ghadi hui badiyan inke hissay mein aayi hain. Yeh zaban ke bhand hote hain lekin kaam ke kaahil. Ek Ansari aur ek doosri qoum ke shakhs ne hajv ka muqabla kiya jis mein dono ki qoum ke bade bade log bhi unke saath ho gaye. Pas is aayat mein yahi hai ke unka saath dene wale gumrah log hain. Woh woh baatein baka karte hain jinhein kisi ne kabhi kiya na ho. Isi liye ulama ne is baat mein ikhtilaf kiya hai ke agar kisi shair ne apne sher mein kisi aisay gunah ka iqrar kiya ho jis par had-e-shara wajib hoti ho to aaya woh had us par jaari ki jayegi ya nahin? Dono taraf ulama gaye. Waqai woh fakhr-o-ghuroor ke saath aisi baatein bak dete hain ke main ne yeh kiya aur woh kiya, halankeh na kuch kiya ho aur na hi kar sakte hon. Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne apni khilafat ke zamane mein Hazrat Numan bin Adi bin Fazla ko Basra ke shehar Misan ka governor muqarrar kiya tha. Woh shair thay, ek martaba apne sheron mein kaha ke kya haseenon ko yeh ittila nahin hui ke unka mehboob Misan mein hai jahan har waqt sheeshay ke glasson mein daur-e-sharab chal raha hai aur gaon ki bholi ladkiyon ke gaanay aur unke raqs-o-suroor muhayya hain. Haan agar mere kisi dost se ho sakay to is baday aur bharey hue jaam mujhe pilaye lekin un se chotay jaam mujhe sakht na-pasand hain. Allah karay Ameer-ul-Momineen ko yeh khabar na pahunchay warna bura maanenge aur saza denge. Yeh ashaar sach much Hazrat Ameer-ul-Momineen (R.A) tak pahunch gaye, Aap (R.A) sakht naraz hue aur usi waqt aadmi bheja ke main ne tujhe tere ohday se mazool kiya. Aur Aap (R.A) ne ek khat bheja jis mein Bismillah ke baad Ha-Meem ki teen aayatein (Ilayhil Maseer) tak likh kar phir tehreer farmaya ke tere ashaar se mujhe sakht ranj hua.

Main tujhe tere ohday se mazool karta hoon. Chunancha is khat ko parhte hi Hazrat Noman darbar-e-khilafat mein hazir hue aur ba-adab arz kiya ke Amir-ul-Momineen wallah na main ne kabhi sharab pi, na naach rang-o-gana bajana dekha, na suna. Yeh toh sirf shairana tarang thi. Aap ne farmaya yahi mera khayal hai lekin meri toh himmat nahin parti ke aisay fahash-go shair ko koi ohda do. Pas maloom hua ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke nazdeek bhi shair apne sheron mein kisi jurm ke elaan par agarche woh qabil-e-hadd ho toh hadd nahin lagayi jaye gi is liye ke woh jo kehte hain so karte nahin, haan woh qabil-e-malamat aur laiq-e-sarzanish zaroor hain. Chunancha hadith mein hai ke pait ko lahoo peep se bhar lena ashaar se bhar lene se badtar hai. Matlab yeh ke Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ) na toh shair hain, na sahir, na kahin, na muftari hain. Aap ka zahir-e-haal hi aap ke in ayoob se bara'at ka bohat bada aadil gawah hai jaise farman hai ke toh hum ne inhe shair-goi sikhayi hai na is ke laiq hai, yeh toh sirf nasihat aur Quran-e-Mubeen hai. Aur aayat mein hai yeh Rasool-e-Kareem ka qaul hai kisi shair ka nahin, tum mein imaan ki kami hai, yeh kisi kahin ka qaul nahin. Tum mein nasihat maanne ka mada kam hai, yeh toh Rabb-ul-Alameen ki utari hui kitab hai. Is surat mein bhi yahi farmaya gaya ke yeh Rabb-ul-Alameen ki taraf se utri hai. Rooh-ul-Ameen ne tere dil par nazil farmayi hai, Arabi zaban mein hai is liye ke tu logon ko aagah kar de, isay shaitan le kar nahin aaye, na yeh un ke laiq hai na un ki bas ki baat hai, woh toh is ke sunne se bhi alag kar diye gaye hain. Jo jhootay muftari aur bad-kirdar hotay hain un ke paas shaitan aatay hain jo uchat-ti baatein sun suna kar un ke kaanon mein aa kar daal jatay hain. Mehez jhoot bolne walay yeh khud hotay hain, shairon ki pusht panahi obashon ka kaam hai, woh toh har wadi mein sar-gardan hotay hain, zabani baatein banatay hain, amal se koray rehtay hain. Is ke baad jo farman hai is ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke is se agli aayat jis mein shairon ki muzammat hai jab utri toh darbar-e-Rasool ke shu'ara Hazrat Hassan bin Sabit, Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawaha, Hazrat Ka'ab bin Malik (R.A) rotay hue darbar-e-Nabi (ﷺ) mein hazir hue aur kehne lage ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) shairon ki toh yeh gat bani aur hum bhi shair hain, isi waqt aap ne yeh dusri aayat tilawat farmayi ke imaan lane walay aur naik amal karne walay tum ho, zikr-e-Allah bakasrat karne walay tum ho, mazloom ho kar badla lene walay tum ho, pas tum un se mustasna ho (Ibn Abi Hatim waghera). Ek riwayat mein Hazrat Ka'ab ka naam hai, ek riwayat mein sirf Abdullah ki is shikayat par ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) shair toh main bhi hoon is dusri aayat ka nazil hona marwi hai lekin yeh qabil-e-nazar.

Is liye ke yeh Surah Makkiyah hai, shu'ara-e-Ansar jitne bhi thay woh sab Madine mein thay, phir un ke bare mein is aayat ka nazil hona yaqeenan mahal-e-ghaur hoga aur jo hadeesein bayan huin woh mursal hain, is wajah se aitimaad nahin ho sakta hai. Yeh aayat ka nazool beshak istisna ke bare mein hai aur sirf yahi Ansari shu'ara R.A hi nahin, balkeh agar kisi shayar ne apni jahiliyat ke zamane mein Islam aur musalmanon ke khilaf bhi ashaar kahe hon aur phir musalman ho jaye, tauba kar le aur us ke muqable mein zikr-e-Allah bakasrat kare, woh beshak is burai se alag hai. Hasanat sayyi'aat ko door kar deti hain, jabkeh us ne musalman ko aur deen-e-haq ko bura kaha tha woh bura tha, lekin jab us ne un ki madh ki toh burai bhalai se badal gayi. Jaise Hazrat Abdullah bin Ziba'ri R.A ne Islam se pehle Huzoor ﷺ ki hajv bayan ki thi lekin Islam ke baad badi madh bayan ki aur apne ashaar mein is hajv ka uzr bhi bayan karte hue kaha: "Main us waqt shaitani panja mein phansa hua tha." Isi tarah Abu Sufyan bin Haris bin Abdul Muttalib bawajood aap ka chacha zaad bhai hone ke aap ka jaani dushman tha aur bahut hajv kiya karta tha, jab musalman hue toh aise musalman hue ke duniya bhar mein Huzoor ﷺ se zyada mehboob unhein koi na tha. Aksar aap ki madh kiya karte thay aur bahut hi aqeedat-o-mohabbat rakhte thay. Sahih Muslim mein Ibn Abbas R.A se marvi hai ke Abu Sufyan Sakhr bin Harb jab musalman hua toh Huzoor ﷺ se kehne laga: "Mujhe teen cheezein ata farmaiye, ek toh yeh ke mere ladke Mu'awiyah ko apna katib bana lijiye. Dusre mujhe kafiron se jihad ke liye bhejiye aur mere sath koi lashkar dijiye taake jis tarah kufr mein musalmanon se lada karta tha ab Islam mein kafiron ki khabar loon." Aap ne dono baatein qabool farmayin, ek teesri darkhwast bhi ki jo qabool ki gayi. Pas aise log is aayat ke hukm se is dusri aayat se alag kar liye gaye. Zikr-e-Allah khwah woh apne sher'on mein bakasrat karein khwah aur tarah apne kalam mein, yaqeenan woh agle gunahon ka badla aur kaffara hai. Apni mazloomi ka badla lete hain, yani kafiron ki hajv ka jawab dete hain. Khud Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Hassan R.A se farmaya tha: "In kuffar ki hajv karo, Jibraeel A.S tumhare sath hain." Hazrat Ka'ab bin Malik R.A shayar ne jab shu'ara ki burai Quran mein suni toh Huzoor ﷺ se arz kiya, aap ne farmaya: "Tum in mein nahin ho, momin toh jis tarah apni jaan se jihad karta hai apni zaban se bhi jihad karta hai. Wallah tum logon ke ashaar toh unhein mujahideen ke teeron ki tarah chhed daalte hain." Phir farmaya: "Zalimon ko apna anjam abhi maloom ho jayega." Unhein uzr-o-ma'azrat bhi kuch kaam na aayegi. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain: "Zalim se bacho, is se maidan-e-Qayamat mein andheron mein reh jaoge." Aayat aam hai, khwah shayar hon khwah shayar na hon, sab shamil hain. Hazrat Hasan R.H ne ek Nasrani ke janaze ko jaate hue dekh kar yahi aayat tilawat farmayi thi. Aap jab is aayat ki tilawat karte toh is qadar rote ke hichki bandh jaati.

Rum mein jab Hazrat Fudala bin Ubaid tashreef le gaye us waqt ek sahib namaz parh rahe thay jab unhon ne is aayat ki tilawat ki toh aap ne farmaya is se murad Baitullah ki barbadi karne wale hain. Kaha gaya ke is se murad Ahl-e-Makkah hain, yeh bhi marwi hai ke murad mushrik hain. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke aayat aam hai sab par mushtamil hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain mere walid Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ne apne inteqal ke waqt apni wasiyat sirf do satron mein likhi. Jo yeh thi: Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim. Yeh hai wasiyat Abu Bakr bin Abi Quhafa ki. Us waqt ki jab ke woh duniya chhor rahe thay. Jis waqt kafir bhi momin ho jata, fajir bhi tauba kar leta tab kazib ko bhi sacha samajhta hai. Main tum par apna khalifa Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko bana ja raha hoon. Agar woh adl kare toh bahut achha aur mera guman bhi un ke sath yahi hai aur agar woh zulm kare aur koi tabdeeli kar de toh main ghaib nahin janta. Zalimon ko bahut jald maloom ho jayega ke kis lautne ki jagah woh laut-te hain. Surah Ash-Shu'ara ki tafsir bihamdillah khatam hui.

Rooh-ul-Ameen ne tere dil par nazil farmayi hai, Arabi zaban mein hai is liye ke tu logon ko aagah kar de, isay shaitan le kar nahin aaye, na yeh un ke laiq hai na un ki bas ki baat hai, woh toh is ke sunne se bhi alag kar diye gaye hain. Jo jhootay muftari aur bad-kirdar hotay hain un ke paas shaitan aatay hain jo uchat-ti baatein sun suna kar un ke kaanon mein aa kar daal jatay hain. Mehez jhoot bolne walay yeh khud hotay hain, shairon ki pusht panahi obashon ka kaam hai, woh toh har wadi mein sar-gardan hotay hain, zabani baatein banatay hain, amal se koray rehtay hain. Is ke baad jo farman hai is ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke is se agli aayat jis mein shairon ki muzammat hai jab utri toh darbar-e-Rasool ke shu'ara Hazrat Hassan bin Sabit, Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawaha, Hazrat Ka'ab bin Malik (R.A) rotay hue darbar-e-Nabi (ﷺ) mein hazir hue aur kehne lage ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) shairon ki toh yeh gat bani aur hum bhi shair hain, isi waqt aap ne yeh dusri aayat tilawat farmayi ke imaan lane walay aur naik amal karne walay tum ho, zikr-e-Allah bakasrat karne walay tum ho, mazloom ho kar badla lene walay tum ho, pas tum un se mustasna ho (Ibn Abi Hatim waghera). Ek riwayat mein Hazrat Ka'ab ka naam hai, ek riwayat mein sirf Abdullah ki is shikayat par ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) shair toh main bhi hoon is dusri aayat ka nazil hona marwi hai lekin yeh qabil-e-nazar.

Is liye ke yeh Surah Makkiyah hai, shu'ara-e-Ansar jitne bhi thay woh sab Madine mein thay, phir un ke bare mein is aayat ka nazil hona yaqeenan mahal-e-ghaur hoga aur jo hadeesein bayan huin woh mursal hain, is wajah se aitimaad nahin ho sakta hai. Yeh aayat ka nazool beshak istisna ke bare mein hai aur sirf yahi Ansari shu'ara R.A hi nahin, balkeh agar kisi shayar ne apni jahiliyat ke zamane mein Islam aur musalmanon ke khilaf bhi ashaar kahe hon aur phir musalman ho jaye, tauba kar le aur us ke muqable mein zikr-e-Allah bakasrat kare, woh beshak is burai se alag hai. Hasanat sayyi'aat ko door kar deti hain, jabkeh us ne musalman ko aur deen-e-haq ko bura kaha tha woh bura tha, lekin jab us ne un ki madh ki toh burai bhalai se badal gayi. Jaise Hazrat Abdullah bin Ziba'ri R.A ne Islam se pehle Huzoor ﷺ ki hajv bayan ki thi lekin Islam ke baad badi madh bayan ki aur apne ashaar mein is hajv ka uzr bhi bayan karte hue kaha: "Main us waqt shaitani panja mein phansa hua tha." Isi tarah Abu Sufyan bin Haris bin Abdul Muttalib bawajood aap ka chacha zaad bhai hone ke aap ka jaani dushman tha aur bahut hajv kiya karta tha, jab musalman hue toh aise musalman hue ke duniya bhar mein Huzoor ﷺ se zyada mehboob unhein koi na tha. Aksar aap ki madh kiya karte thay aur bahut hi aqeedat-o-mohabbat rakhte thay. Sahih Muslim mein Ibn Abbas R.A se marvi hai ke Abu Sufyan Sakhr bin Harb jab musalman hua toh Huzoor ﷺ se kehne laga: "Mujhe teen cheezein ata farmaiye, ek toh yeh ke mere ladke Mu'awiyah ko apna katib bana lijiye. Dusre mujhe kafiron se jihad ke liye bhejiye aur mere sath koi lashkar dijiye taake jis tarah kufr mein musalmanon se lada karta tha ab Islam mein kafiron ki khabar loon." Aap ne dono baatein qabool farmayin, ek teesri darkhwast bhi ki jo qabool ki gayi. Pas aise log is aayat ke hukm se is dusri aayat se alag kar liye gaye. Zikr-e-Allah khwah woh apne sher'on mein bakasrat karein khwah aur tarah apne kalam mein, yaqeenan woh agle gunahon ka badla aur kaffara hai. Apni mazloomi ka badla lete hain, yani kafiron ki hajv ka jawab dete hain. Khud Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Hassan R.A se farmaya tha: "In kuffar ki hajv karo, Jibraeel A.S tumhare sath hain." Hazrat Ka'ab bin Malik R.A shayar ne jab shu'ara ki burai Quran mein suni toh Huzoor ﷺ se arz kiya, aap ne farmaya: "Tum in mein nahin ho, momin toh jis tarah apni jaan se jihad karta hai apni zaban se bhi jihad karta hai. Wallah tum logon ke ashaar toh unhein mujahideen ke teeron ki tarah chhed daalte hain." Phir farmaya: "Zalimon ko apna anjam abhi maloom ho jayega." Unhein uzr-o-ma'azrat bhi kuch kaam na aayegi. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain: "Zalim se bacho, is se maidan-e-Qayamat mein andheron mein reh jaoge." Aayat aam hai, khwah shayar hon khwah shayar na hon, sab shamil hain. Hazrat Hasan R.H ne ek Nasrani ke janaze ko jaate hue dekh kar yahi aayat tilawat farmayi thi. Aap jab is aayat ki tilawat karte toh is qadar rote ke hichki bandh jaati.

Rum mein jab Hazrat Fudala bin Ubaid tashreef le gaye us waqt ek sahib namaz parh rahe thay jab unhon ne is aayat ki tilawat ki toh aap ne farmaya is se murad Baitullah ki barbadi karne wale hain. Kaha gaya ke is se murad Ahl-e-Makkah hain, yeh bhi marwi hai ke murad mushrik hain. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke aayat aam hai sab par mushtamil hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain mere walid Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ne apne inteqal ke waqt apni wasiyat sirf do satron mein likhi. Jo yeh thi: Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim. Yeh hai wasiyat Abu Bakr bin Abi Quhafa ki. Us waqt ki jab ke woh duniya chhor rahe thay. Jis waqt kafir bhi momin ho jata, fajir bhi tauba kar leta tab kazib ko bhi sacha samajhta hai. Main tum par apna khalifa Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko bana ja raha hoon. Agar woh adl kare toh bahut achha aur mera guman bhi un ke sath yahi hai aur agar woh zulm kare aur koi tabdeeli kar de toh main ghaib nahin janta. Zalimon ko bahut jald maloom ho jayega ke kis lautne ki jagah woh laut-te hain. Surah Ash-Shu'ara ki tafsir bihamdillah khatam hui.

Shayateen aur jadugar mushrikeen kaha karte the ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka laya hua yeh Quran bar-haq nahin. Is ne is ko khud ghar liya hai ya is ke paas jinnon ka koi sardar aata hai jo isay yeh sikha jata hai. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne Rasool ko is aitraz se pak kiya aur sabit kiya ke aap jis Quran ko laye hain woh Allah ka kalam hai, usi ka utara hua hai. Buzurg, ameen, taqatwar farishta isay laya hai. Yeh kisi shaitan ya jin ki taraf se nahin, shayateen to taleem-e-Quran se chidte hain, is ki taleemat un ke yaksar khilaf hain. Unhein kya padi ke aisa pakeeza aur rah-e-rast par lagane wala Quran woh layein aur logon ko nek rah batayein? Woh to apne jaise insani shayateen ke paas aate hain jo pet bhar kar jhoot bolne wale hon, bad-kirdar aur gunahgar hon. Aise kahinon aur bad-kirdaron aur jhoote logon ke paas jinat aur shayateen pahunchte hain kyunke woh bhi jhoote aur bad-aamal hain. Uchat-ti hui koi ek aadh baat suni sunayi pahunchate hain aur woh ek jo aasman se chhupe chhuppaye sun li to sau jhoot is mein mila kar kahinon ke kaan mein daal di. Unhon ne apni taraf se phir bahut si baatein shamil kar ke logon mein deengein maar dein. Ab ek aadh baat to sachi nikli lekin logon ne un ki aur sau jhooti baatein bhi sachi maan lein aur tabah huye. Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke logon ne kahinon ke bare mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya to aap ne farmaya woh koi cheez nahin hain. Logon ne kaha Huzoor! kabhi kabhi to un ki koi baat khari bhi nikal aati hai? Aap ne farmaya haan, yeh wohi baat hoti hai jo jinat aasman se uda late hain aur un ke kaan mein keh kar jate hain, phir is ke sath jhoot apni taraf se mila kar keh dete hain. Sahih Bukhari Shareef ki ek hadith mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala kisi kaam ka faisla aasman par karta hai to farishte ba-adab apne par jhuka dete hain. Aisi aawaz aati hai jaise kisi chattan par zanjeer bajayi jati ho. Jab woh ghabrahat un ke dilon se door hoti hai to aapas mein daryaft karte hain ke Rabb ka kya hukm sadir hua hai? Dusre jawab dete hain ke Rabb ne yeh farmaya aur woh aali-shan aur bahut badi kibriya wala hai. Kabhi kabhi Amr-e-Ilahi se chori chhupe sunne wale kisi jin ke kaan mein bhunak pad jati hai jo is tarah ek par ek par ho kar wahan tak pahunch jate hain. Rawi-e-Hadith Hazrat Sufyan ne apne hathon ki ungliyan phaila kar is par dusra hath is tarah rakh kar unhein hila kar bataya ke is tarah. Ab upar wala neeche wale ko aur woh apne se neeche wale ko woh baat batla deta hai yahan tak ke jadugar aur kahin ko woh pahuncha dete hain. Kabhi aisa bhi hota hai ke baat pahunchate is se pehle shola pahunch jata hai aur kabhi is ke pehle hi woh pahuncha dete hain. Is mein kahin-o-jadugar apne sau jhoot shamil kar ke mashhoor karta hai, chunke woh ek baat sachi nikalti hai, log sab baton ko hi sacha samajhne lagte hain.

In tamam ahadees ka bayan aayat (Hatta iza fuzzi'a an quloobihim qalu maza, qala rabbukum, qalul haq, wa huwal aliyyul kabeer) (Surah Saba: 23) ki tafseer mein aayega. Insha'Allah. Bukhari Shareef ki ek hadees mein yeh bhi hai ke farishtay aasmani amr ki baat cheet badalon par karte hain jisay shaitan sun kar kahinon tak pahunchate hain aur woh ek sach mein sau jhoot milate hain. Phir farmaya ke kafir shairon ki itteba gumrah log karte hain. Arab ke shairon ka dastoor tha kisi ki muzammat aur hajv mein kuch keh daalte thay, logon ki ek jamaat unke saath ho jaati thi aur uski haan mein haan milane lagti thi. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Sahaba (R.A) ki ek jamaat ke saath 'Arj mein ja rahe thay, raastay mein ek shair sher-khwani karte hue mila. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya is shaitan ko pakad lo ya farmaya roko. Tum mein se koi shakhs khoon aur peep se apna pait bhar le, yeh is se behtar hai ke woh sheron se apna pait bhare. Inhein har jangal ki thokarain khaate kisi ne nahin dekha? Har laghv mein yeh ghus jaate hain. Kalam ke har fan mein bolte hain. Kabhi kisi ki tareef mein zameen aur aasman ke qulabey milate hain. Kabhi kisi ki muzammat mein aasman-o-zameen sar par uthate hain, jhooti khushamad, jhooti buraiyan, ghadi hui badiyan inke hissay mein aayi hain. Yeh zaban ke bhand hote hain lekin kaam ke kaahil. Ek Ansari aur ek doosri qoum ke shakhs ne hajv ka muqabla kiya jis mein dono ki qoum ke bade bade log bhi unke saath ho gaye. Pas is aayat mein yahi hai ke unka saath dene wale gumrah log hain. Woh woh baatein baka karte hain jinhein kisi ne kabhi kiya na ho. Isi liye ulama ne is baat mein ikhtilaf kiya hai ke agar kisi shair ne apne sher mein kisi aisay gunah ka iqrar kiya ho jis par had-e-shara wajib hoti ho to aaya woh had us par jaari ki jayegi ya nahin? Dono taraf ulama gaye. Waqai woh fakhr-o-ghuroor ke saath aisi baatein bak dete hain ke main ne yeh kiya aur woh kiya, halankeh na kuch kiya ho aur na hi kar sakte hon. Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne apni khilafat ke zamane mein Hazrat Numan bin Adi bin Fazla ko Basra ke shehar Misan ka governor muqarrar kiya tha. Woh shair thay, ek martaba apne sheron mein kaha ke kya haseenon ko yeh ittila nahin hui ke unka mehboob Misan mein hai jahan har waqt sheeshay ke glasson mein daur-e-sharab chal raha hai aur gaon ki bholi ladkiyon ke gaanay aur unke raqs-o-suroor muhayya hain. Haan agar mere kisi dost se ho sakay to is baday aur bharey hue jaam mujhe pilaye lekin un se chotay jaam mujhe sakht na-pasand hain. Allah karay Ameer-ul-Momineen ko yeh khabar na pahunchay warna bura maanenge aur saza denge. Yeh ashaar sach much Hazrat Ameer-ul-Momineen (R.A) tak pahunch gaye, Aap (R.A) sakht naraz hue aur usi waqt aadmi bheja ke main ne tujhe tere ohday se mazool kiya. Aur Aap (R.A) ne ek khat bheja jis mein Bismillah ke baad Ha-Meem ki teen aayatein (Ilayhil Maseer) tak likh kar phir tehreer farmaya ke tere ashaar se mujhe sakht ranj hua.

Main tujhe tere ohday se mazool karta hoon. Chunancha is khat ko parhte hi Hazrat Noman darbar-e-khilafat mein hazir hue aur ba-adab arz kiya ke Amir-ul-Momineen wallah na main ne kabhi sharab pi, na naach rang-o-gana bajana dekha, na suna. Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke logon ne kahinon ke bare mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya to aap ne farmaya woh koi cheez nahin hain. Logon ne kaha Huzoor! kabhi kabhi to un ki koi baat khari bhi nikal aati hai? Aap ne farmaya haan, yeh wohi baat hoti hai jo jinat aasman se uda late hain aur un ke kaan mein keh kar jate hain, phir is ke sath jhoot apni taraf se mila kar keh dete hain. Sahih Bukhari Shareef ki ek hadith mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala kisi kaam ka faisla aasman par karta hai to farishte ba-adab apne par jhuka dete hain. Aisi aawaz aati hai jaise kisi chattan par zanjeer bajayi jati ho. Jab woh ghabrahat un ke dilon se door hoti hai to aapas mein daryaft karte hain ke Rabb ka kya hukm sadir hua hai? Dusre jawab dete hain ke Rabb ne yeh farmaya aur woh aali-shan aur bahut badi kibriya wala hai. Kabhi kabhi Amr-e-Ilahi se chori chhupe sunne wale kisi jin ke kaan mein bhunak pad jati hai jo is tarah ek par ek par ho kar wahan tak pahunch jate hain. Rawi-e-Hadith Hazrat Sufyan ne apne hathon ki ungliyan phaila kar is par dusra hath is tarah rakh kar unhein hila kar bataya ke is tarah. Ab upar wala neeche wale ko aur woh apne se neeche wale ko woh baat batla deta hai yahan tak ke jadugar aur kahin ko woh pahuncha dete hain. Kabhi aisa bhi hota hai ke baat pahunchate is se pehle shola pahunch jata hai aur kabhi is ke pehle hi woh pahuncha dete hain. Is mein kahin-o-jadugar apne sau jhoot shamil kar ke mashhoor karta hai, chunke woh ek baat sachi nikalti hai, log sab baton ko hi sacha samajhne lagte hain.

In tamam ahadees ka bayan aayat (Hatta iza fuzzi'a an quloobihim qalu maza, qala rabbukum, qalul haq, wa huwal aliyyul kabeer) (Surah Saba: 23) ki tafseer mein aayega. Insha'Allah. Bukhari Shareef ki ek hadees mein yeh bhi hai ke farishtay aasmani amr ki baat cheet badalon par karte hain jisay shaitan sun kar kahinon tak pahunchate hain aur woh ek sach mein sau jhoot milate hain. Phir farmaya ke kafir shairon ki itteba gumrah log karte hain. Arab ke shairon ka dastoor tha kisi ki muzammat aur hajv mein kuch keh daalte thay, logon ki ek jamaat unke saath ho jaati thi aur uski haan mein haan milane lagti thi. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Sahaba (R.A) ki ek jamaat ke saath 'Arj mein ja rahe thay, raastay mein ek shair sher-khwani karte hue mila. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya is shaitan ko pakad lo ya farmaya roko. Tum mein se koi shakhs khoon aur peep se apna pait bhar le, yeh is se behtar hai ke woh sheron se apna pait bhare. Inhein har jangal ki thokarain khaate kisi ne nahin dekha? Har laghv mein yeh ghus jaate hain. Kalam ke har fan mein bolte hain. Kabhi kisi ki tareef mein zameen aur aasman ke qulabey milate hain. Kabhi kisi ki muzammat mein aasman-o-zameen sar par uthate hain, jhooti khushamad, jhooti buraiyan, ghadi hui badiyan inke hissay mein aayi hain. Yeh zaban ke bhand hote hain lekin kaam ke kaahil. Ek Ansari aur ek doosri qoum ke shakhs ne hajv ka muqabla kiya jis mein dono ki qoum ke bade bade log bhi unke saath ho gaye. Pas is aayat mein yahi hai ke unka saath dene wale gumrah log hain. Woh woh baatein baka karte hain jinhein kisi ne kabhi kiya na ho. Isi liye ulama ne is baat mein ikhtilaf kiya hai ke agar kisi shair ne apne sher mein kisi aisay gunah ka iqrar kiya ho jis par had-e-shara wajib hoti ho to aaya woh had us par jaari ki jayegi ya nahin? Dono taraf ulama gaye. Waqai woh fakhr-o-ghuroor ke saath aisi baatein bak dete hain ke main ne yeh kiya aur woh kiya, halankeh na kuch kiya ho aur na hi kar sakte hon. Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne apni khilafat ke zamane mein Hazrat Numan bin Adi bin Fazla ko Basra ke shehar Misan ka governor muqarrar kiya tha. Woh shair thay, ek martaba apne sheron mein kaha ke kya haseenon ko yeh ittila nahin hui ke unka mehboob Misan mein hai jahan har waqt sheeshay ke glasson mein daur-e-sharab chal raha hai aur gaon ki bholi ladkiyon ke gaanay aur unke raqs-o-suroor muhayya hain. Haan agar mere kisi dost se ho sakay to is baday aur bharey hue jaam mujhe pilaye lekin un se chotay jaam mujhe sakht na-pasand hain. Allah karay Ameer-ul-Momineen ko yeh khabar na pahunchay warna bura maanenge aur saza denge. Yeh ashaar sach much Hazrat Ameer-ul-Momineen (R.A) tak pahunch gaye, Aap (R.A) sakht naraz hue aur usi waqt aadmi bheja ke main ne tujhe tere ohday se mazool kiya. Aur Aap (R.A) ne ek khat bheja jis mein Bismillah ke baad Ha-Meem ki teen aayatein (Ilayhil Maseer) tak likh kar phir tehreer farmaya ke tere ashaar se mujhe sakht ranj hua.

Main tujhe tere ohday se mazool karta hoon. Chunancha is khat ko parhte hi Hazrat Noman darbar-e-khilafat mein hazir hue aur ba-adab arz kiya ke Amir-ul-Momineen wallah na main ne kabhi sharab pi, na naach rang-o-gana bajana dekha, na suna. Yeh toh sirf shairana tarang thi. Aap ne farmaya yahi mera khayal hai lekin meri toh himmat nahin parti ke aisay fahash-go shair ko koi ohda do. Pas maloom hua ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke nazdeek bhi shair apne sheron mein kisi jurm ke elaan par agarche woh qabil-e-hadd ho toh hadd nahin lagayi jaye gi is liye ke woh jo kehte hain so karte nahin, haan woh qabil-e-malamat aur laiq-e-sarzanish zaroor hain. Chunancha hadith mein hai ke pait ko lahoo peep se bhar lena ashaar se bhar lene se badtar hai. Matlab yeh ke Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ) na toh shair hain, na sahir, na kahin, na muftari hain. Aap ka zahir-e-haal hi aap ke in ayoob se bara'at ka bohat bada aadil gawah hai jaise farman hai ke toh hum ne inhe shair-goi sikhayi hai na is ke laiq hai, yeh toh sirf nasihat aur Quran-e-Mubeen hai. Aur aayat mein hai yeh Rasool-e-Kareem ka qaul hai kisi shair ka nahin, tum mein imaan ki kami hai, yeh kisi kahin ka qaul nahin. Tum mein nasihat maanne ka mada kam hai, yeh toh Rabb-ul-Alameen ki utari hui kitab hai. Is surat mein bhi yahi farmaya gaya ke yeh Rabb-ul-Alameen ki taraf se utri hai. Rooh-ul-Ameen ne tere dil par nazil farmayi hai, Arabi zaban mein hai is liye ke tu logon ko aagah kar de, isay shaitan le kar nahin aaye, na yeh un ke laiq hai na un ki bas ki baat hai, woh toh is ke sunne se bhi alag kar diye gaye hain. Jo jhootay muftari aur bad-kirdar hotay hain un ke paas shaitan aatay hain jo uchat-ti baatein sun suna kar un ke kaanon mein aa kar daal jatay hain. Mehez jhoot bolne walay yeh khud hotay hain, shairon ki pusht panahi obashon ka kaam hai, woh toh har wadi mein sar-gardan hotay hain, zabani baatein banatay hain, amal se koray rehtay hain. Is ke baad jo farman hai is ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke is se agli aayat jis mein shairon ki muzammat hai jab utri toh darbar-e-Rasool ke shu'ara Hazrat Hassan bin Sabit, Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawaha, Hazrat Ka'ab bin Malik (R.A) rotay hue darbar-e-Nabi (ﷺ) mein hazir hue aur kehne lage ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) shairon ki toh yeh gat bani aur hum bhi shair hain, isi waqt aap ne yeh dusri aayat tilawat farmayi ke imaan lane walay aur naik amal karne walay tum ho, zikr-e-Allah bakasrat karne walay tum ho, mazloom ho kar badla lene walay tum ho, pas tum un se mustasna ho (Ibn Abi Hatim waghera). Ek riwayat mein Hazrat Ka'ab ka naam hai, ek riwayat mein sirf Abdullah ki is shikayat par ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) shair toh main bhi hoon is dusri aayat ka nazil hona marwi hai lekin yeh qabil-e-nazar.

Is liye ke yeh Surah Makkiyah hai, shu'ara-e-Ansar jitne bhi thay woh sab Madine mein thay, phir un ke bare mein is aayat ka nazil hona yaqeenan mahal-e-ghaur hoga aur jo hadeesein bayan huin woh mursal hain, is wajah se aitimaad nahin ho sakta hai. Yeh aayat ka nazool beshak istisna ke bare mein hai aur sirf yahi Ansari shu'ara R.A hi nahin, balkeh agar kisi shayar ne apni jahiliyat ke zamane mein Islam aur musalmanon ke khilaf bhi ashaar kahe hon aur phir musalman ho jaye, tauba kar le aur us ke muqable mein zikr-e-Allah bakasrat kare, woh beshak is burai se alag hai. Hasanat sayyi'aat ko door kar deti hain, jabkeh us ne musalman ko aur deen-e-haq ko bura kaha tha woh bura tha, lekin jab us ne un ki madh ki toh burai bhalai se badal gayi. Jaise Hazrat Abdullah bin Ziba'ri R.A ne Islam se pehle Huzoor ﷺ ki hajv bayan ki thi lekin Islam ke baad badi madh bayan ki aur apne ashaar mein is hajv ka uzr bhi bayan karte hue kaha: "Main us waqt shaitani panja mein phansa hua tha." Isi tarah Abu Sufyan bin Haris bin Abdul Muttalib bawajood aap ka chacha zaad bhai hone ke aap ka jaani dushman tha aur bahut hajv kiya karta tha, jab musalman hue toh aise musalman hue ke duniya bhar mein Huzoor ﷺ se zyada mehboob unhein koi na tha. Aksar aap ki madh kiya karte thay aur bahut hi aqeedat-o-mohabbat rakhte thay. Sahih Muslim mein Ibn Abbas R.A se marvi hai ke Abu Sufyan Sakhr bin Harb jab musalman hua toh Huzoor ﷺ se kehne laga: "Mujhe teen cheezein ata farmaiye, ek toh yeh ke mere ladke Mu'awiyah ko apna katib bana lijiye. Dusre mujhe kafiron se jihad ke liye bhejiye aur mere sath koi lashkar dijiye taake jis tarah kufr mein musalmanon se lada karta tha ab Islam mein kafiron ki khabar loon." Aap ne dono baatein qabool farmayin, ek teesri darkhwast bhi ki jo qabool ki gayi. Pas aise log is aayat ke hukm se is dusri aayat se alag kar liye gaye. Zikr-e-Allah khwah woh apne sher'on mein bakasrat karein khwah aur tarah apne kalam mein, yaqeenan woh agle gunahon ka badla aur kaffara hai. Apni mazloomi ka badla lete hain, yani kafiron ki hajv ka jawab dete hain. Khud Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Hassan R.A se farmaya tha: "In kuffar ki hajv karo, Jibraeel A.S tumhare sath hain." Hazrat Ka'ab bin Malik R.A shayar ne jab shu'ara ki burai Quran mein suni toh Huzoor ﷺ se arz kiya, aap ne farmaya: "Tum in mein nahin ho, momin toh jis tarah apni jaan se jihad karta hai apni zaban se bhi jihad karta hai. Wallah tum logon ke ashaar toh unhein mujahideen ke teeron ki tarah chhed daalte hain." Phir farmaya: "Zalimon ko apna anjam abhi maloom ho jayega." Unhein uzr-o-ma'azrat bhi kuch kaam na aayegi. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain: "Zalim se bacho, is se maidan-e-Qayamat mein andheron mein reh jaoge." Aayat aam hai, khwah shayar hon khwah shayar na hon, sab shamil hain. Hazrat Hasan R.H ne ek Nasrani ke janaze ko jaate hue dekh kar yahi aayat tilawat farmayi thi. Aap jab is aayat ki tilawat karte toh is qadar rote ke hichki bandh jaati.

Rum mein jab Hazrat Fudala bin Ubaid tashreef le gaye us waqt ek sahib namaz parh rahe thay jab unhon ne is aayat ki tilawat ki toh aap ne farmaya is se murad Baitullah ki barbadi karne wale hain. Kaha gaya ke is se murad Ahl-e-Makkah hain, yeh bhi marwi hai ke murad mushrik hain. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke aayat aam hai sab par mushtamil hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain mere walid Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ne apne inteqal ke waqt apni wasiyat sirf do satron mein likhi. Jo yeh thi: Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim. Yeh hai wasiyat Abu Bakr bin Abi Quhafa ki. Us waqt ki jab ke woh duniya chhor rahe thay. Jis waqt kafir bhi momin ho jata, fajir bhi tauba kar leta tab kazib ko bhi sacha samajhta hai. Main tum par apna khalifa Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko bana ja raha hoon. Agar woh adl kare toh bahut achha aur mera guman bhi un ke sath yahi hai aur agar woh zulm kare aur koi tabdeeli kar de toh main ghaib nahin janta. Zalimon ko bahut jald maloom ho jayega ke kis lautne ki jagah woh laut-te hain. Surah Ash-Shu'ara ki tafsir bihamdillah khatam hui.

Pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne Rasool ko is aitraz se pak kiya aur sabit kiya ke aap jis Quran ko laye hain woh Allah ka kalam hai, usi ka utara hua hai. Buzurg, ameen, taqatwar farishta isay laya hai.
