Mehez jhoot bolne walay yeh khud hotay hain, shairon ki pusht panahi obashon ka kaam hai, woh toh har wadi mein sar-gardan hotay hain, zabani baatein banatay hain, amal se koray rehtay hain. Is ke baad jo farman hai is ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke is se agli aayat jis mein shairon ki muzammat hai jab utri toh darbar-e-Rasool ke shu'ara Hazrat Hassan bin Sabit, Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawaha, Hazrat Ka'ab bin Malik (R.A) rotay hue darbar-e-Nabi (ﷺ) mein hazir hue aur kehne lage ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) shairon ki toh yeh gat bani aur hum bhi shair hain, isi waqt aap ne yeh dusri aayat tilawat farmayi ke imaan lane walay aur naik amal karne walay tum ho, zikr-e-Allah bakasrat karne walay tum ho, mazloom ho kar badla lene walay tum ho, pas tum un se mustasna ho (Ibn Abi Hatim waghera). Ek riwayat mein Hazrat Ka'ab ka naam hai, ek riwayat mein sirf Abdullah ki is shikayat par ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) shair toh main bhi hoon is dusri aayat ka nazil hona marwi hai lekin yeh qabil-e-nazar.

Is liye ke yeh Surah Makkiyah hai, shu'ara-e-Ansar jitne bhi thay woh sab Madine mein thay, phir un ke bare mein is aayat ka nazil hona yaqeenan mahal-e-ghaur hoga aur jo hadeesein bayan huin woh mursal hain, is wajah se aitimaad nahin ho sakta hai. Yeh aayat ka nazool beshak istisna ke bare mein hai aur sirf yahi Ansari shu'ara R.A hi nahin, balkeh agar kisi shayar ne apni jahiliyat ke zamane mein Islam aur musalmanon ke khilaf bhi ashaar kahe hon aur phir musalman ho jaye, tauba kar le aur us ke muqable mein zikr-e-Allah bakasrat kare, woh beshak is burai se alag hai. Hasanat sayyi'aat ko door kar deti hain, jabkeh us ne musalman ko aur deen-e-haq ko bura kaha tha woh bura tha, lekin jab us ne un ki madh ki toh burai bhalai se badal gayi. Jaise Hazrat Abdullah bin Ziba'ri R.A ne Islam se pehle Huzoor ﷺ ki hajv bayan ki thi lekin Islam ke baad badi madh bayan ki aur apne ashaar mein is hajv ka uzr bhi bayan karte hue kaha: "Main us waqt shaitani panja mein phansa hua tha." Isi tarah Abu Sufyan bin Haris bin Abdul Muttalib bawajood aap ka chacha zaad bhai hone ke aap ka jaani dushman tha aur bahut hajv kiya karta tha, jab musalman hue toh aise musalman hue ke duniya bhar mein Huzoor ﷺ se zyada mehboob unhein koi na tha. Aksar aap ki madh kiya karte thay aur bahut hi aqeedat-o-mohabbat rakhte thay. Sahih Muslim mein Ibn Abbas R.A se marvi hai ke Abu Sufyan Sakhr bin Harb jab musalman hua toh Huzoor ﷺ se kehne laga: "Mujhe teen cheezein ata farmaiye, ek toh yeh ke mere ladke Mu'awiyah ko apna katib bana lijiye. Dusre mujhe kafiron se jihad ke liye bhejiye aur mere sath koi lashkar dijiye taake jis tarah kufr mein musalmanon se lada karta tha ab Islam mein kafiron ki khabar loon." Aap ne dono baatein qabool farmayin, ek teesri darkhwast bhi ki jo qabool ki gayi. Pas aise log is aayat ke hukm se is dusri aayat se alag kar liye gaye. Zikr-e-Allah khwah woh apne sher'on mein bakasrat karein khwah aur tarah apne kalam mein, yaqeenan woh agle gunahon ka badla aur kaffara hai. Apni mazloomi ka badla lete hain, yani kafiron ki hajv ka jawab dete hain. Khud Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Hassan R.A se farmaya tha: "In kuffar ki hajv karo, Jibraeel A.S tumhare sath hain." Hazrat Ka'ab bin Malik R.A shayar ne jab shu'ara ki burai Quran mein suni toh Huzoor ﷺ se arz kiya, aap ne farmaya: "Tum in mein nahin ho, momin toh jis tarah apni jaan se jihad karta hai apni zaban se bhi jihad karta hai. Wallah tum logon ke ashaar toh unhein mujahideen ke teeron ki tarah chhed daalte hain." Phir farmaya: "Zalimon ko apna anjam abhi maloom ho jayega." Unhein uzr-o-ma'azrat bhi kuch kaam na aayegi. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain: "Zalim se bacho, is se maidan-e-Qayamat mein andheron mein reh jaoge." Aayat aam hai, khwah shayar hon khwah shayar na hon, sab shamil hain. Hazrat Hasan R.H ne ek Nasrani ke janaze ko jaate hue dekh kar yahi aayat tilawat farmayi thi. Aap jab is aayat ki tilawat karte toh is qadar rote ke hichki bandh jaati.

Rum mein jab Hazrat Fudala bin Ubaid tashreef le gaye us waqt ek sahib namaz parh rahe thay jab unhon ne is aayat ki tilawat ki toh aap ne farmaya is se murad Baitullah ki barbadi karne wale hain. Kaha gaya ke is se murad Ahl-e-Makkah hain, yeh bhi marwi hai ke murad mushrik hain. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke aayat aam hai sab par mushtamil hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain mere walid Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ne apne inteqal ke waqt apni wasiyat sirf do satron mein likhi. Jo yeh thi: Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim. Yeh hai wasiyat Abu Bakr bin Abi Quhafa ki. Us waqt ki jab ke woh duniya chhor rahe thay. Jis waqt kafir bhi momin ho jata, fajir bhi tauba kar leta tab kazib ko bhi sacha samajhta hai. Main tum par apna khalifa Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko bana ja raha hoon. Agar woh adl kare toh bahut achha aur mera guman bhi un ke sath yahi hai aur agar woh zulm kare aur koi tabdeeli kar de toh main ghaib nahin janta. Zalimon ko bahut jald maloom ho jayega ke kis lautne ki jagah woh laut-te hain. Surah Ash-Shu'ara ki tafsir bihamdillah khatam hui.
